tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /sher phyin mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /sher phyin mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// sher phyin mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na maḥpradz+nyā pā ra mi tā yai// chos rnams kun gyi de bzhin nyid// spros pa'i mtshan ma nyer zhi ba// rgyal ba'i yum dang de sras la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal te// pha rol phyin pa'i mngon rtogs rim// rgyal ba'i sras kyis legs par bsdus// de don gsal zhing go bde bar// cung zad tsam zhig bshad par bya// de yang srid pa'i gcong rong nyam nga bar mi shes pa'i mun pas ches gnag par gyur pa de las skye dgu rnams drang bar bya ba'i phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa de dag kyang bsdu na 'khor lo rim pa gsum du 'dus shing*/ de'i nang nas 'khor lo bar pa sher phyin gyi mdo 'di'i dbye ba la snga rabs pa rnams kyis stong phrag (2na)brgya pa/ nyi khri lnga stong pa/ khri brgyad stong pa/ shes rab khri pa/ brgyad stong pa/ sdud pa ste yum drug dang*/ sher phyin bdun brgya pa/ lnga brgya pa/ sum brgya pa/ tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ lnga bcu pa/ sgo nyer lnga pa/ kau shi kas zhus pa/ rab rtsal rnam gnon gyis zhus pa/ sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu/ yi ge gcig ma/ shes rab snying po ste sras bcu gcig tu grangs nges mdzad cing*/ bcom ldan rig ral gyis ni/ sher phyin mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad ma/ nyi ma'i snying po/ zla ba'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po/ lag na rdo rje/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan rnams sher phyin yin kyang bcu bdun du ma 'dus pas grangs nges mi 'thad gsungs so// de dag la ar byang chub ye shes kyis rgyas 'bring bsdus pa dgur dbye bar mdzad do// yum gyi dgongs 'grel la rgyal ba ma pham pas sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gtso bor ston pa mngon rtogs rgyan dang*/ klu sgrub kyis dngos bstan stong nyid kyi don ston pa dbu ma rigs tshogs drug dang*/ phyogs glang gis brgyad stong don bsdus dang*/

dpa' bo'i 'bum ṭīka te shing rta'i srol 'byed tshul bzhir grags pa'i dang po 'di la'ang rjes 'brang gi 'grel pa la/ thogs med sku mched kyis gzhan stong gi (2ba)dbu mar bkral ba dang*/ 'phags pa grol sdes rang stong gi dbu mar dang*/ btsun grol gyis rang gi rnam dpyod dang mthun par bkral ba dang*/ shān+ti pa dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang*/ rat+na kīrti/ bud+dha shrī/ a bhā ya sogs kyis 'grel pa mdzad do// de'i rjes su mkhas pa snga ma'i bstan bcos mthong zhing lo bcu bdun du dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas mthar byams pa nyid kyi lung bstan thob pa'i slob dpon seng ge bzang pos rgyan 'di la yum bar pa dang sbyar ba le brgyad ma'i bsdus don/ brgyad stong pa dang sbyar ba brgyad stong 'grel chen/ sdud pa dang sbyar ba sdud 'grel rtogs sla ba/ kun las khyad par 'phags pa'i yum gsum ga dang sbyar ba don gsal 'grel pa dbu ma chen po dang mthun pa 'di mdzad do// 'di la yang rgyas 'gyur gyi 'grel pa la/ ku lan+da t+ta'i rtogs dka'i snang ba/ dharma mi tra'i tshig gsal/ nub kyi sgo glegs pa dang*/ kha che gzhon nu dpal gnyis kyi don bsdus rnams yod cing*/ gangs can du'ang 'grel bshad mang zhig byung ba las legs bshad du gyur pa kho bo'i 7 rje bla ma rgyal ba karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa 'di'i rtsa ba dang mthun par bsdus te 'chad par bya ba la gsum/ lo tswa bas bstan bcos bsgyur ba'i yan lag tu mdzad pa/ yan lag de ldan gyi bstan bcos dngos/ mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba'o// dang po la/ khungs btsun pa dang don rtogs pa'i phyir mtshan smos pa/ 'gyur mthar phyin pa'i phyir phyag 'tshal ba'o// dang po khungs btsun pa dang don rtogs pa'i phyir mtshan smos pa ni/ rgya gar skad du/ a bhi sa ma ya a laṅkā ra nā ma pradz+nya pā ra mi ta u pa de sha shās+t+ra kā ri ka bod skad du/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba/ ces pas bstan/ rgya gar na skad rigs la/ pi shā tsi/ sha za/ a wa bh+raṃ sha zur chag /(3na)pra kṛ ta/ rang bzhin/ saṃ kṛ ta/ legs sbyar/ dang bzhi yod pa'i nang nas saṃ kṛ ta'i skad du bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan la/ a bhi sa ma ya/ a laṅkā ra/ nā ma/ pradz+nya pā ra mi tā u pa de sha shās+t+ra kā ri kā/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don rgya chen po tshig nyung ngus ston par byed pa'i man ngag gis gdul bya rnams rgyal ba'i bstan pa la gzhug pa'i phyir nyon mongs pa'i nad bcos pa'i thabs 'di la ni mngon par rtogs pa gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba yin la/ de nyid kyang tshig le'ur byas pa ste tshigs bcad kho na yin no// gnyis pa 'gyur mthar phyin pa'i phyir phyag 'tshal ba ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstan/ ma rig bag chags dang bcas pa sangs shing shes bya la mtshan 'dzin med par mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas pa sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub de yid la sems shing bdud gzhom pa la dpa' ba'i dge 'dun thams cad la lo tsā bas bar chad zhi ba'i phyir phyag 'tshal bar mdzad do// gnyis pa yan lag de ldan gyi bstan bcos dngos 'chad pa la/ gang zag gzhan 'bras yum la dang ba bskyed pa'i rgyu mchod brjod/ bstan bcos la dang ba bskyed pa'i rgyu dgos 'brel/ dang ba skyes nas 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs nyid bshad pa'o// dang po gang zag gzhan 'bras yum la dang ba bskyed pa'i rgyu mchod brjod ni/ rje btsun byams pas so so rang rig pa'i ye shes smra brjod dang bral bar mnyam par bzhag pa na yul du byas pa'i chos dbyings de la rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su yang dag pa'i rtog pas kun nas bslangs te ngag gis mchod par brjod pa la/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi sgo nas yon tan brjod pa/

yon tan can gyi 'bras yum la phyag 'tshal (3ba)ba'o// dang po la/ gzhi shes kyis nyan rang gi bzhed don sgrub nus par bstan pa ni/ nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir 'khrid mdzad gang yin dang*// ces pas bstan/ gang zag nyan thos dang rang rgyal zhi ba 'tshol ba ste thob par 'dod pa rnams ni thabs phyi nang gi chos kun bdag med par shes pa nyid kyis bzhed don lhag bcas lhag med kyi nyer zhir 'khrid par mdzad nus pa gang yin pa dang*/ zhes so// 'di skabs kyi nyan thos ni shrā wa ka'i sgra las drangs na rang gi thos pa gzhan la sgrog pa ste/ de la dbye na/ lta ba khas len gyi nyan thos dang*/ sprul pa'i dang*/ rigs ma nges pa'i dang*/ nges pa'o// dang po gnyis ni byang sems la nyan thos kyi sgras bstan pa yin la/ phyi ma gnyis ni mtshan nyid pa'o// rang rgyal la dbye na/ bse ru lta bu/ tshogs spyod che chung gnyis dang gsum mo// de dag gi bzhed don ni/ gnas skabs kyi myang 'das te srog gi 'du byed ma btang la nyon mongs pa zhi ba'i lhag bcas dang*/ de btang la sdug bsngal spangs shing dge rtsa dang lam rgyun chad pa ni lhag med kyi myang 'das te/ mngon pa kun las btus pa las/ phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su nyan thos ni lam thams cad rgyun yang dag par gcod pa'i rnam par 'dor bas rnam par spong ste/ byang chub sems dpa' ni ma yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de'i gnas skabs su theg dman gyis rig pa rgyun chad par 'dod la/ sems tsam pas rig pa'i mtha' thug med yin pas rgyun ma chad par 'dod do// myang 'das de dag gi rgyu'i gtso bo ni nyan rang 'phags (4na)pa'i mngon rtogs kun shes nyid yin te/ des 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin spong ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa lam shes kyis byang sems kyi bzhed don sgrub nus par bstan pa ni/ 'gro la phan par byed rnams lam shes nyid kyis 'jig rten don sgrub mdzad pa gang*//

zhes pas bstan/ gang zag byang chub sems dpa' 'gro la phan par byed 'dod pa rnams thabs lam gsum rang bzhin med par shes pa nyid kyis bzhed don 'jig rten pa dag gi don du gnyer bya'i byang chub gsum sgrub par mdzad nus pa gang yin pa dang*/ zhes so// byang sems de la rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i byang sems/ mnyan pa lta bu/ rdzi bo lta bu dang gsum mo// dbye ba de'i dang po ni/ bzang por spyod pa'i smon lam dang*/ phyi ma ni/ byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam las grub pa yin no// de dag gis bzhed don ni/ byang 'phags rang rgyud kyi lam shes kyis sgrub pa yin te/ thabs snying rje chen po dang ldan zhing*/ shes rab lam gsum ga khong du chud pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub nus par bstan pa ni/ gang dang yang dag ldan pas thub rnams rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs 'di gsungs pa// zhes pas bstan/ gang zag 'bras yum gang dang yang dag ldan pa'i thub pa zag pa gsum dang bral ba chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'dod pa rnams ni thabs rnam pa rtags mtshan ma kun skye ba med par mkhyen pa dang ldan pas bzhed don chos kyi phung po sna tshogs pa 'di dag gsung bar nus pa yin no// bzhed don de ni rang gi mngon rtogs rnam mkhyen gyis sgrub nus pa yin te/ des gdul bya'i khams la 'jug pa'i phyir ro// 'dir chos 'khor gyi mtha' dpyad pa la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshon (4ba)bya'i sgra bshad/ mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ ston pas bstan pa'i dam chos gang zhig gdul bya'i sdug bsngal dang sgrib pa sel byed nyid yin te/ sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad dang*// sgrib kun sel byed dam pa'i chos// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ chos zhes bya ba ni dhṛ dha ra ṇa 'dzin pa la 'jug pa yin pas/ rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin par byed pa ste/

rnam mkhyen gyi rang mtshan chos thams cad mngon sum du mkhyen pa de 'dzin pa lta bu'o// 'khor lo ni myur bar 'gro ba la sogs pa 'khor lo rin po che dang chos mtshungs pas so// gsum pa la/ rtogs pa'i chos dang lung gi chos so// dang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo goms pas bskyed pa'i rnam byang gi bden pa'o// dbye na gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de bzhin nyid la dmigs pas zag pa dang bral ba'i 'gog bden te/ slob mi slob kyi spangs pa dang*/ lhag med kyi mya ngan 'das sam chos sku'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'gog pa de thob byed kyi thabs zag med lam bden te/ mthong lam dang sgom lam mo// gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ ngo bo/ gsungs tshul/ dbye ba/ grangs nges kyi khyad par ro// dang po ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i ngo bo rgyu 'bras gang rung brjod byar ston pa'i ngag gang zhig /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis po gang rung gis bsdus pa'o// bcu gnyis ni/ phan yon bcu gzigs nas smos pa'i tshul gyis ston pa mdo ste/ de'i dbus mthar tshigs su bcad pa dbyangs bsnyad/ 'byung 'gyur lung ston pa/ rkang pa gnyis pa nas drug pa'i bar (5na)gyi tshigs bcad/ bstan pa gnas pa'i don du yi rang ba la ched du brjod pa/ gang zag gi ched du byung ba dang bcas pa'i bslab pa gsungs pa gleng gzhi/ dpe dang bcas pa rtogs brjod/ gang zag gzhan gyi byung tshul bstan pa de lta bu byung ba/ rang gi byang chub tu spyad pa spyod tshul gsungs pa skyes rabs/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang ldan pa'i shin tu rgyas pa/ 'phags pa rnams kyi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos/ mtshan nyid phyin ci ma log par ston pa gtan la dbab pa'i sde rnams so// de'i dang po lnga ni nyan thos kyi mdo ste/ de 'og bzhi ni 'dul ba/ de 'og gnyis ni byang sems kyi mdo sde/ gcig ni nyan thos dang theg chen gnyis ka'i mngon pa'i sde snod do// gnyis pa ni/

lung gi chos de dag kyang chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong du gnas la/ chos phung ni mdo sde pas tshig dang*/ bye smras ming du 'dod pa yin te/ mdzod las/ tshig gam ming yin de dag kyang*// gzugs sam 'du byed dag tu 'dus// zhes so// sems tsam pas/ nyan pa po'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i sgrar snang ba'i rnam rig la 'dod do// chos phung gi tshad la/ sh+lo ka drug stong dang*/ phung po sogs brjod byar ston pa'i gtam rgyud re re dang*/ 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs pa re re'i gnyen po la dang*/ glang po che sa la rab brtan gyis khur nus pa'i snag tshas chos phung gcig 'bri nus par 'dod pa sogs so// gsum pa ni/ rnam pa bcu'i (5ba)sgo nas legs par gsungs pa ste/ bcu ni/ yang dag par bslang ba nyid kyis dang*/ dbang du mdzad pa dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ rab tu brtan pa dang*/ rab tu dbye ba dang*/ rten dang*/ go bar mdzad pa dang*/ gdags pa dang*/ dus dang*/ yon tan yongs su 'dzin pa nyid rnams so// bzhi pa ni/ chos 'khor rim pa gsum du phye ba ni theg chen pa'i lugs yin la/ de la'ang rnam bzhag mi 'dra ba bzhi yod de/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ bka' dang po bden bzhi'i 'khor lo// bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i 'khor lo// tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o// gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdor/ bden pa bzhi'i tshul/ stong pa nyid kyi tshul/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i tshul zhes gsungs so// de'i dgongs 'grel du rgyud blar/ 'jig rten zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa'i dang*/ rab tu smin pa'i dang*/ lung ston pa'i 'khor lo zhes gsungs so// klu sgrub kyis ni/ dang po bdag ston pa'i dang*/ bar du bdag med ston pa'i dang*/ tha mar lta ba kun bzlog pa'i 'khor lo zhes gsungs so// de ltar bshad pa las lugs snga ma gsum du ni/ dang por bden bzhi/ bar du spros bral/

tha mar chos dbyings ye shes bden grub tu ston par mtshungs so// lugs phyi mar ni/ dang por thabs kyi cha/ bar du rnam grangs pa'i don dam/ tha mar spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba ston pa yin no// (6na)des na nges don mthar thug tu ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na ngag gi rgyu 'byung ba dang kun slong med pas sangs rgyas kyis chos gcig kyang ma bstan la/ nges don tsam du ni rim pa gsum ga cig car du gsungs kyang*/ gdul bya rnams kyi mos pa'i dbang gis so sor go ba yin te/ sems can rnams kyi bsam pa yis// bskul bas sangs rgyas gsung 'byung ngo*// de la 'dir rtog yongs mi mnga'// zhes dang*/ gsung gcig nyid du gsungs mod kyang*// du ma nyid du so sor go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// drang don du ni chos 'khor rnams rim gyis gsungs pa yin la/ de yang rnam bzhag dang po'i dbang du byas te rim pa gsum po so so la/ gnas/ dus/ 'khor/ chos bzhi bzhis 'chad pa las/ rim pa dang po ni/ 'khor mo 'jig tu lo bdun gyi bar du lnga sde dang lha mang po la bden pa bzhi lan gsum bzlas pas bcu gnyis so// bar pa ni bya rgod phung ri na lo nyi shu rtsa bdun du dge slong pha ma dang*/ dge bsnyen pha ma lnga stong dang*/ byang sems bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag la sher phyin ston pa rnams so// tha ma ni ri ma la ya dang*/ yangs pa can la sogs par lo bcu ru/ 'khor theg pa sna tshogs la mos pa dag la kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub ston pa rnams so// lnga pa ni/ kun rdzob bden pa gtso bor ston pa ni drang don gyi mdo yin la/ dbye na/ pha dang ma ni bsad bya zhing*// zhes pa lta bu log pa'i (6ba)kun rdzob ston pa dang*/ tshogs bsags pa las bde ba 'byung*// zhes pa lta bu yang dag kun rdzob ston pa gnyis so// don dam pa'i bden pa gtso bor ston pa ni nges don gyi mdo yin zhing*/ de'i dbye ba la thogs med sku mched kyi lugs las ni/

sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa nges don gyi drang don/ sgra ji bzhin pa nges don gyi nges don gyi mdo zhes 'byung ngo*// klu sgrub yab sras kyi lugs las/ spros pa phyogs re bkag pa'i de bzhin nyid ston pa gnas skabs pa'i nges don dang*/ spros pa ma lus pa bkag pa'i de bzhin nyid ston pa mthar thug gi nges don gyi mdo zhes 'byung ngo*// des na mdo sde dgongs 'grel nas gsungs pa'i 'khor lo rim pa gsum po de la drang nges so sor 'byed na/ 'khor lo dang po la nges don dang*/ phyi ma gnyis la drang don gyi cha yod mod/ gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na dang po drang don dang phyi ma gnyis nges don du theg chen pa dag mthun yang*/ khyad par ni/ rnam rdzun pas 'khor lo bar pa sgra ji bzhin pa'i nges don du mi 'dod la/ ngo bo nyid med smra bas sgra ji bzhin pa'i nges don du 'dod do// 'dir 'di ltar shes dgos te/ 'khor lo bar par ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes zhes sogs la skrag pa skyes pa'i gang zag gi don du 'khor lo tha mar yod med so sor dbyes nas/ gzhan dbang la kun brtags kyis stong pa'i yongs grub yod ces gsungs la/ de'i tshe lta bas spros pa gcod pa na 'khor lo bar pa nges don dang*/ sgom pas nyams su myong ba na (7na)tha ma nges don du 'gro ba yin no//

gnyis pa yon tan can gyi yum la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas sangs rgyas kyi ni yum de la phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstan/ kun shes kyi sgo nas nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang lam shes kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas rnams la phan 'dogs par byed pa'i yon tan can gyis ni yum de la rje btsun byams pas bstan bcos rtsom pa'i thog mar phyag 'tshal bar mdzad do// 'dir 'phags bzhi'i yum du 'jog pa'i tshul ni/ 'bras yum la gzhi lam rnam gsum skye ba med pa'i yon tan gyi cha gsum yod la/ de gsum ni so sor 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs yin te/ yum bar pa las/ rab 'byor thams cad shes pa nyid ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no// lam shes pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yin no// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// mngon rtogs des ni rang rang gi bzhed don sgrub pa'i sgo nas phan 'dogs par byed pas yum du gyur pa yin la/ yum mtshan nyid pa de yang 'phags lam thob pa yan chad kyi gang zag gi rgyud la yod kyi de phyin chad na ni med de/ mos spyod kyi gnas skabs su gzhi shes dang lam shes mtshan nyid pa med pa'i phyir te spang bya'i sa bon la mi gnod pa'i phyir ro// rgyun mtha' man chad na rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid pa yang med de/ chos thams cad kyi rnam rtags mtshan (7ba)ma skye med mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang rje mthun pa ni yod par blta'o// 'dir 'di ltar dogs te/ yum la mkhyen pa gsum gyi sgo nas bstod pa 'di mangs pas/ rnam mkhyen gcig pu'i sgo nas bstod par 'thad cing*/ yang na nyungs te dngos po brgyad ka'i sgo nas bstod dgos so snyam na/

skyon dang po med de/ de ltar gyi tshe na nyan rang byang sems rnams yum la dang ba mi skye ba'i phyir ro// skyon phyi ma med de// mkhyen gsum 'di'i nang du dngos po gzhan brgyad 'dus pa'i phyir ro// 'dus tshul yang*/ chos sku ni rnam mkhyen las logs su med cing*/ sbyor ba bzhi ni mkhyen gsum gyi rgyu yin pas 'bras bus rgyu bsdus pa lta bu yin no// 'dir gzhi lam rnam gsum gyi de kho na nyid yum la skye med spros bral gyi sgo nas bstod pa las 'phros nas spros mtshan 'gog tshul cung zad bshad na/ gang zag tu 'dzin pa 'gog /chos su 'dzin pa 'gog pa'o// dang po la/ phyogs snga bkod/ de dgag pa'o// dang po la/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin lhan skyes ni grub mthas blo ma bsgyur ba'i 'gro ba kun gyi rgyud la yod pa'i phung po'i tshogs pa la dmigs nas ngar 'dzin pa tsam mo// kun btags ni de la blos sna tshogs su brtags pa phyi rol pa rnams kyi smra ba ste/ phyi rol pa la rtsa ba'i dbye ba/ rgyang 'phen pa/ grangs can pa/ dbang phyug pa/ khyab 'jug pa/ gcer (8na)bu pa dang lnga/ dang pos 'jig rten pha rol med par 'dod pas chad smra/ lhag ma rnams rtag smra ba yin no// dang po rgyang 'phen pa ni phur bus lha ma yin las g.yul rgyal ba'i ched du tshe phyi ma med pa'i bstan bcos brtsams pa la brten nas byung zhing 'dzam gling du rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod sogs snyoms 'jug pa drug /rgyu rgyal la sogs rjes sgrogs pa drug /'od srungs rdzogs byed sogs rtog ge pa'i ston pa drug rnams su yod la/ 'byung bzhi'i dus na mi gsal ba'i bdag dang lus sems zung du 'jug pa na gsal ba'i bdag sogs 'dod/ grangs can pa ni/ tshe lo dpag med kyi dus byung ba'i drang srong ser skyas rang gi ji ltar rtogs pa gzhan la bstan pa las byung zhing lhag bcas lhag med gnyis su gyes la/

gtso bo'i blor gnas pa'i bdag za po dang*/ rtag pa dang*/ shes rig yin pa sogs 'dod/ dbang phyug pa ni/ drang srong rkang mig dang gzegs zan gyis dbang phyug la brten nas byas shing rig pa can pa/ bye brag pa/ gsal byed pa/ rna ba ma phug pa dang bzhir gyes la/ bdag de lus dbang po blo sogs kun la khyab kyang gson pa'i lus kho na la gnas shing yon tan bcu ldan sogs 'dod/ khyab 'jug pa ni/ rgyal dpogs dang gzhon nu ma len las byung zhing tshangs pa pa/ dpyod pa pa/ brda sprod pa/ rig byed mtha' pa/ gsang ba pa dang lngar gyes la/ shes rig rtag pa'i bdag tu 'dod/ gcer bu pa ni/ drang srong rgyal ba dam pa las byung zhing khyu mchog sogs (8ba)kyi rjes 'brang las nyi shu rtsa lngar gyes la/ bdag rdzas su 'dod pa ste mdor na kun kyang bdag rtag par khas len pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ mu stegs rnams kyis gang btags pa'i// bdag de rigs pas brtags na 'dir// phung rnams kun gyi nang rnams ni// phung po las ni gzhan nyid du// gang zhig gnas kyang rnyed ma yin// nam yang rnyed pa ma yin no// phung rnams yod kyi de rtag min// phung po yin na de mi rtag /ces dang*/ 'jug pa las kyang*/ de ltar btags pa'i bdag chos can/ tha snyad du yang dngos por yod pa ma yin te/ ngar 'dzin gyi yul ma yin pa'i phyir te/ ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi khyod du ma bzung ba'i phyir/ yang rang sde mang bkur ba'i nang tshan gnas ma bu pa sogs kha cig phung po las de nyid dang gzhan du med pa'i bdag 'dod pa la/ 'jug par/ bdag mang po dang rdzas grub dang 'jig lta kun brtags su mi 'gyur par thal/ phung po bdag yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes 'gog par mdzad do// gnyis pa la'ang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chos kyi bdag 'dzin lhan skyes ni myu gu la dmigs nas myu gu'o snyam du 'dzin pa tsam ste grub mthas ma bsgyur ba'o// kun btags ni/

de la sna tshogs su brtags pa ste/ dbye na bzung ba bden grub smra ba/ rnam shes bden grub smra ba'o// dang po la/ grub mtha' smra ba po'i dbye ba/ 'dod pa rags rim brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang drug bcu na rgyal po mya ngan med kyi dus grong khyer me tog gis rgyas par dge 'dun 'khrugs nas phal chen pa dang gnas brtan pa gnyis su gyes/ dang po la (9na)brgyad/ phyi ma la bcur gyes pa'am/ yang na dang po la drug /phyi ma la bcu gnyis su gyes pa'am/ yang na rtsa ba gnyis po de'i steng du rnam par phye ste smra ba dang gsum gyi dang po la brgyad/ gnas brtan pa la drug phye ste smra ba la bzhir phye ba'am/ yang na dul ba'i lhas bshad pa ltar thams cad yod smra bdun/ phal chen pa lnga/ gnas brtan pa gsum/ mang bkur pa gsum ste rtsa ba'i sde bzhi/ gyes pa sde pa bco brgyad de 'dren tshul gyi khyad par ro// de dag kyang grub mtha' gtso che bar bsdu na/ gnas ma bu sogs lngas bdag 'dod pa dang*/ lhag ma rnams de mi 'dod pa'i dbye bas gnyis su phye ba'am/ yang na yod smra'i nang tshan sa ston sde pa ni mdo sde pa dang lhag ma rnams bye brag tu smra ba ste gnyis su 'du'o// gnyis pa la mi mthun pa dang*/ mthun pa'o// dang po ni/ sde pa bco brgyad so so'i 'dod tshul zhib mo rnams yi ges 'jigs la/ bye mdo'i khyad par ni/ rim pas mngon pa sde bdun bka' yin min/ lung chos 'du byed dang gzugs phung du 'dod pa/ rdul phran rnams ma reg pa dang reg par gnas pa/ rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs sgrub 'gog /dbang po gzugs can tshad ma yin min/ rgyu 'bras dus mnyam 'dod mi 'dod/ don snang gi shes pas phyi don rnam med rjen gcer du 'dzin par 'dod pa dang mi 'dod pa/ snang ba sems su mi 'dod pa dang 'dod pa/ dbyibs dus gsum ldan min 'du byed rang skya thub pa'i rdzas su dang cha la btags pa'i brtags par 'dod pa/

'gog bden dngos por 'dod mi 'dod/ de bzhin nyid mi 'dod pa dang 'dod pa/ shes pa (9ba)rang rig mi 'dod pa dang 'dod pa/ bya 'brel ldan pa rnams byed po 'brel can thos po las don gzhan dang don gcig 'dod pa/ lus shes bde ba bsam gtan gyi yan lag tu mi 'dod pa dang 'dod pa/ dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu las nyams pa yod med/ lus la sems kyi sa bon mi 'dod pa dang 'dod pa/ rags pa rtsom pa la rdul rdzas brgyad ka dgos mi dgos/ sems byung so brgyad po nang phan tshun rdzas gzhan 'dod pa dang*/ kun 'gro lnga ma gtogs btags yod rdzas gcig 'dod pa/ rten 'brel re re ba phung po lnga tshogs dang phung po re rer 'dod pa 'di dag ni khyad par ro// gnyis pa ni/ phung khams skye mched kyi dbye ba/ skye gnas bzhi/ 'gro ba lnga/ zas bzhi/ rdul phran chung mtha' bden grub/ rags pa brdzun pa/ sems sems byung*/ 'byung 'gyur 'byung ba las/ shes pa mtshungs ldan las/ ldan min 'du byed gnas skabs can las skye ba/ bden bzhi/ lam lnga/ nyan rang byang sems sogs kyi lam bgrod tshul/ rgyal bu don grub kyi tshe so skyer 'dod pa/ bsam gzugs kyi 'dod tshul phal cher/ sangs rgyas sa na rnam smin gyi phung po yod pa/ lhag med rig pa zad pa/ zag pa'i rnam gzhag /gzhig cing blos sel nus pa bum pa lta bu kun rdzob bden pa dang*/ de ltar mi nus pa'i gzugs dang bde ba lta bu don dam bden par 'dod pa sogs so// gnyis pa rnam shes bden grub smra ba ni/ sems tsam rnam bden pa ste sems la shar ba'i don gyi rnam pa bden par 'dod pas so// dbye na gzung 'dzin gyi cha so sor rdzas (10na)gzhan bden par 'dod pa'i sgo nga phyed tshal ba/ gzung ba'i rnam pa ji snyed du shes pa yang 'dod pa'i gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa/ rnam pa sna tshogs kyang shes pa gcig gi rang bzhin du 'dod pa sna tshogs gnyis med pa dang gsum du yod/

gnyis pa de dgag pa la/ dbu ma pa ngos bzung*/ des bstan pa'i rigs pa'o// dang po ni/ theg pa chen po dbu ma pa la'ang bden gnyis gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas bka' bar pa nges don du 'grel pa'i klu sgrub dang*/ rang bzhin gsum gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas bka' mtha' ma nges don du 'grel ba'i thogs med de srol 'byed kyi gtso bo gnyis byung ba de dag gi rjes 'brang yang mtha' yas la/ snga ma'i rjes 'brang las rnam med pa dang*/ phyi ma las rnam bden pa sogs don dam las cung ring ba 'phags yul du'ang byung zhing gangs can du ni mu cor smra'o// phyogs gnyis po de ni snga mas chos can glo bur ba stong bya la dgongs shing*/ phyi mas chos nyid kyi gnas tshul stong gzhi la dgongs nas grub mtha' bzhag la/ des na 'di gnyis gzhi 'gyur med bde gshegs snying po/ lam de'i 'khrul pa sel byed/ 'bras bu de sgrib bral sku'i rnam bzhag rnams mthun pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ thogs med kyis ming don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa ldog par mdzad de/ lto ldir ba'i don de bum pa'i ming dang gcig pa 'gal te/ gcig na brda mi shes pa'i byis pas lto ldir ba mthong ba'i tshe bum pa'o snyam pa'i blo skye srid par thal ba la de mi skye ba dang*/ gzhan yang brgya byin mang por dang*/ yul yul can 'dres (10ba)pa dang*/ me brjod pa'i tshe kha tshig par 'gyur pa'i skyon sogs gsungs so// klu sgrub kyis kyang bden grub 'gog byed kyi rigs pa lnga gsungs pa'i mtha' ma rten 'brel gyi rigs pa ni/ phyi nang gi dngos po rnams chos can/ bden par med de/ rten 'brel tsam yin pa'i phyir/ 'di'i phyogs chos sgrub sla zhing khyab pa yang*/ grub mtha' 'og mas rten 'brel 'dod cing de'i don ltos grub tu 'dod la ltos grub dang bden grub 'gal bas so// des na 'di ni tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub kyi rtags so// 'dir rje btsun gyi mchod brjod 'di ni mdo'i gleng gzhi'i don 'grel ba yin te/

dge slong lnga stong tsam zhes pa ni/ nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol zhes sogs dang*/ byang sems bye ba khrag khrig ces pa ni/ 'gro la zhes sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das zhes pa dang*/ thub rnams zhes sogs go rim mthun pas so// gnyis pa gzhan bstan bcos la dang ba bskyed ba'i rgyu dgos 'brel ni/ mchod brjod kyi mjug tu rtsom par dam bca' dgos 'brel gyi sgo nas bstan cing*/ de yang mdo 'di'i don bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i tshul gyis bshad par mdzad la/ yan lag lnga ni/ rnam shes rig pa/ dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang*// tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyar bcas// brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par bya// zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// de dag gi go rim yang rgyan 'di la mtshon na/ dgos 'brel gyis dgos don dang*/ lus rnam bzhag gis bsdus don dang*/ yan lag rgyas bshad kyis tshig don bstan pa dang*/ go rim mi 'khrug par mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ rigs pa dang mi 'gal ba/ snga phyi mi (11na)'gal ba'i brgal lan gnyis ni skabs skabs su bstan pa ltar ro// de la dgos sogs dang por 'chad rigs te/ ji srid dgos pa ma bstan pa// de srid du ni su yis 'dzin// zhes gsungs pas so// de la dgos 'brel ngag la yod pa'i dgos sogs/ bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs so// dang po ngag la yod pa'i dgos sogs ni/ bstan bcos kyi dgos sogs chos bzhi ni dgos 'brel ngag gi brjod bya/ ngag de las bstan bcos la dgos sogs yod pa thog mar go ba ni dgos pa/ go ba la brten nas dpyod ldan bstan bcos la 'jug pa ni nying dgos/ snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi ma la 'brel ba ni 'brel pa'o// gnyis pa bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// ston pas 'di las bshad pa gang*// gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te// chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyi// mdo don dran pa la bzhag nas// blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir//

bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes// bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin// zhes pas bstan/ gzhung dang sbyar nas 'chad de/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mtshon byed kyi chos bcu la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob byed kyi lam/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pas yum 'di dag las bshad pa gang yin pa de ni bstan bcos rgyan gyi yang brjod bya yin no// phyi rol pa dang nyan rang sogs gzhan gyis myong bar nus pa ma yin te chos sku de ni sbyin pa la sogs pa chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyis sgrub nus par mdo las gsungs pa'i don dran pa la bzhag nas byang sems blo dang ldan pas lam der zhugs pa na chos sku mthong ba'am rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes pa ni nying dgos yin no// byang chub sgrub pa la yum gyi don bde blag tu ni rtogs pa dgos so zhes bya ba'i phyir bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin no// nying dgos dgos pa las dgos pa brjod bya las byung ba'i 'brel pa ni brjod bya dgos pa nying dgos bstan pas rtogs nus pa (11ba)yin no// 'o na dgos sogs la bzhir grangs nges sam zhe na/ nges te/ log rtog bsal bya la brjod bya med pa dang*/ 'bras bu med pa dang*/ thabs med pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i don 'grub par mi 'gyur snyam pa ste bzhi yod pas/ sel byed dgos sogs la yang bzhir grangs nges pa'i phyir ro//

gsum pa 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa la/ rgyas pa la mos pa'i gang zag la brgyad du bstan pa/ 'bring la mos pa'i gang zag la drug tu bstan pa/ bsdus pa la mos pa'i gang zag la gsum du bstan pa'o// dang po la/ lus rnam bzhag dang*/ yan lag rgyas bshad gnyis las/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad// ces pas bstan/ gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i brjod bya ni/ lam dang 'bras bu'i sher phyin dngos po brgyad kyi don du gnas la/ de dag ni 'dir yang dag par bshad do// 'di'i skabs su sher phyin la gsum du yod pa las 'bras bu sher phyin ni/ chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid bzung 'dzin gyi dri ma glo bur ba thams cad dang bral ba de'o// lam sher phyin ni de dri ma dang bral rim ste/ dbye na/ gtso phal gnyis kyi snga ma la yang mos spyod kyi gnas skabs kyi zag bcas dang*/ mthong sgom gyi gnas skabs kyi zag med gnyis su yod de/ zla ba snying pos zhus pa las/ mos pas spyod pa'i sa'i gnas skabs kyi gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams te/ de spong bar byed pa ni zag par bcas pa'i sher phyin yin no// rigs kyi bu de la zag pa med pa'i sher phyin ni mthong ba'i lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes te/ zhes gsungs pas so// phal pa ni nyan rang dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa ste/ 'bum ṭīka las/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi mthar phyin pa'i sas bsdus pa dgra bcom pa'i lam gyi ye shes kyang sher phyin (12na)gyi rgyu mthun pa yin pas sher phyin gyi ming thob par 'gyur ro// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// gzhung sher phyin ni 'bras bu sher phyin de thob pa'i thabs ston par byed pa'i ming tshig gi tshogs so// des na 'bras bu sher phyin ni sher phyin dngos yin la/

lam ni shes rab yin gyi sher phyin ma yin kyang 'bras ming rgyu la btags pa dang*/ gzhung ni shes rab tsam yang min kyang brjod bya'i ming gis rjod byed la btags pa yin no// de skad du 'grel chen las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu de ni dngos yin la/ de thob pa dang rjes su mthun pa nyid kyis na tshig dang ngag gi tshogs kyi gzhung dang mthong ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi lam la yang sher phyin zhes bya ba ni btags pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ bshad bya dngos po brgyad/ 'chad byed don bdun cu'o// dang po la/ dngos po brgyad so so'i don/ go rim nges pa/ mdo dang sbyar ba'o// dang po la/ brgyad las rnam mkhyen la/ mtshan nyid/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so// dang po mtshan nyid ni/ chos thams cad skye med du mngon sum du rtogs shing*/ don gnyis mthar thug pa'i ye shes de yin no// de la ni kha cig gis sangs rgyas kyi sa na sems sems byung rnams med pas rang snang la ye shes med do zhes gsung*/ kha cig gis ye shes sgyu ma lta bu yod par 'chad/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de la kun rdzob kyi snang ba mnga' 'am mi mnga' zhe na/ slob dpon kha cig ni chos can ji snyed pa skyu ru ra rlon pa lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar snang yang mtshan 'dzin (12ba)gyi 'khrul pa mi 'byung ste/ sgrib gnyis kyi sa bon ma lus pa spangs pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs so// 'dir ni mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir/ zhes gsungs pas 'khrul snang mi mnga' bar 'chad dgos so// gnyis pa sgra bshad ni/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid// ces pas bstan/ chos thams cad kyi rnam pa dang*/ rtags dang*/ mtshan ma kun skye med du mngon sum du mkhyen pa nyid do// gsum pa dbye ba ni/ chos nyid ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i mnyam bzhag dang*/ de dang dbyer med pa'i chos can ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rjes thob gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni/

mdo las/ rab 'byor/ chos gcig gis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya ste zhi ba'i rnam pas so// zhes gsungs pa ltar rang ngo gsal stong gi cha nas bzhag la/ phyi ma ni/ shes bya'i rnam pa thams cad skye ba med par mkhyen pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'o// bzhi pa sa mtshams ni/ rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar yod cing*/ rjes mthun pa ni de man chad kyi 'phags lam na'ang yod de/ ji lta ba sa dang po nas dang*/ ji snyed pa sa brgyad pa nas so// gnyis pa lam shes pa la yang snga ma ltar bzhi las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ lam gsum gzod ma nas skye med du rtogs shing shes sgrib kyi gnyen por gyur pa de'o// gnyis pa sgra bshad ni/ lam shes nyid// ces pas bstan/ lam thams cad khong du chub pa'am shes shing lam gyi bya ba yang byed pa nyid do// gsum pa dbye ba ni/ theg gsum gyi lam gsum rtogs pa dang*/ rtogs pa de dag gzod ma nas zhi bar shes pa gnyis so// bzhi pa sa mtshams ni/ sa dang po yan chad nas yod do// gsum pa kun shes la (13na)yang bzhi las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pas nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por gyur pa de'o// gnyis pa sgra bshad ni/ de nas thams cad shes pa nyid// ces pas bstan/ de nas gzhi phung khams skye mched thams cad bdag med par shes pa nyid do// gsum pa dbye ba ni/ mtshan 'dzin dang bcas pa spang bya'i gzhi shes dang*/ mtshan 'dzin dang bral ba'i gnyen po'i gzhi shes gnyis so// bzhi pa sa mtshams ni/ dang po nyan rang gi mthong lam nas/ phyi ma ni sa dang po nas yod do// bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba la'ang*/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum rtogs par bya ba'i phyir gzhi lam rnam gsum rang bzhin med par sgom pa'o// gnyis pa sgra bshad ni/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang*// zhes pas bstan/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i chos la sogs pa'i rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs phyir du sgom pa'i sbyor ba dang*/

gsum pa dbye ba ni/ sbyor ba bzhi'am nyi shu'o// bzhi pa sa mtshams ni/ tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha' man chad na'o// lnga pa rtse sbyor la'ang*/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gzhi lam rnam gsum rang bzhin med par sgom pa rab tu gyur pa'o// gnyis pa sgra bshad ni/ rtse mor phyin dang*// zhes pas bstan/ rnam kun gyi rtse mor te rab kyi mthar phyin pa dang*/ gsum pa dbye ba ni/ sbyor mthong sgom bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dang bzhi'o// bzhi pa sa mtshams ni/ drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar na'o// drug pa mthar gyis pa la'ang*/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ rtse sbyor la brtan pa thob pa'i phyir rim gyis sgom pa'o// gnyis pa sgra bshad ni/ mthar gyis pa// zhes pas bstan/ mthar gyis pa ste snga ma'i rjes su phyi ma 'brel bar sgom pa'o// gsum pa dbye ba ni/ bcu gsum mo// bzhi pa sa mtshams ni/(13ba)drod nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs bar ro// bdun pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la'ang*/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom la brtan pa thob pas cig car sgom pa'o// gnyis pa sgra bshad ni/ skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub// ces pas bstan/ rim gyis phar phyin dag la goms pas/ bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma gcig la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa yin no// gsum pa dbye ba ni/ mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bzhi yod do// bzhi pa sa mtshams ni/ rgyun mtha' kho na la'o// brgyad pa chos sku la'ang*/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ sbyor bzhi'i 'bras bu mthar thug go / gnyis pa sgra bshad ni/ chos kyi sku dang*// zhes pas bstan/ zag pa med pa'i chos thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa'i sku dang*/ gsum pa dbye ba ni/ sku gsum phrin las dang bcas pa'o// bzhi pa sa mtshams ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na la'o// gnyis pa go rim nges pa ni/ de rnam brgyad// ces pas bstan/ nyams su blang bya skye med gsum shes par bya ba'i phyir mkhyen gsum bstan/

de dag nyams su blang ba'i thabs sbyor bzhi/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu chos sku bstan pa ni/ spyi'i go rim/ bye brag tu'ang rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu yin pas sems bskyed sogs chos bcu dang por bstan/ de dag gi don du gnyer bya yang lam shes la rag las pas lam shes bstan/ de'i mthun phyogs dang mi mthun phyogs ngo shes pa'i phyir gzhi shes bstan pa ni mkhyen gsum gyi go rim mo// mkhyen gsum mngon du bya ba'i phyir sgom pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ de mngon par rtogs pa'i tshul gyi sgom pa rtse sbyor/ de la brtan pa thob par bya ba'i phyir sgom (14na)pa mthar gyis pa/ de la brtan pa thob nas cig car du sgom pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba rnams ni sbyor bzhi'i go rim mo// de ltar na dngos po rnam pa brgyad po de dag ni/ skabs brgyad kyi don du gnas la/ dngos po re re bas kyang skyes bu'i lam yongs rdzogs re re ston no// de yang gong du mkhyen gsum gyi mtshan nyid dang dbye ba la sogs pa bstan pa ni/ gang zag dang 'brel ba'i mngon rtogs bsdu byed mkhyen gsum yin la/ bsdu bya'i mkhyen gsum ni de dag mtshon byed de/ skabs dang po gsum gyi brjod byar gyur pa'o// gsum pa mdo dang sbyar ba ni/ rab 'byor gyi le'us rnam mkhyen/ mtha' gnyis rnam dag gi le'us lam shes/ spyod pa khyad par gyi le'us bzhi shes/ de bzhin nyid kyi le'us rnam kun/ bslab pa yongs su dag pa'i le'us rtse sbyor/ rim gyis 'jug pa'i le'us mthar gyis pa/ bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'us skad cig ma/ bslab pa 'bras bu'i le'us chos sku rnams bstan no// gnyis pa 'chad byed don bdun cu bshad pa la/ mkhyen gsum mtshon byed kyi sgo nas bshad/ sbyor bzhi ngo bo'i sgo nas bshad/ chos sku dbye ba'i sgo nas bshad pa'o// dang po mkhyen gsum mtshon byed kyi sgo nas bshad pa la gsum las/

dang po rnam mkhyen ni/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang*// nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang*// sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*// dmigs pa dag dang ched dang ni// go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang*// tshogs ni nges par 'byung bcas rnams// thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid// ces pas bstan/ rdzogs byang gi sa bon du gyur pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ de smin cing dag par byed pa'i rkyen theg chen gyi gdams ngag dang*/ de nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu'i thog mar nges par 'byed pa mthong lam gyi yan lag ste rgyur gyur pa'i sbyor lam rnam bzhi dang*/ de thob pa na theg chen (14ba)du rigs nges pas sgrub pa'i ni rten du gyur pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can gyi rigs dang*/ sgrub pa de'i dmigs pa dag dang*/ sgrub pa de'i ched du bya ba dang ni/ de nas sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la dbye na/ mi mthun phyogs kyis mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir go cha bgos pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ go bgos nas theg chen gyi g.yul du 'jug pa'i bya ba sgrub pa dang*/ g.yul du zhugs nas dpung gi tshogs dag sog pa'i sgrub pa dang ni/ de nas dgra las rgyal ba nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa dang bcas pa de ltar bcu po rnams kyis thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid ni yul gyi yul can nam rgyus 'bras bu mtshon pa'i sgo nas bstan no// gnyis pa lam shes ni/ mog mog por byed la sogs dang*// slob ma bse ru'i lam gang dang*// 'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyis// phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam// byed pa dang ni mos pa dang*// bstod dang bkur dang bsngags pa dang*// bsngo dang rjes su yi rang ba// yid la byed pa bla med dag / sgrub dang shin tu dag pa zhes// bya ba 'di ni sgom pa'i lam// byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi// lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad//

ces pas bstan/ lam shes skye ba'i rten du bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis lha rnams kyi 'od mog mog por byed pa dang la sogs pas yul nges pa dang khyab pa dang rang bzhin dang byed las rnams bsdus so// shes bya'i lam la ni/ slob ma nyan thos kyi lam dang*/ bse ru lta bu la sogs pa'i rang rgyal gyi lam gang dang*/ theg chen gyi lam la dbye na/ tshe 'di dang gzhan pa phyi ma'i yon tan can gyi phan yon che ba dang ldan pa'i mthong ba'i lam dang*/ sgom lam gyi byed pa ste phan yon dang ni/ byed pa can gyi sgom lam la/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i rjes thob dang*/ zag med mnyam bzhag gnyis yod pa'i dang po la dbye na/ yum la yon tan can du 'dzin pa'i mos pa dang*/ de dag gi 'bras bu bstod pa dang bkur ba dang bsngags pa gsum dang*/ dge ba mi zad par byed pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ 'phel bar byed pa'i (15na)rjes su yi rang ba'i yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang gsum mo// gnyis pa zag med la/ rtogs pa phun tshogs sgrub pa sgom lam dang*/ spangs pa phun tshogs shin tu dag pa zhes bya ba 'di ni sgom pa'i lam ste gnyis so// de ltar bcu gcig po de dag gi byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa rnams kyi lam shes nyid ni yul gyis yul can mtshon pa'i sgo nas de 'drar bstan no// gsum pa gzhi shes ni/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang*// thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang*// thabs kyis ring ba ma yin nyid// mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag dang*// sbyor dang de yi mnyam nyid dang*// nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam// de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod// ces pas bstan/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du shes pas srid pa la mi gnas shing*/ sems can la snying rje bas dman pa zhi ba la mi gnas pa dang*/ shes sgrib spong ba'i thabs la mkhas pa ma yin pas 'bras yum la ring ba dang*/ de spong ba'i thabs kyi lam la mkhas pas 'bras yum la ring ba ma yin pa nyid dang*/

mi mthun phyogs mtshan 'dzin gyi 'du shes dang bcas pa nyan rang gi dang*/ 'du shes de dang bral ba gnyen po'i phyogs byang sems kyi gzhi shes dag dang*/ gnyen po'i gzhi shes la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ de'i yul yul can mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa dang*/ sbyor ba de'i 'bras bu nyan thos dang*/ la sogs pas byang sems kyi mthong ba'i lam shugs dang dngos la bstan pa ste/ de ltar dgu po de 'dra bas ni kun shes nyid yul can gyi yul dang*/ rgyus 'bras bu mtshon pa'i sgo nas bstan pa nyid du 'dod do// gnyis pa sbyor bzhi ngo bo'i sgo nas bstan pa la bzhi las/ dang po rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ni/ rnam pa sbyor bar bcas rnams dang*// yon tan skyon ni mtshan nyid bcas// thar dang nges 'byed cha mthun dang*// slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid dang*// zhing dag bla na med pa ni// rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa ste// 'di ni thabs mkhas bcas pa yin// zhes pas bstan/ gang bsgom par bya ba don shes kyi rnam pa dang*/ ji ltar sgom par bya ba sbyor ba dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i yon tan dang*/ (15ba)de la bar du gcod pa'i skyon dang ni/ sbyor ba de rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang bcas pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i 'bras bu thar pa cha mthun tshogs lam dang*/ de yongs su smin pa nges 'byed cha mthun dang*/ sbyor ba sgom pa po'i gang zag slob pa phyir mi bzlog pa'i tshogs dang*/ srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ rang gi zhing dag yon tan bla na med par bsgyur ba dang ni/ gzhan yongs su smin par byed pa 'di ni thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba dang bcas pa ste bcu gcig po 'di rnams kyis ni rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba bstan pa yin no//

gnyis pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba ni/ de yi rtags dang rnam 'phel dang*// brtan dang sems kun gnas pa dang*// mthong zhes bya dang sgom pa zhes// bya ba'i lam ni so so la// rnam par rtog pa rnam bzhi yi// gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang ni// bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin// log par sgrub dang bcas pa ni// rtse mo'i mngon rtogs// zhes pas bstan/ bsdus bsgoms rab tu gyur pa de'i rtags drod dang*/ bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba rtse mo dang*/ mkhyen gsum dang sems can gyi don mi gtong ba la brtan pa'i bzod pa dang*/ sems dmigs pa la kun tu gnas pa'i chos mchog dang*/ mthong zhes bya ba dang sgom pa zhes bya ba'i lam ni so so'i gnas skabs la gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa re re la gnyis gnyis su phye bas rnam pa bzhi'i gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ sangs rgyas pa la lam gzhan gyi bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bar chad med lam gyi spang bya bden gnyis 'gal bar rtsod pa'i log par sgrub pa dang bcas pa'i ni chos brgyad po de dag gi rtse mo'i mngon rtogs bstan pa yin no// gsum pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba ni/ mthar gyis pa// rnam gsum rnam bcu// zhes pas bstan/ bsam pa phun tshogs rjes dran drug dang*/ sbyor ba phun tshogs phar phyin drug dang*/ dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi sbyor ba ste rnam pa gsum dang rnam pa bcu po de dag gis mthar (16na)gyis pa'i sbyor ba bstan no// bzhi pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ni/ skad cig ma// gcig gis mngon rdzogs byang chub pa// mtshan nyid kyis ni rnam pa bzhi// zhes pas bstan/ bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa de yin la/ dngos po tha dad du dbye ba med kyang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis ni rnam pa bzhi yod do// gsum pa chos sku dbye ba'i sgo nas 'chad pa ni/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang*// de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni//

chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa// rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod// ces pas bstan/ gdod ma nas dri ma dang bral ba'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang*/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang bcas pa dang*/ de bzhin du 'khor ba ji srid par rgyun mi 'chad cing nges pa lnga ldan las gzhan pa'i sprul pa'i sku dang ni/ ye shes chos sku bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i mdzad pa dang bcas pa phrin las te/ de ltar rnam pa bzhir ni chos sku'i dbye ba yang dag par brjod pa yin no// gnyis pa yan lag rgyas bshad la/ yul mkhyen gsum/ thabs sbyor bzhi/ 'bras bu chos sku'o// dang po la/ thob bya rnam mkhyen/ thob byed lam shes/ de'i rtsa ba gol sa dang bcas pa gzhi shes so// dang po la/ bsam pa sems bskyed/ sbyor ba sgrub pa gnyis/ dang po la/ spyi don dang*/ gzhung don gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ mtshan gzhi'o// dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs byang la dmigs pa'i sems te/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sems byung ba// zhes pas so// gnyis pa mtshon bya ni/ shes bya thams cad khong du chub pas na byang chub de'i rgyur tshogs bsags pas na sems de rgyu tshad med pa las byung bas na bskyed pa zhes bya'o// gsum pa mtshan gzhi la/ don dam sems bskyed dang*/ kun rdzob sems bskyed gnyis kyi dang po la/ ngo bo/(16ba)dbye ba/ sa mtshams/ thob tshul lo// dang po ngo bo ni/ don dam chos dbyings kyi byang chub la dmigs shing zag med yid shes kyi ngo bor skyes pa de'o// gnyis pa dbye ba ni/ lhag bsam dag pa dang*/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed do// gsum pa sa mtshams ni/ snga ma sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar dang*/ gnyis pa dag pa sa gsum/ gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi sar bzhag go / bzhi pa thob tshul la/ rgyu ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes bya// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags// chos la mi rtog ye shes ni// skyes phyir de ni dam par 'dod// ces gsungs pas/

dam pa gsum dang*/ rkyen ni sgom stobs kyi thob pa yin no// gnyis pa kun rdzob sems bskyed la'ang bzhi las/ dang po ngo bo ni/ kun rdzob chos can gyi byang chub la dmigs pa'i sems byung yin la/ de yang smon pa ni 'dod pa dang*/ 'jug pa ni sems pa yin no// gnyis pa dbye ba ni/ gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas smon 'jug gnyis las/ dang po ni/ byang sems kyi bslab bya slob par smon pa tsam dang*/ phyi ma ni khas blangs shing zhugs pa yin no// de la thogs med sku mched kyis ni sems bskyed pa dang de'i sdom pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad nas thog mar sems bskyed la phyis sdom pa cho gas len pa de gnyis gzhi mthun mi srid par bzhed do// smon 'jug gi tha snyad 'di ni zhi ba lhas bzhed cing*/ de'i lugs la yang smon sems ni cho ga la mi ltos la/ 'jug pa ni nges par ltos dgos par bzhed do// (17na)'on kyang smon 'jug so sor ma phye bar cho gas len pa zhig kyang 'byung ngo*// gsum pa sa mtshams ni/ smon sems ni sbyor lam yan chad la mi 'gro la/ 'jug sems ni mngon gyur dang bag nyal gyi sgo nas byang sems thams cad la yod do// bzhi pa thob tshul la/ rgyu ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs// thos stobs dge ba goms pa las// zhes dang*/ rkyen ni/ gzhan gyis bstan pa'i sems bskyed bshad// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ mtshan nyid/ dmigs yul/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces pas bstan/ sems bskyed ni 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi rgyu yin pas thog mar 'chad la/ de las kyang dang por byung ba'i dbang du byas nas smon pa sems bskyed pa nyid gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ sems bskyed pa ni sems can gzhan gyi don gyi phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'am 'dun pa'am smon pa'o// mdo ni/

byang sems ci nas bdag bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub par bya'o zhes de ltar don du gnyer bar byed pa yin no zhes/ 'di ltar sems byung la sems bskyed pa'i sgra mi 'jug go zhe na/ de ni sgra yangs pa'i dbang du byas pas skyon med do// gnyis pa dmigs yul ni/ de dang de ni mdo bzhin du// bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod// ces pas bstan/ 'o na sems bskyed de'i yul du gyur pa'i rdzogs byang ni gang*/ gzhan don ni gang zhe na/ lan ni/ thob bya rdzogs byang de dang las su bya ba gzhan don de ni blo gros mi zad pa dang sdong po bkod pa'i mdo sogs dang mthun par rgyas (17ba)'bring bsdus pa las gsungs pa bzhin du bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod de/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang sems chen po chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas sher phyin la brtson par bya'o// zhes bsdus pa dang*/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang sems chen po mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis yum la gnas te sbyin par bya ba dang sbyin pa po dang len pa po mi dmigs pa'i phyir yongs su gtong ba med pa'i tshul gyis sbyin pa'i phar phyin yongs su grub par bya'o// zhes pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan rnams la yang sbyar te rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas shes par bya ba'i byang chub bstan pa dang*/ sems can gang zhig yod pa de dag thams cad phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pas sher phyin 'di nyid sgrub par bya'o// zhes bsdus pa dang*/ sems can ser sna can rnams ni sbyin pa la 'god pa nas shes rab 'chal ba rnams ni shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la 'god par 'dod pa'i byang sems kyi yum la bslab par bya'o// zhes rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas las su bya ba gzhan don bstan to// gzhung tshig gnyis po 'di'i de dang zhes pas rang nyid lam la 'jug pa dang*/

de ni zhes pas gzhan lam la gzhug pa'i 'jug pa sems bskyed bstan par rtogs so// gsum pa dbye ba ni/ de yang sa gser zla ba me// gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho// rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang*// yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu// rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che// bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni// sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis// rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// zhes pas bstan/ de ltar sems bskyed pa de la du zhig yod ce na/ 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi dbang du byas nas mdo gzhan gyi rjes su 'brangs te dpe nyer gnyis dang*/ yum gyi dngos bstan gyi grogs nyer gnyis dang*/ slob dpon (18na)gyis mdzad pa'i chos mthun nyer gnyis rnams sbyar te bshad pa ni/ de yang grogs 'dun pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni dpe sa lta bu yin te/ chos mthun chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhi yin pas so// de bzhin du sbyar te/ bsam pa dang ldan pa ni gser dang 'dra ste byang chub kyi bar du mi 'gyur bas so// lhag bsam dang ldan pa ni zla ba tshes pa lta bu yin te dge ba'i chos 'phel bar 'gyur bas so// sbyor ba dang ldan pa ni me lta bu yin te nyon mongs pa'i bud shing bsreg pas so// sbyin pa dang ldan pa ni gter dang 'dra ste sems can thams cad tshim par byed pas so// tshul khrims dang ldan pa ni rin po che'i 'byung gnas dang 'dra ste yon tan thams cad 'byung bas so// bzod pa dang ldan pa ni rgya mtsho lta bu yin te gting mi 'khrug pas so// brtson 'grus dang ldan pa ni rdo rje lta bu yin te bdud las kyis mi 'byed pas so// bsam gtan dang ldan pa ni ri bo lta bu yin te rnam g.yeng gis mi bskyod pas so// shes rab dang ldan pa ni sman lta bu yin te sgrib gnyis kyi nad zhi bar byed pas so// bsngo ba'i thabs mkhas dang ldan pa ni bshes gnyen dang 'dra ste sems can gyi don mi gtong bas so// smon lam chen po bcu sogs dang ldan pa ni yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yin te smon pa 'grub pas so// stobs dang ldan pa ni nyi ma lta bu yin te gdul bya'i lo thog smin par byed pas so// ye shes dang ldan pa ni dri za'i glu lta bu yin te gdul bya 'dun pa'i chos ston pas so// mngon shes dang ldan pa ni rgyal po lta bu yin te mthu thogs pa med pas gzhan don bsgrubs pas so// tshogs gnyis dang ldan pa ni bang mdzod dang 'dra ste bsod nams dang ye shes kyi gnas yin pas so// byang (18ba)phyogs so bdun dang ldan pa ni lam po che lta bu yin te 'phags pa rnams gshegs pas so// snying rje lhag mthong dang ldan pa ni bzhon pa lta bu yin te srid zhi gang du yang mi gnas par 'gro bas so// gzungs spobs dang ldan pa ni bkod ma'i chu dang ni 'dra ste chos 'dzin cing mi bzad pas so// chos kyi dga' ston dang ldan pa ni sgra snyan lta bu yin te thar pa 'dod pa la snyan par sgrogs pas so// bgrod pa gcig po'i lam dang ldan pa ni chu bo lta bu yin te gzhan don rgyun mi 'chad pas so// chos sku dang ldan pa ni 'byor pa 'byung ba'i rgyu sprin lta bu yin te sprul pa'i sku'i spyod lam rnams kyi 'byung bas so// de ltar rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so//

bzhi pa sa mtshams ni/ sems bskyed dang po gsum ni tshogs lam/ de 'og gcig ni sbyor lam/ de 'og bcu ni sa bcu/ de 'og lnga ni dag pa'i khyad par gyi lam/ de 'og gsum ni sbyor dngos mjug gi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus so// gnyis pa sbyor ba sgrub pa la/ sgrub pa'i thabs ston pa gdams ngag /de sgrub pa'i 'bras bu nges 'byed yan lag /sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo bshad pa'o// dang po la/ gdams ngag bcu spyir bstan/ dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la/ bsdus te gzhung dang sbyar/ so sor phye ste bshad pa gnyis kyi/ dang po bsdus te gzhung dang sbyar ba ni/ sgrub dang bden pa rnams dang ni// sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog gsum// ma zhen yongs su mi ngal dang*// lam ni yongs su 'dzin pa dang*// spyan lnga dang ni mngon shes kyi// yon tan drug dang mthong lam dang*// sgom zhes bya la gdams ngag ni// bcu yi bdag nyid shes par bya// zhes pas bstan/ sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i gang zag des yon tan ma thob pa thob byed kyi gdams ngag don du gnyer ba 'byung la/ de yang gdams ngag phal pa ni nyan rang dang (19na)chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin ma thob pa rnams kyis gdams pa las thob mod/ khyad par can ni theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam la gnas shing chos kyi tshig don mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i skyes bu de la/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skus mngon sum du rnam 'byor 'di dang 'di dag nyams su longs shig ces gdams par mdzad pa yin no// de lta bu gdams ngag la dbye na/ kun rdzob snang tsam pa de nyid rang bzhin med pa nyid du rtogs shig /ces sgrub bya'i gtso bo dang*/ chos kyi bdag med pa'i rnam pa can gyi yul bden pa bzhi po rnams dang ni/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dkon mchog gsum la mngon zhen med par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i dkon mchog gsum la dang*/

rang gi bde ba la ma zhen par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus la dang*/ gnyen po'i stobs bsgrub par bya ba'i yongs su mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus la dang*/ lam gzhan du mi 'gro bar bya ba'i rang gi lam ni yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus la dang*/ gzhan dring mi 'jog par bya ba'i spyan lnga dang ni/ gzhan don bya ba'i mngon shes kyi yon tan drug la dang*/ rdzogs byang gi skal mnyam gyi rgyu mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam zhes bya ba la 'doms pa ste de ltar gdams ngag ni bcu'i bdag nyid du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la/ sgrub pa'i dmigs yul bden pa la 'doms pa/ sgrub pa'i rten dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa/ sgrub pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu la 'doms pa'o// dang po la/ gtso bo bden gnyis/ dman pa bden (19ba)bzhi'o// dang po gtso bo bden gnyis ni/ byang sems kyi sgrub pa de shes rab kyi khyad par du 'phags pa bden gnyis las mi 'da' ba dang*/ thabs kyi khyad par du 'phags pa snying rje dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis zin pa yin la/ de yang kun rdzob las mi 'da' bar rjes thob tu bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog cing*/ don dam las mi 'da' bar mnyam bzhag tu ye shes kyi tshogs bsog pa yin no// des na bden pa gnyis la mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum/ dang po la/ don dam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rang bzhin gyi spros pa dang bral bar gnas pa ste/ zla ba snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ rang bzhin med cing spros med pa// de nyid don dam spyod yul lo// zhes gsungs so// kun rdzob kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rten 'brel sna tshogs su snang ba ste/ bden gnyis las/ ji ltar snang ba 'di kho na// kun rdzob/ ces gsungs so// gnyis pa mtshon bya ni/ bslu bar yod pas na kun rdzob bden pa/ nges pa'i don du yod pas na don dam bden pa zhes bya'o//

gsum pa mtshan gzhi la gnyis las dang po ni/ ma rig pas bslad pa'i shes pa dang der snang gi cha thams cad yin la/ dbye na/ zla ba gnyis 'dzin lta bu log pa'i kun rdzob dang*/ bum pa dang ka ba 'dzin pa lta bu yang dag kun rdzob gnyis so// gnyis pa ni/ 'khrul bral mi rtog pa'i shes pa dang de'i yul thams cad de/ dbye na/ spros bral phyogs re rtogs pa rnam grangs pa'i don dam dang*/ spros pa ma lus pa dang bral bar rtogs pa rnam grangs pa ma yin pa'i don dam gnyis su yod do// (20na)mdo ni/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ji ltar bslab par bya/ zhes dris pa'i lan du/ shā ri'i bu/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' yod bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chen po yang dag par rjes su mi mthong zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam mo// zhes bya ba'i bar gyis shes rab khyad par du 'phags pa bstan/ yang shā ri'i bu/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpas shes rab nyin gcig bsgoms pa gang yin pa des ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi shes rab zil gyis gnon par byed do// zhes pa nas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi shes rab ni de lta ma yin no// zhes pa'i bar gyis thabs khyad par du 'phags pa bstan to// gnyis pa dman pa bden bzhi la 'doms pa ni/ nyan thos kyis ni bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug tu mngon par zhen cing chags pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa yin la/ 'dir ni zhen pa de dang bral ba'i sgo nas stong pa nyid dang mtshungs ldan du nyams su longs zhes 'doms pa yin no// 'dir bden bzhi'i mtha' dpyad pa la/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras/ rnam byang rgyu 'bras gnyis/ dang po la/ shes bya 'bras bu/

spang bya rgyu gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi'i dang po ni/ gzhan la mi ltos par 'jig pas mi rtag pa/ gnod pa'i ngo bor gyur pas sdug bsngal ba/ rang bzhin med pas (20ba)na stong pa/ 'dzin pa dang bral bas bdag med pa ste rnam pa bzhi'o// de dag gi stong bdag med gnyis ni shes bya thams cad dang*/ mi rtag pa ni 'dus byas thams cad dang*/ sdug bsngal ni zag bcas thams cad la rjes su 'gro'o// gnyis pa ni/ las nyon gyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu sems can dang*/ de'i bdag 'bras snod kyi 'jig rten gnyis so// des na 'dir skye ba po sems can/ gang du skye ba'i snod/ de dag 'jal byed bshad pa'o// dang po la/ dbye ba/ skye ba gnas pa/ 'chi 'pho ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro// mi/ lha ste 'gro ba lnga dang*/ bar srid rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ sems can de dag skye ba'i tshul ni/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis yin zhing gnas pa dang 'tsho ba'i rgyu ni zas yin la/ de la ni 'dod khams nyid la yod cing dri ro reg bya'i ngo bor gyur pa'i khams kyi zas dang*/ khams gsum char na yod pa'i reg pa'i zas yul dbang rnam shes 'dus pa las byung ba dang*/ sems pa'i zas yid kyi las dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i zas te thams cad zag bcas kho na yin no// bzhi po de las snga ma gnyis kyis tshe 'di'i lus sems gso bar byed/ phyi ma gnyis kyis yang srid 'phen 'grub byed do// sems can rnams 'chi 'pho ba'i tshul ni/ rten srog gi dbang po 'gag pas brten pa yid shes nyid 'pho ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rten dkyil 'khor gsum/ lhun po ri bdun/ khor yug gi ri/ gling bcu gnyis/ nyi zla skar ma 'dod lha'i gnas drug /gzugs khams kyi gnas bcu bdun (21na)rnams so// gsum pa la yul dus gnyis las dang po ni/ phra rab kyi rdul dang rdul phran dang lcags rdul chu rdul ri bong gi rdul lug rdul glang rdul nyi zer rdul sro ma shig nas sor tshigs rnams gong nas gong du bdun 'gyur/

de nyi shu bzhi la khru/ de bzhi la 'dom gang*/ de lnga brgya la rgyang grags/ de brgyad la dpag tshad do// gnyis pa ni/ se gol myur ba gcig la drug cu rtsa bzhir phye ba'i cha gcig la dus mtha'i skad cig /de brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig /de drug cu la thang gcig dang yud tsam nyin zhag zla ba rnams ni gong nas gong du sum cu 'gyur/ de zhag mi thub dang bcas pa bcu gnyis la lo gcig yin no// gnyis pa spang bya rgyu la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ srid pa len par byed pas rgyu/ sdug bsngal ma lus 'byung bas kun 'byung*/ 'bras bu drag tu bskyed pas rab bskyed/ sdug bsngal snga ma 'dor zhing phyi ma 'dren pas rkyen te rnam pa bzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ sdug bden gyi rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa de'o// rgyur 'gyur tshul ni/ 'phen byed kyis rnam smin dang 'grub byed kyi skal mnyam gyi rgyur 'gyur/ las nyon gnyis ka snod kyi byed rgyur 'gyur ro// 'dir nyon mongs dang las kyi mtha' dpyad pa'i dang po la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ rgyas par 'gyur tshul lo// dang po ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sa bon ma spangs pa/ gang la dmigs nas skye ba'i yul nye bar gnas (21ba)pa/ de la dmigs pa'i tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid byed de gsum yin no// gnyis pa ni/ sems byung gang zhig de byung ba na sems kyi rgyud rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa'o// gsum pa la ngo bo dang*/ spong tshul dang*/ ming gi sgo nas phye ba'o// dang po la/ rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ nyon mongs can nye nyon gnyis yod pa'i snga ma la ni/ 'dod chags/ khong 'khro// nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ the tshom/ lta ba dang drug /lta ba la dbye na/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba/ mthar 'dzin lta ba/ log lta/ lta ba mchog 'dzin/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin te lngar phye bas bcu'o// gnyis pa la/ grub mtha'i blo bsgyur ba las byung ba nyon mongs pa kun brtags kyi cha mthong spangs dang*/

de la ma ltos pa lhan skyes kyi cha sgom spang yin pa gnyis las dang po la/ theg dman ltar na/ 'dod khams nas sdug bsngal mthong spangs la bcu/ kun 'byung dang 'gog pa mthong spangs gnyis la lta ba dang po gnyis phyi ma gcig ma gtogs pa bdun bdun/ lam mthong spangs la lta ba dang po gnyis ma gtogs pa'i brgyad yin la/ theg chen ltar na/ 'dod pa khams su bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs bcu bcu/ khams gong mar khong khro ma gtogs dgu dgu yin no// sgom spangs la theg dman ltar na/ 'dod par 'dod chags (22na)khong khro nga rgyal ma rig pa bzhi/ khams gong na khong khro ma gtogs pa'o// theg chen ltar na/ snga ma rnams kyi steng du 'jig mthar gnyis bsnan pa de'o// lugs gnyis gang yin na'ang sgom spangs la/ sa dgu na nyon mongs pa re re la chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum de re re la chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum du phye bas dgu dgu ru yod do// khams gong na khong khro med pa'i rgyu mtshan ni kun nas mnar sems pa'i rgyu dgu dang bral bas yin no// gsum pa la/ kun sbyor/ 'ching ba/ bag la nyal/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa/ kun dkris/ chu bo// sbyor ba/ nye bar len pa/ mdud pa/ sgrib pa/ tha ba/ dri ma/ sdig pa/ zug rngu/ ci yang*/ nyes spyod/ zag pa/ 'phongs pa/ yongs gdung*/ 'khrug pa/ 'thab mo/ rims nad/ nags sbyor/ gegs te nyi shu bzhi'o// bzhi pa la dmigs pa'i sgo nas dang*/ mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas rgyas 'gyur gnyis/ dang po ni/ sdug kun mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i lta ba rnams dang*/ the tshom ma rig pa ste kun 'gro rnams ni khams gsum gyi spang bya rigs lnga la dmigs nas rgyas par 'gyur la/ de las gzhan pa'i nyon mongs rnams ni rang rang gi rigs la dmigs nas rgyas par 'gyur ro// 'on kyang zag med dang khams gong ma la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams ni rgyas par mi 'gyur te (22ba)dmigs pa de sred pa dang bdag ltas bdag gir ma byas pa'i phyir ro// theg dman ltar na nyon mongs kyi zag med dngos la dmigs par 'dod la/

theg chen ltar na dngos la dmigs mi nus so// gnyis pa ni/ nyon mongs gang zhig chos gang dang mtshungs par ldan pa de ni ma spangs kyi bar du de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas rgyas par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa las kyi kun 'byung la/ theg chen pas ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes la las kyi sa bon gnas par 'dod/ bye mdo gnyis las kyi rten yid shes su 'dod par mtshungs la/ bye smras las kyi rgyun thob pa'i rdzas kyi ldan pa dang*/ mdo sde pas chud mi 'dza' ba'i rdzas kyi ldan par 'dod do// de lta'i las la dbye na/ bsam pa yid kyi las dang*/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi las gnyis so// kun slong la ni bya ba de dang por 'phen byed kyi rgyu'i kun slong dang*/ bya ba de dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa dus kyi kun slong gnyis yin zhing*/ rgyu'i kun slong dge ba las dus kyi kun slong mi dge ba 'byung ba sogs kyang yod do// rnam smin gyi sgo nas dbye na/ nges pa'i las/ ma nges pa'i las gnyis/ snga ma la mthong chos myong 'gyur/ skye gnas myong 'gyur/ lan grangs gzhan du myong 'gyur dang gsum du phye/ de yang mthong chos myong 'gyur gyi rnam smin rdzogs par byed pa kho na yin la/ phyi ma gnyis kyis ni rnam smin 'phen par yang byed do// 'phen byed ni skya ris dang rdzogs byed ni mtshon bkye (23na)ba lta bu yin no// yang las dkar la rnam smin dkar ba khams gong ma'i dge ba 'bras bu sa gzhan du mi g.yo ba dang*/ gnag la rnam smin gnag pa mi dge ba bsod nams ma yin pa dang*/ dkar nag tu gyur la rnam smin yang 'dres pa 'dod pa'i dge ba bsod nams kyi las dang*/ mi gnag cing mi dkar la rnam smin gnag pa mi 'byung ba zag med kyi las rnams su phye'o// zag med kyi las 'di ni kun 'byung du mi bzhag la/ kun 'byung yin na mi dge ba dang dge ba zag bcas gang rung yin cing*/

sdug bden yin na ma sgribs lung ma bstan yin dgos so// gnyis pa rnam byang rgyu 'bras la/ thob bya 'bras bu/ bsten bya rgyu gnyis so// dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi'i dang po ni/ nyon mongs spangs pas 'gog pa/ sdug bsngal bral bas zhi ba/ de las lhag pa'i 'dod bya med pas gya nom/ spangs pa slar mi zlog pas nges par 'byung ba dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ dgag gzhi de bzhin nyid kyi steng du 'gog byed bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi dgag bya glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa la byed/ de ni bral ba'i 'bras bu yin pas rgyu mtshan nyid pa med do// de la dbye na/ brda'i 'gog pa/ (23ba)don dam pa'i 'gog pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ lam zag bcas kyis spang bya'i sa bon nyams smad pa la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ lam zag med kyis spang bya'i sa bon drungs phyung pa la byed cing*/ de la yang yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ ma rdzogs pa dang*/ khyad par du 'phags pa dang gsum du yod do// gnyis pa bsten bya lam la/ mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi gnyis kyi dang po ni/ thar pa'i grong khyer du bgrod par byed pas lam/ sems phyin ci ma log par sgrub pas bsgrub pa/ sgrib pa'i gnyen po byed pas rigs pa/ rtag pa dam pa'i gnas su 'byin pas nges 'byin te bzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab 'khor bcas so// de lta'i bden bzhi'i go rim ni mngon par rtogs pa ji ltar skye ba'i tshul dang mthun par bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa sgrub pa'i rten dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa'i gdam ngag la/ dkon mchog gi ngo bo/ skyabs gnas su 'jog tshul lo// dang po dkon mchog gi ngo bo la/ sangs rgyas ni don dam par yon tan brgyad ldan gyi chos sku ste/ rang bzhin rnam dag 'dus ma byas pa/ glo bur rnam dag lhun gyis grub pa/ sangs rgyas nang phan tshun ma gtogs pa gzhan gyis mi rtogs pa ste rang don gyi yon tan dang*/

shes bya ji lta ba mkhyen pa dang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la thugs brtse ba dang*/ de gnyis kyi sems can gyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa 'joms pa ni nus pa ste gzhan don gyi yon tan rnams so// chos ni don dam par yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i ye shes te/ spros pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral bas bsam du med pa dang*/ gzung (24na)ba dang 'dzin pa gnyis su med pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa med pa ste/ gang zhig chags pa dang bral ba 'gog bden gyi yon tan dang*/ gzod ma nas zhi ba'i dag pa dang*/ gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa gsal ba dang*/ spang bya'i sa bon drungs 'byin par byed pas gnyen po ste gang gis chags pa dang bral bar byed pa'i lam bden gyi yon tan no// dge 'dun ni yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i skyes bu ste sems rang bzhin 'od gsal ji lta bar rig pa dang*/ de sems can thams cad la khyab par mthong ba ji snyed pa rig pa dang*/ de bde bar gshegs pa'i snying por mthong ba nang rig pa ste rig pa'i yon tan dang*/ ye shes de'i dang po chags pa'i dri ma las grol ba dang*/ gnyis pa thogs pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba dang*/ des na lus can kun gyi skyabs gnas su gyur pas dman pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba ste grol ba'i yon tan no// theg dman gyis sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun ni lam bden dang*/ chos ni lhag med kyi myang 'das la 'dod do// gnyis pa skyabs gnas su 'jog tshul ni/ mthar thug sangs rgyas nyid skyabs gnas su 'jog la/ gnas skabs su ni gsum char skyabs gnas su 'jog ste/ rgyud bla las/ ston pa'i bstan pa bslab don dang*// theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la// mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas// skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa sgrub pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu la 'doms pa la/ sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i brtson (24ba)'grus ni go sla bar zad do//

sgrub pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa spyan lnga la 'doms pa ni/ sha'i spyan/ lha'i spyan/ shes rab kyi spyan/ chos kyi spyan/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan no// de dag gis rim par dpag tshad brgya stong tshun gyi dngos po dang*/ sems can thams cad gyi 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba'i tshul dang*/ chos nyid kyi don ji lta ba dang*/ rang dang spangs rtogs mnyam pa'i rgyud tshod dang*/ chos thams cad mngon par byang chub par mthong ngo*// dang po gnyis ni/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba yin la/ de dag gi rgyu ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug yin no// sa mtshams ni/ dang po gnyis tshogs sbyor na'ang yod/ bar pa gnyis sa bcu'i mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob na'ang yod/ mtha' ma gcig ni sangs rgyas kyi sa nyid na yod do// gzhan don sgrub pa'i rgyu mngon shes drug la 'doms pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul dang*/ lha'i rna ba dang*/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang*/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ mngon par 'du byed dang bcas pa lha'i mig dang*/ zag pa zad pa shes pa'i mngon shes dang drug go de las dang po ni/ lus rnam par dag pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni ngag rnam par dag pa dang*/ phyi ma bzhi sems rnam par dag pa yin no// sa mtshams ni/ dang po lnga so skye dang mthun mong ba yin la/ phyi ma ni 'phags pa'i sa thob nas 'byung ngo*// sgrub pa mthar thug pa'i rgyu mthong lam dang sgom lam la 'doms pa ni 'og nas 'chad do// mdor na gdams ngag de dag thams cad yul yul can gnyis su med pa'i sgo nas chos nyid las mi 'da' bar 'doms pa (25na)yin no// mdo ni/ gzugs stong pa nyid la brtson na zhes sogs dang*/ gzugs skye ba zhes sogs dang*/ shā ri'i bu stong pa nyid ni mi skye mi 'gag ces sogs dang*/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang sbyin pa'i phar phyin la brtson zhes sogs kyi go rim bzhin du bden pa bzhi la 'doms pa dang*/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos yum la spyod pa'i tshe gzugs la zhes sogs dang*/

gzugs dngos por zhes sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di gang nas 'dir skyes pa lags/ zhes sogs kyi go rim bzhin du dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lus dang zhes sogs kyis brtson 'grus la 'doms pa dang*/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig ces sogs kyis spyan lnga la dang*/ shā ri'i bu yum la spyod pas pha rol tu phyin pa thob ces sogs kyis mngon shes drug la 'doms pa dang*/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yum las brtsams zhes sogs kyis mthong lam dang*/ rab 'byor 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings med par zhes sogs kyi sgom lam la 'doms pa yin no//

gnyis pa dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa la/ mtshon byed dpe'i dge 'dun/ mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun no// dang po la/ thob byed gang zag /thob bya 'bras bu'o// dang po la/ chags bral sngon song*/ spang bya cig car ba/ 'bras bu rim gyis pa'o// dang po chags bral sngon song la ni/ phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong gnyis kho na yin te/ de gnyis kyi spang bya'i gtso bo mthong lam gyi snga rol tu 'jig rten pa'i (25ba)sgom lam gyis spong ba yod pas so// rgyun zhugs dang dgra bcom pa gnyis la chags bral sngon song med de/ mthong lam gyi snga rol tu mthong spangs kun sbyor gsum dang*/ srid rtse'i nyon mongs spong mi nus pas so// des na phyir 'ong chags bral sngon song la zhugs gnas gnyis/ dang po ni/ mthong lam kyi snga rol tu 'dod pa'i sgom spangs nyon mongs drug pa nas/ brgyad pa'i bar ci rigs par spangs shing da lta mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga po gang rung la gnas pa de'o// 'bras gnas ni/ gang zag des bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa'i tshe'o// de'i tshe mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga po la gnas pa'i gang zag dbang rtul la dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang*/ dbang rnon la chos kyi rjes 'brang zhes bya zhing*/ bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa'i tshe gang zag de gnyis la dad mos dang mthong thob ces bya'o// de ni 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro// gnyis pa chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong la zhugs gnas gnyis las dang po ni/ mthong lam gyi snga rol tu 'dod nyon dgu pa nas ci yang med pa'i bar ci rigs pa la chags pa dang bral zhing da lta mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga po gang rung la gnas pa de'o// gnyis pa ni/ bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa'i tshe'o// gnyis pa spang bya cig car ba ni/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i gang zag gis bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs zag med la brten nas 'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang po nas/

dgu pa spong ba'i tshe sa gong ma rnams la yang de ltar du 'gyur la/ dgu pa spangs pa'i rnam grol lam thob pa na dgra bcom 'bras gnas su 'gyur ba yin no// (26na)de la 'bras bu bar pa gnyis ni mi 'byung ste/ de gnyis 'dod nyon gyi spangs pa kho na las bzhag pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa 'bras bu rim gyis pa la/ rgyun zhugs zhugs gnas/ phyir 'ong zhugs gnas/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs gnas/ dgra bcom zhugs gnas dang bzhi'o// dang po rgyun zhugs la zhugs pa ni/ mthong lam gyi snga rol tu sgom spangs cung zad kyang ma spangs pa'am/ lam zag bcas kyi 'dod nyon lnga pa man chad spangs na yang rung*/ mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga po gang rung la gnas pa'o// 'bras gnas ni/ des tshe de la bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa ste/ de la yang*/ sgom spangs cung zad kyang ma spangs pa 'dod par skye ba bdun len pa dang*/ lam zag med kyi 'dod pa'i sgom spangs gsum pa dang bzhi pa spangs pas 'dod par rigs mthun gyi skye ba gnyis sam gsum len pa ste gnyis yod do// gnyis pa phyir 'ong la zhugs pa ni/ mthong lam la zhugs pa ni mthong lam thob rjes su 'dod pa'i sgom spangs lnga pa spangs shing drug pa spong ba la brtson pa'o// 'bras gnas la/ drug pa spangs pa'i rnam grol lam la gnas pa tsam po ba dang*/ bdun brgyad gnyis spangs pa'i tshe gcig pa bar chad gcig pa ste gnyis yod do// gsum pa phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa ni/ phyir 'ong tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa de nyid yin no// 'bras gnas la/ 'dod nyon dgu pa las grol ba'i phyir mi 'ong tsam po ba dang*/ khyad par can ni bsam gtan dang po nas srid nyon brgyad pa la chags pa dang bral ba'i bar gyi 'phags pa thams cad do// de la dbye na/ gzugs su nyer 'gro// gzugs med nyer 'gro// mthong chos zhi ba/ 'dod par tshe yongs (26ba)gyur/ lus mngon byed dang lnga yod pa las/ dang po la/ bar 'da' ba/

skyes 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed pa dang bcas te 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed med par 'da' ba/ gong 'pho dang lnga'o// dang po ni/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong zhig gis gzugs khams su skye ba'i kun sbyor spangs shing mngon par 'grub pa'i kun sbyor ma spangs pas gzugs khams su skye ba'i bar dor mya ngan las 'das pa de'o// gnyis pa ni/ gang zag des skye ba'i kun sbyor yang ma spangs pas skyes ma thag tu mya ngan las 'da' ba'o// gsum pa ni/ gang zag des 'bad rtsol gyi 'du byed dang bcas nas gzugs khams kyi tshe'i dkyil tsam du 'da' ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ 'du byed med par tshe'i 'jug tu 'da' ba'o// lnga pa ni/ rang gang du skyes pa der mya ngan las 'da' ma nus pas sa gong mar 'phos te 'gro ba'o// gong 'pho 'di la lhag mthong shas che zhing bsam gtan gyi spel sgom thob pa 'og min 'gro dang*/ zhi gnas shas cher spyod pa spel sgom ma thob pa srid rtser 'gro gnyis su yod cing*/ 'og min 'gro la yang 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong ba bsam gtan gong ma gsum las nyams pa des skye ba phyi ma tshangs ris su skyes/ rten de las bsam gtan gyi spel sgom ches shin tu chen po sor chud de/ skye ba phyi ma 'og min du skyes nas myang 'das thob pa'i (27na)'phar ba dang*/ des spel sgom dang po gsum po gang rung sor chud/ skye ba phyi ma gnas gtsang ma'i 'og min du skyes nas myang 'das thob pa'i 'phar ba dang*/ des spel sgom dang po gsum po gang rung sor chud/ skye ba phyi ma gnas gtsang ma'i 'og ma gsum po gang rung du skyes/ rten de las spel sgom ches shin tu chen po sor chud par byas/ de'i skye ba phyi ma 'og min du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i phyed du 'phar ba dang*/ des spel sgom ches shin tu chen po ma thob pas tshangs ris ma gtogs pa'i gzugs kyi gnas rnams su 'chi 'pho zhing*/

mthar 'og min du myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba dang gsum yod do// bsam gtan spel mar sgom tshul ni/ bsam gtan bzhi ka la spel sgom yod kyang*/ dang por bzhi pa nyid spel bar byed pa yin te/ de lam sla ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir ro// spel tshul ni/ chung ngu gsum spel/ 'bring drug spel/ chen po dgu spel/ shin tu chen po bcu gnyis spel/ ches shin tu chen po bco lnga spel dang lnga yod pa las/ dang po la mtshon na/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i snyoms 'jug zag med la rgyun ldan du snyoms par 'jug /de nas zag bcas la/ slar zag med la 'jug pa gsum dang*/ yang de gsum skad cig ma gnyis gnyis su 'jug pa ni sbyor ba'o// dngos gzhi ni/ skad cig ma re re kho na la zag bcas zag med gsum spel bar nus pa ste/ spel sgom grub pa'i tshad yin no// slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ skad cig ma re re bsre nus pa de ni ston pa sangs rgyas (27ba)kho nas yin gyi/ gzhan pas ni/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin rgyun ldan du 'jug nus pa nyid kyi grub pa yin zhes gsungs so// spel sgom gang gi phyir byed na/ phyir mi 'ong dbang rnon gyis ni bder gnas dang gnas gtsang mar skye ba'i phyir dang*/ dgra bcom dbang rnon gyis ni bder gnas kyi phyir dang*/ de gnyis dbang rtul gyis ni 'bras bu las mi nyams pa'i phyir 'jug pa yin no// phyi ma srid rtser 'gro ni/ gnas gtsang ma ma gtogs pa'i gzugs dang gzugs med kyi gnas rnams su 'chi 'pho zhing mthar srid rtse'i rten las myang 'das thob pa'o// gnyis pa gzugs med nyer 'gro ni/ gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral bas skye ba phyi ma gzugs khams su mi 'gro bar gzugs med du 'gro ba ste/ dbye na bar 'da' ba ma gtogs pa'i 'da' ba gsum gong 'pho dang bzhi yod do// gsum pa mthong chos zhi ba ni/

bden pa mthong ba'i tshe de nyid la myang 'das mngon du byed pa ste/ mchog zung gcig lta bu'o// bzhi pa 'dod par tshe yongs gyur ni/ 'phags pa'i skye ba brgyud mar len pa ste/ de la khams gsum ga'i rten can yod cing*/ 'dod par tshe yongs gyur ni khams gzhan du mi 'gro'o// lnga pa lus mngon byed ni/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug thob la ma nyams pa'i phyir mi 'ong ste lus la rnam shes 'gags pas so// bzhi pa dgra bcom la zhugs pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyon mongs dang po spong ba nas srid nyon dgu pa spong ba'i bar chad med lam la gnas pa'i bar thams cad yin la/ de spong ba'i bar chad med lam la rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o// 'bras gnas ni/ (28na)srid nyon dgu pa zad pa'i so sor brtags 'gog thob pa dang dus mnyam du rnam grol lam zad pa shes pa'i ye shes skye ba yin no// gal te mi g.yo ba'i rigs can yin na ni mi skye ba shes pa'i ye shes kyang skye'o// spyir dgra bcom la ni/ yongs su nyams pa'i chos can/ bdag gsod pa'i chos can/ rjes su bsrung ba'i chos can/ gnas pa la mi skyed pa'i chos can/ rtogs pa'i skal ba can/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can dang drug tu yod do// rigs de dag mi slob par ma zad slob pa la yang yod do// gnyis pa thob bya 'bras bu la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ thob tshul lo// dang po ngo bo ni/ zag med bar chad med lam de la ni dge sbyong gi tshul zhes bya zhing de'i stobs kyis sgrib pa las grol ba la ni dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu zhes bya'o// 'o na 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis spangs pas phye ba'i 'bras bu bar pa gnyis dge sbyong tshul 'bras su mi rung ste/ lam zag med kyi 'bras bu ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ 'bras bu de gnyis byis pa'i sgom lam gyis thob pa'i tshe/ mthong spangs dang sgom spang spangs pa'i spangs pa gnyis bsres pa dang*/
