gnyis pa lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug bshad pa ni/ rgyu dang lam dang sdug bsngal dang*// 'gog pa la ni go rim bzhin// de dag brgyad dang bdun dang ni// lnga dang bcu drug ces bsgrags so// zhes pas bstan/ rgyu kun 'byung dang lam dang sdug bsngal dang 'gog pa'i bden pa la ni dmigs nas go rim bzhin du de dag rtogs pa'i rnam pa brgyad dang bdun dang ni/ lnga dang bcu drug ces bsgrags so// mdo ni/ 'dod chags dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs so// de las kun bden la dmigs pa'i rnam pa brgyad ni/ yul la 'dun pa dang zhen pa'i 'dod chags dang yang srid la dga' ba ste rgyu'i rnam pa gsum gyi gnyen por 'dod chags dang bral ba dang 'dun pa med pas mi gnas pa dang mtshan ma zhi ba'i rnam pa gsum mo// dug gsum ste kun 'byung gi gsum gyi gnyen por dug gsum med pa gsum mo// gnyis su snang ba'i kun 'byung ste rab skye'i gcig gi gnyen por nyon mongs kyi rgyu gnyis 'dzin zhi ba gcig go /sems can du zhen pa 'jig tshogs la lta ba rkyen gyi gcig gi gnyen por sems can med pa gcig go /lam gyi bdun ni/ tshad med pa dang mtha' gnyis dang ma 'brel ba ni/ sems can thams cad byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs 'byed pa'i lam yin te shes rab dang snying rjes mtha' gnyis dang ma 'brel bar 'byed pa'i phyir/ tha mi dad pa dang mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa ni/ chos thams cad tha mi dad par rtogs pa'i rigs pa yin te nyan rang gi lam la mchog 'dzin med pa'i phyir/ rnam par mi rtog pa dang gzhal du med pa ni/ bdag gnyis su mi rtog pa'i sgrub pa yin te chos nyid ni blos gzhal du med pa'i phyir/(80ba)chags pa med pa ni/ rigs pa chos rnams ni mkha' 'dra bar rtogs pa yin no// 'di la 'thad pa ma bkod pa'o// sdug bden gyi lnga ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang stong pa dang bdag med pa bzhi/

spyi'i mtshan nyid de dag gang du yang mi lta ba gcig go /'gog bden gyi bcu drug ni/ nang dang phyi dang gnyis ka stong nyid du rtogs pa gsum ni 'gog pa dang*/ stong pa nyid dang chen po dang don dam dang 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas dang mtha' las 'das pa dang thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid du rtogs pa brgyad ni zhi ba dang*/ rang bzhin stong nyid du rtogs pa gcig ni gya nom dang*/ chos thams cad dang rang gi mtshan nyid dang mi dmigs pa stong nyid du rtogs pa gsum ni ji ltar nges par 'byung ba dang*/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong nyid du rtogs pa gcig ni nges par 'byung ba yin te/ de dang der zhen pa bral nas stong nyid du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'di dag ni 'dzin rtogs gi gnyen po'o// gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu bshad pa ni/ dran pa nyer gzhag nas bzung ste// sangs rgyas rnam pa'i mthar thug rnams// lam gyi bden pa'i rjes mthun par// zhes pas bstan/ gang zag 'phags lam pa'i rgyud kyi bden don rtogs pa'i rnam pa gzhi shes dang lam shes kyi rnam pa dngos dang rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rjes mthun pa bstan te/ de yang rnam pa thams cad skye med du shes pa'i khog tu gzhi lam skye med du shes pa yang 'dus pa'i dbang gis/ kun mkhyen gsum du phye bas na// slob ma byang chub sems dpa' dang*// (81na) sangs rgyas rnams la rim bzhin te// sum cu bdun dang sum cu bzhi// sum cu rtsa dgu dag tu bzhed// ces so// mdo ni/ lus dang tshor ba dang sems dang chos mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs so// 'o na gong du gzhi lam gyi rnam pa bshad pa dang mi zlos sam snyam na/ skyon med de/ gong du byang sems rang rgyud kyi dbang du byas/ 'dir sangs rgyas kyi thugs la mnga' ba'i sgo nas bzhag pa'am yang na/ gong du bden bzhi'i gnas tshul dang sbyar ba mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas dang*/

'dir lam sgrub pa'i sgo nas bzhag pas so// de la gzhi shes dang thun mong ba'i rnam pa so bdun/ lam shes dang thun mong ba'i rnam pa so bzhi/ rnam mkhyen thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa so dgu bshad pa'o// dang po la/ dngos po rtogs pa'i lam/ rtsol byung gi lam/ ting 'dzin yongs sbyong gi lam/ mngon rtogs la sbyor ba'i lam/ mngon rtogs dang 'brel ba'i lam/ bden pa mngon rtogs kyi lam/ rnam dag nges 'byin gyi lam mo// dang po ni/ bdag 'dzin gyi rten lus/ bdag gi longs spyod du 'dzin pa'i rten tshor ba/ bdag gi dngos por rtogs pa'i rten sems/ bdag kun nyon dang rnam byang du rtogs pa'i rten sems byung dad sogs dang chags sogs kyi chos la shes rab kyi rim pas mi gtsang ba/ sdug bsngal ba/ mi rtag pa/ bdag med pa'i dran pa nye bar 'jog pa'o// de yang nang phyi gnyis ka'i lus dbang po yul dbang rten lnga lnga po rnams la dur khrod kyi lus ltar rang (81ba)mtshan mi gtsang ba spyi mtshan rang bzhin med par sgom/ de ltar lus gsum po la brten nas/ dmigs shing skyes pa'i tshor ba sems chos rnams kyang lus kyi dbye bas gsum gsum du 'gyur zhing*/ sgom tshul yang sngar gyis 'gre'o// gnyis pa ni/ de bsgoms pas mi dge skyes pa spong ba/ ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa/ dge ba skyes pa spel ba/ ma skyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom mo// de re re yang dang por byed 'dod pa'i 'dun pa de las zhi lhag la 'bad pa de la zhum rgod kyi gnyen por brtson 'grus rtsom ji ltar na shes rab kyi sems sdud cing*/ zhi gnas kyis de'i steng du sems 'jog pas sgom mo// 'di'i dge mi dge ni/ yum nas 'byung ba'i yid la byed mi byed do// gsum pa ni/ de bsgoms pas gus sbyor gyi bdun par brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus la brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin/

sngon ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i sems la brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos rnams shes rab kyis dpyod pa la brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems rtse gcig pa skye zhing de skyes pa na rdzu 'phrul yang thob bo/ de ni/ nyes pa le lo// gdam ngag brjed pa/ bying rgod de zhi bas sems 'du mi byed pa ma zhi bas sems 'phro ba'i 'du byed pa lnga'i le lo'i gnyen por 'dun pa brtson 'grus dad pa shin sbyangs kyi ting nge 'dzin bzhi sgom/ lhag ma bzhi'i gnyen por dran pa shes bzhin 'du byed pa sems rnal du 'jog pa'i btang snyoms bzhi ste spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad sgom pa'o// de gsum (82na)tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum nas gtso bor sgom pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ de bsgoms pas byang chub la yid ches pa'i dad pa/ byang sems kyi spyod pa la sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ dmigs pa mi brjod pa'i dran pa/ sems mi 'phro ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab ste rang rang gi snga ma snga ma la dbang byed pa'o// de yang bden pa la yid ches des na de rtogs pa la spro rtogs nas mi brjed ma brjed pa la rtse gcig gnas/ de'i don rnam par nges pa'i tshul gyis sgom mo// lnga pa ni/ de bsgoms pas/ mi mthun phyogs ma dad pa/ le lo// brjed nges/ rnam g.yeng*/ gti mug rnams 'joms pa ste dbang po lnga mthu cher gyur pa'o// sgom tshul sngar bzhin no// de gnyis ni drod rtse dang bzod mchog nas sgom pa'o// drug pa ni/ de bsgoms pas/ gnas tshul mi brjed pa'i dran pa/ rnam rtog 'joms pa'i shes rab chos rab tu rnam 'byed/ mngon shes myur du sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus/ chos kyi snang ba 'phel bas lus sems tshim pa'i dga' ba/ lus sems las rung gi bde ba thob pa shin tu sbyangs pa/ ye shes kyi 'byor pa skye ba'i rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes btang snyoms yang dag rnams ni byang chub kyi gnas sogs yan lag tu 'gyur te/

dran pa ni byang chub kyi gnas/ chos rnam 'byed ni ngo bo/ brtson 'grus ni nges 'byung*/ dga' ba ni phan yon/ lhag ma rnams nyon mongs med pa'i yan lag go /de dag re rer yang bden bzhir dmigs nas shes bya (82ba)spang bya mngon du bya ba rgyud la bsten byar sgom zhing mthong lam nas yod do// bdun pa ni/ de bsgoms pas/ gnas tshul ji lta bar rtogs pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba/ de'i mthus mdo sde sogs kyi don rtogs pa'i rtog pa/ ngag gi las dag pa'i ngag /lus kyi las dag pa'i las kyi mtha'/ ngag gi kha gsags dang lus kyi bcos ma sogs dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ yun ring por shes sgrib spong ba la mi skyo ba'i rtsol ba/ bying rgod kyi gnyen por dran pa/ mngon shes sogs la sgrib pa'i snyom 'jug gi sgrib pa'i gnyen por ting nge 'dzin rnams ni 'phags lam gyi yongs su gcod pa sogs kyi yan lag tu 'gyur te/ lta bas mthong lam gyi rtog pa yongs su gcod/ rtog pa dang ngag gis gzhan la go bar byed ngag las kyi mtha' 'tsho ba gsum gyi lta ba tshul khrims yo byad bskyungs pa la yid ches par byed lhag ma gsum gnyen po'i yan lag go /sgom tshul byang chub yan lag bzhin la sa gnyis pa nas sgom pa'o// gnyis pa lam shes dang thun mong ba'i rnam pa so bzhi bshad pa la/ gnyen po'i lam/ sprul pa'i lam/ mthong chos la bder gnas kyi lam/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam/ spong ba'i lam/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam mo// dang po ni/ yul bdag gnyis/ bdag gnyis kyi rten phung po lnga/ rten de zhi ba gsum la dmigs nas/ stong pa nyid/ smon pa med pa/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum mo// de ni 'dus byas kun mi rtag pa dang rnam rtog kun (83na)sdug bsngal bar sgom pa smon med kyi rgyu/ bdag med par sgom pa stong nyid kyi rgyu/ myang 'das rtog pa nyer zhir sgom pa mtshan med kyi rgyu'o// bden bzhi'i rnam pa rnams kyang 'dir 'dus te sgo dang por stong bdag med gnyis/

gnyis par mi rtag sdug bsngal kun 'byung gi rnams/ gsum par 'gog lam gyi brgyad 'dus so// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi gzugs la chags pa ma bral ba'am/ bral kyang gzugs kyi 'du shes ma bshig par snod bcud kyi gzugs che chung mdzes mi mdzes sogs sna tshogs su sprul pa gzugs can gzugs la lta ba/ rang gi gzugs la 'dod chags bral ba'am/ ma bral kyang 'du shes bshig nas phyi'i gzugs la sngar ltar sprul pa gzugs med gzugs la lta ba gnyis ni/ sprul pa'i sgrib pa las rnam par thar byed kyi sgo'o// zangs dngul gser gyi bum pa lta bu gsum las dngul bum la dmigs nas gzhan gnyis la ltos te sdug mi sdug gnyis kar lta/ yang de gzhan gnyis dang 'brel bar lta/ de bzhin du mi sdug pa yang sdug pa dang 'brel bar lta bas chos kun la bsgre ba khyad par sdug pa ste/ sdug pa 'ba' zhig sprul 'dod kyi sgrib pa las thar ba'o// gsum pa ni/ gzugs med bzhi sems sems byung 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ste rang sa'i ro myang gi sred pa dang tshor 'du las thar ba'o// de'i steng du snga ma gsum (83ba)bsnan na rnam thar brgyad do// 'di dag theg chen lugs na lus rten dang por thob pa mi'i rten skyes zin gnas pa gzugs khams pa'i rten la'ang yod/ sems rten bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mthar bsten par mtshungs so// bzhi pa ni/ bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ste mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu'o// dang po brgyad 'das lam gyi rten phyi ma 'das lam gyi rjes la thob pas sam phyi ma ngo bo yin pa'i dbang gis so// snyom 'jug dang rnam thar gyi khyad ni bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam yin no// lnga pa ni/ mthong lam bzod pa bzhi'o// drug pa ni/ phar phyin bcu'o// 'dir 'gog snyoms bshad na/ theg dman lugs/ theg chen lugs so// dang po la/ rten/ ngo bo/ dang po ni/ lus rten sngar bzhin sems rten la 'jug pa'i rten srid rtse ste sems kyi rgyu ba 'gog sla bas so// ldang ba'i tshe srid rtse'i dag pa dang ci yang med gang rung gi sems la brten no//

gnyis pa ni/ tshor 'du rags pas sun nas lus kyi steng du sems sems byung 'gog pa ste/ dge ba dang ldan min 'du byed du 'dod cing lus mngon byed dang gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol gyi dgra bcom gang rung gi kun slong gis ji tsam 'phangs pa'i bar du 'jug pa'o// gnyis pa la/ thun mong ba ni tshor 'du 'gog pa tsam ste/ nyan thos dang mthun zhing de la byang sems kyi zhag bdun las lhag par mi gnas so// (84na)thun mong min pa la dbu sems kyi lugs/ dang po ni/ sa drug pa nas thob cing de la sa bdun par rang gi 'jug ldang nus/ sa brgyad par rjes thob tu yang mtshan 'dzin med pas de las ldang ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi slong dgos par bstan pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi steng du/ sher phyin gyis spros mtshan bkag pa'o// sems tsam lugs la dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i slob pa'i dbang du na mthong lam gyi rjes thob nas yod cing*/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi steng du ye shes kyis tshogs bdun 'khor bcas 'gog pa'o// de rang ngo ye shes min kyang ye shes rgyun mi 'chad du yod la/ mi slob pa'i dbang du na kun gzhi'i ye shes kyi steng du glo bur gyi dri ma thams cad 'gags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes te ldang ba med pa'o// rgyan 'dir ni dbu sems kyi lugs gnyis ka dang mthun par khas blang bar bya'o// gsum pa rnam mkhyen thun mong min pa'i rnam pa so dgu bshad pa la/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi/ chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ de bzhin nyid/ rang 'byung*/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa'o// dang po ni/ sbyin pa las longs spyod 'byung ba gnas ser sna las de 'byung ba'i gnas ma yin pa sogs dang*/ zag bcas kyi las kyi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu 'gro ba ma lus pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi mos pa'i bye brag sna tshogs dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams chags 'jig dang mchog (84ba)dman du ma dang*/

dad pa sogs kyi dbang po rno ba mchog dang rtul 'bring mchog ma yin pa dang*/ byang chub gsum po thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam dang*/ snyoms 'jug la sgrib pa'i ro myang sogs kun nas nyon mongs dang de dang bral ba'i mtshan med dang dus su ldang ba rnam par byang ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi tshe rabs dpag tu med pa'i sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ sems can kun 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba'i tshul dang*/ sgrib gnyis kyi zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'o// de las dang po ni/ bde 'gro'i thabs la bslu ba gnyis pa skyabs ma yin pa skyabs su bslu ba/ bdun pa zag med kyi dag pa la bslu ba lhag ma rnams theg chen gyi nges par 'byung ba la bslu ba'i bdud rnams 'joms pa'i stobs can no// gnyis pa ni/ 'khor gyi dbus su nga ni sangs rgyas so// zhes dang*/ zag pa thams cad zad pa nyid du zhal gyis bzhes pa rang don rtogs pa dang spangs pa'i dam bca' gnyis/ sgrib gnyis kyi thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs byed pa dang*/ thams cad shes pas nyan rang dang lam shes pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'byung ba'i lam du zhal gyis bzhes pa gzhan don spang bya dang lam la dam bca' gnyis so// de dag la chos mthun gyi rgol bar rtsom pa tsam yang mi 'byung bas mi 'jigs pa'o//

gsum pa ni/ rten rgyu'i chos ming gi rnam grangs mtha' dag mkhyen pa chos dang*/ brten pa brjod bya'am 'bras bu'i chos mkhyen pa don so so yang dag par rig pa bshad bya mkhyen pa gnyis/(85na)gcig brjod pas yul so so'i skad du go bar 'gyur ba nges pa'i tshig dang*/ rdzas yod btags yod sogs chos kyi rnam dbye mkhyen pa'i spobs pa so so yang dag pa rig pa 'chad byed mkhyen pa gnyis so// bzhi pa ni/ glang chen gtum po dang lhan du mchong ba sogs sku la 'khrul pa/ bzhad gad dang 'o dod sogs gsung la ca co// bya ba mi byed pa dang dus yol sogs thugs la dran pa nyams pa/ ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs bzhugs gang la'ang thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa/ 'khor 'das la tha dad pa'i 'du shes/ so sor ma brtag par gdul bya yal bar 'dor ba'i btang snyoms rnams mi mnga' ba ni spyod pa ma 'dres pa drug /chos ston pa'i 'dun pa/ gdul bya'i bya ba sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus/ bsam mi dgos par chos ston pa'i dran pa/ chos nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ye shes dpag tu med pa'i shes rab/ spang bya thams cad las rnam par grol ba rnams nyams pa mi mnga' ba ni rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug /sku'i cha byad dang spyod lam sogs kyis sems can 'dul ba sku'i/ 'bras bu ldan pa'i chos ston pa gsung gi /ye shes sems can kun gyi rjes su son pa thugs kyi phrin las rnams ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing*/ ye shes rjes su 'brang ba phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ dus gsum gyi chos thams cad ji lta bar mkhyen pas ma chags pa/ ji snyed par mkhyen pas ma thogs par ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'jug pa ni ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum mo// lnga pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bshad (85ba)pa'i myang 'das kyi ngo bo nyid de bzhin nyid do// drug pa ni/ de bzhin nyid sngon du gyur pa'i rten 'brel las chos ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes rang byung ngo*//

bdun pa ni/ chos de rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i ngo bo 'ba' zhig las gzhan du snang ba med pa'o// gnyis pa sgom mkhan gang zag ni/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas// de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun// dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa// 'di mnyan pa yi snod yin no// sangs rgyas bsten dang kun 'dri dang*// sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs spyod pas// len dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i// snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do// zhes pas bstan/ sher phyin sgom pa po'i gang zag gang zhe na/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par bsnyen bskur byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas de dag las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes kyis yongs su zin pas mgon dang bcas pa ni sher phyin zab mo 'di nyan pa'i snod yin no// sangs rgyas rnams dge ba'i bshes su bsten pa dang de dag la sher phyin gyi don kun 'dri ba dang*/ sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs kyi phar phyin la spyod pas ni/ nyan par ma zad thos nas mi skrag cing dang du len pa dang tshig don 'dzin pa dang la sogs pas sgrub pa dang khong du chud par 'gyur ba'i snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do// mdo ni/ yum 'di sems can gang dag gi rna lam du grag par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'o// zhes sogs so// gsum pa sbyor ba'i ngo bo la/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga'o// dang po rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba ni/ gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir// de la sbyor ba bkag pa'i phyir// de yi de bzhin nyid zab phyir// de rnams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir// de dag tshad ni med phyir dang*// ces pas bstan/ gzugs dang la sogs pas rnam mkhyen gyi bar la zhen pas mi gnas pa'i phyir dang*/ de la sbyor ba bkag pa'i phyir dang*/ de'i de bzhin nyid zab pa'i phyir dang*/

de'i de bzhin nyid rnams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir dang*/ de dag gi de bzhin nyid tshad (86na)ni med pa'i phyir dang*/ go rim bzhin du bzung ba la zhen pa bkag pa dang 'dzin pa la zhen pa bkag pa dang gzhi lam rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin lnga la de dang de'i sgrub byed dang mthun pa'i ming can gyi sbyor ba zhes bya'o// 'di rnams tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du yod pa'o// gnyis pa gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga ni/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i phyir// lung bstan phyir mi ldog nyid dang*// nges 'byung bar chad med bcas dang*// byang chub nye dang myur ba dang*// gzhan don 'phel med 'grib med phyir// chos dang chos min sogs mi mthong*// gzugs sogs bsam mi khyab mi mthong*// gzugs sogs de yi mtshan ma dang*// de yi ngo bo rnam mi rtog /'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed dang*// de ni dag pa 'tshams dang bcas// zhes pas bstan/ yum la skrag pa skye srid pas tshegs chen pos yun ring nas yum rtogs pa'i phyir dang*/ yum la mi skrag pas rdzogs byang du lung bstan thob pa'i phyir dang*/ yum thos nas myur du 'dzin pas phyir mi ldog pa nyid kyi phyir dang*/ yum gyi 'gal zla sa gnyis sogs las nges par 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi bar chad mthong spangs rtog pa rags pa med pa dang bcas pa'i phyir dang*/ zag med kyi chos gsar pa thob pas byang chub la nye ba'i phyir dang*/ myur du byang chub par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rim pas tshogs lam pa dbang brtul dang drod rtse bzod mchog mthong lam sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi ting nge 'dzin bdun po rnams la de dang de'i sgrub pa zhes bya'o// chos 'khor bskor zhing bskul ba'i gzhan don sgrub pa'i phyir dang*/ chos nyid 'phel ba med 'grib pa med par mthong ba'i phyir dang*/ chos dkar po'i las dang chos min nag po'i las sogs mi mthong ba'i phyir dang*/

gzugs sogs la bsam gyis mi khyab par mi mthong bas mi rlom pa'i phyir dang*/ gzugs sogs de'i mtshan ma dang de'i ngo bor rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyir sa brgyad par gnas pa'i byang sems (86ba)kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par lnga la de dang de'i sgrub pa zhes bya'o// rgyun zhugs nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi 'bras bu rin chen drug gzhan la sbyin par byed pa'i phyir dang*/ gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra mo de ni dag par byed pa'i phyir dang*/ lo zla'i sa mtshams dang bcas par yum 'bri ba sogs la dam bcas pa las phyir mi nur ba'i phyir sa dgu pa bcu pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ tshogs lam nas sa bdun pa'i bar gyi byang sems kyi bgyi ba la de dang de'i sgrub pa zhes bya'o// mdo ni/ gzugs la mi gnas pa de'i tshe gzugs la rnal 'byor du byed pa yin/ zhes sogs so// bzhi pa sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro'i chos la/ yon tan/ skyon/ mtshan nyid/ thar pa cha mthun shes pa'o// dang po yon tan ni/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa// yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi 'o// zhes pas bstan/ yum sgom pa la spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir gsungs pa/ 'di rnams tshogs lam nas thob mod legs par sbyar ba sbyor lam yan du'o// mdo ni/ bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi mthus bdud sdig can gyis bar chad bya bar mi nus so// zhes sogs so// bcu bzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs pas bdud kyi mthu bcom pa gcig /sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs kyi dgongs pa gnyis/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa gsum/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nye ba bzhi/ phyir mi ldog tu ma gyur kyi bar du nam yang ngan 'gror mi skye ba lnga/ sangs rgyas rnams dang mi 'bral ba drug /phyin drug sogs zag med kyi chos dang mi 'bral ba bdun/ yul lho byang (87na)rnams su sangs rgyas par 'gyur zhing de ltar spyod pa la sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa brgyad/

zag med kyi chos yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dgu/ yum mi spong zhing thos pa'i tshe dga' bde chen po skye ba bcu/ dam bca' brtan pas bdud kyis bsgyur mi nus pa bcu gcig /skye bo mang po rdzogs byang la 'god nus pa bcu gnyis/ rnam smin phun tshogs yongs su 'dzin pa bcu gsum/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po nus pa bcu bzhi'o// 'di skabs kyi mdor/ lnga brgya'i tha ma la zhes pa las 'phros nas bstan pa'i gnas tshad bshad na/ bskal bzang du gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa 'das nas bstan pa lo lnga stong gnas te/ de yang dgra bcom phyir mi 'ong rgyun zhugs gtso bor thob pa khong du chud pa'i dus la lnga brgya pa gsum/ shes rab ting 'dzin tshul khrims gtso cher sgrub pa'i dus la lnga brgya pa gsum/ mngon pa mdo sde 'dul ba gtso cher ston pa lung gi dus la lnga brgya pa gsum/ lta spyod rnal ma med par rab byung gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus la lnga brgya pa gcig rnams so// deng sang rgyal ba'i dbang po dgung lo zhe gcig bzhes pa'i dus 'di ni/ dus 'khor lugs kyi ston pa 'das nas lo nyis stong bzhi brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga song ba ste/ des na ting nge 'dzin gyi lnga brgya'i nang nas lo bzhi brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga song zhing bdun cu don lnga lus pa'o// gnyis pa skyon shes pa ni/ yum sgom pa la bar chad du 'gyur ba'i skyon bsal dgos pas gsungs pa/ skyon ni bcu (87ba)tshan bzhir bcas pa// drug tu nges par rtogs par bya// zhes pas bstan/ zhes zhe drug ste/ tshogs lam nas sa bdun pa'i bar yod cing gtso cher tshogs sbyor na'o// mdo sdud par/ 'gro ba'i don ma byas par glog bzhin myur du yang*/ yongs su nyams par 'gyur ba 'di ni bdud kyi las/ zhes sogs so// zhe drug ni/ spobs pa ha cang 'phyis pa gcig /ha cang myur ba gnyis/ glal ba rgod pa phan tshun brdeg pa gsum/ sems g.yeng ba bzhi/

yi ge gzhan la chags pa lnga/ yum gyi ro ma myong nas stan las langs te 'gro ba drug /glal zhing lung 'bogs pa bdun/ yum rtsa ba 'dra ba bor nas nyan rang gi mdo sde yal ga 'dra ba slob par sems pa brgyad/ rnyed bkur gyi phyir yum bor nas dman pa'i mdo sde la slob pa dgu/ yum bor nas dman pa'i mdo sde las rnam mkhyen 'tshol ba bcu'o// rgyal phran dang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal bsgrun par ltar nyan rang gi mdo sde dang yum mnyam par mos nas nyan rang gi mdo sde la slob pa gcig /nor bu rin po che dang nor bu 'ching bu mnyam par sems pa ltar yum rnyed pa bor nas nyan rang gi mdo sde las rnam mkhyen btsal bar sems pa gnyis/ yum la spyod pa'i tshe gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi chos la rnam rtog gi spobs pa 'phro ba gsum/ dngos po med pa la yum du zhen pa bzhi/ yi ge la yum du zhen pa lnga/ yi ge med pa la yum du zhen pa drug /chos spyod kyi tshe yul gyi bya ba mang po bskyed pa bdun/ grong gi skyes pa bud med dang de dag gi las sna tshogs yid la byed pa brgyad/(88na)rnyed bkur gyi ro myang ba dgu/ yum bor nas bdud kyis btags pa'i nyan rang gi mdo las thabs mkhas 'tshol ba bcu'o// yum gyi chos spyod la 'chad po brtson la nyan po mi brtson pa gcig /'chad po rnyed bkur 'dod la nyan po mi 'dod pa gnyis/ 'chad po sbyangs yon bcu gnyis dang ldan la nyan po mi ldan pa gsum/ 'chad po bdog pa gtong zhing dge la brtson la dbang po rno ba nyan po ser sna le lo can dbang po rtul ba bzhi/ 'chad po gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis shes la nyan po mi shes pa lnga/ de dag las ldog pa lnga dang bcu'o// dpon slob gang rung gcig thabs mkhas ldan la gcig mi ldan pa gcig /de bzhin du gzungs thob ma thob gnyis/ yum gyi chos spyod la 'dun mi 'dun gsum/ sgrib pa lnga dang bral ma bral bzhi/

'khor bas 'jigs nas myang 'das da lta nyid du 'dod mi 'dod lnga/ zla med gcig pur brtson mi brtson drug /'chad pa po rjes su 'brang ba mi 'dod la nyan po phyi bzhin 'brang ba bdun/ zang zing cung zad kyi phyir chos spyod la brtson mi brtson brgyad/ srog gi bar chad 'ong ba'i phyogs su 'gro mi 'gro dgu/ 'tsho ba 'phongs pa'i phyogs su 'gro mi 'gro bcu'o// 'chad po 'tsho ba mod phyogs 'gro zhing nyan po rjes su 'brang ba las ldog pa gcig /'chad po 'jigs bcas kyi sar 'gro bar bcos nas nyan po rjes su 'brang ba ldog pa gnyis/ 'chad po bsod snyoms mod pa'i grong la chags pas blta zhing nyan po rjes su 'brang ba ldog pa gsum/ gsum las ldog (88ba)pa'i phyir bdud kyis yum ni nged kyi 'di yin gyi khyod kyis spyod pa de min no zhes/ dbyen byed pa la the tshom skyes nas yum spong ba bzhi/ de'i mthus yum ltar bcos pa la slob pa lnga/ bdud sdig can dge sbyong gi tshul gyis sems bsgyur nas de la dad par byed pa drug go / gsum pa mtshan nyid shes par bya ba la spyi gzhung gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid spyi'i rnam gzhag /skabs bab bshad pa'o// dang po mtshan nyid spyi'i rnam gzhag ni/ mtshan nyid la/ me'i tsha ba lta bu rang gi mtshan nyid/ mi rtag pa lta bu spyi'i mtshan nyid/ dngos po gcig la'ang log pa la ltos nas ldog pa du ma can ni rnam par dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ ma khyab khyab ches sogs gcod pa rigs mi mthun sel ba'i mtshan nyid/ don la med kyang blo ngor dogs pa sel phyir bkod pa log rtog sel ba'i mtshan nyid rnams las 'dir bshad pa ni snga ma'o// gnyis pa skabs bab bshad pa ni/ gzhung 'dir rnam par bzhag 'jog mtshan nyid par mi bzung la/ gang bzung na/ mtshan gzhi dang mtshon bya ni don dang skad dod gnyis kar gcig pas don la tha dad med mod/ 'on kyang dper na/ 'tshed pa zhes pa'i sgra gcig nyid/

gang gis 'tshed pa gang 'tshed pa zhes bya byed gnyis kar drang rung ba bzhin/ mtshan nyid ces pa'i sgra gcig nyid/ gang gis mtshon pa gang mtshon pa'i bya byed gnyis kar 'brel ba la dgongs nas gsungs pa'o// des na shes khyad byed gsum ni gang gis mtshon byed sgrub bo/ ngo bo nyid mtshan ni gang mtshon pa las sgrub bo/ de gnyis ni rtags dang bsgrub bya lta bu shes byed dang shes bya'o// (89na)de yang ji ltar mtshon na/ shes mtshan byed mtshan gnyis kyi rim par mkhyen gsum sbyor ba'i steng gi rang don rtogs pa dang gzhan don phrin las bskyed pa'i nus pa de gnyis yod par mtshon pa ste mi ldan rnam gcod do// khyad mtshan gyis nyan rang gis sbyor ba la'ang nus pa de gnyis yod dam snyam pa bsal nas 'di kho nar yod pa mtshon pa ste gzhan ldan rnam gcod do// gang mtshon pa'i mtshan gzhir ni sbyor ba dang de steng gi nus pa gnyis ka bzung ngo*// gnyis pa gzhung don la/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ gang gis mtshon de mtshan nyid du// shes bya de yang rnam pa gsum// shes pa khyad par byed pa ste// ngo bo nyid gang mtshon bya yang*// zhes pas bstan/ sbyor ba sgom pa la'ang de'i mtshan nyid shes dgos pas gsungs pa/ gang gi mtshon de sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid du shes par bya ba'i mtshon byed kyi mtshan nyid de yang rnam pa gsum ste shes pa khyad par byed pa'i mtshan nyid de/ de gsum gyi sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid bcu drug gis mkhyen gsum bskyed pa gang mtshon par bya ba'o// yang ni snga mar ma zad 'di yang mtshan nyid do zhes pa'o// mtshan nyid kyi sa mtshams ni tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du'o//

gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ rtogs pa mthar thug bskyed nus par ston pa shes pa/ nus pa phun tshogs de nyan rang la med par ston pa khyad par/ gzhan don rgya chen sgrub nus par ston pa byed pa/ khyad chos de rnams dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba ngo bo nyid mtshan no// dang po la/ gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes mtshan no// dang po gzhi shes ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang*// 'jig rten 'jig med bdag nyid dang*// sems can sems kyi spyod pa dang*// de bsdus pa dang phyir bltas dang*// mi zad pa yi rnam pa dang*// chags bcas sogs dang rgya chen dang*// chen por gyur dang tshad med dang*// rnam shes bstan du med pa dang*// sems bltar med dang shes pa dang*// g.yo ba la sogs zhes bya dang*// de las gzhan yang de dag ni// de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par shes// thub pas de bzhin nyid rtogs de// gzhan la bstan pa zhes bya ba// thams cad shes pa nyid skabs kyi// shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa yin// zhes pas bstan/ dang po yum las de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang*/ gnyis pa phung (89ba)lnga'i 'jig rten de kho nar rgyun dang skad cig gi 'jig pa med pa'i bdag nyid dang*/ gsum pa sems can rnams kyi sems kyi spyod pa tshad med pa dang*/ bzhi pa sems de nang du bsdus pa dang*/ lnga pa sems de phyir bltas pas rnam par g.yengs pa dang*/ drug pa bral ba'i 'dus ma byas su gyur pa sems de mi zad pa'i rnam pa dang*/ bdun pa sems nyon mongs chags pa sogs dang bcas pa dang*/ sogs pas brgyad pa chags sogs dang bral ba dang*/ dgu pa chos nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yin pas sems rgya chen po dang*/ bcu pa thams cad la khyab pas sems chen por gyur pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa rten med pas sems tshad med pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa rang gi mtshan nyid med pas rnam shes 'di'o zhes bstan du med pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa sems de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyis kyang bltar med pa dang*/

bcu bzhi pa shes pa de g.yo ba ste yul la sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa dang la sogs pas 'du ba ste dgag pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa'o// de yang*/ bdag dang 'jig rten rtag pa dang mi rtag pa dang gnyis ka dang gnyis min du 'dod pa sngon mthar brten pa/ bdag dang 'jig rten mtha' ldan dang mi ldan pa dang gnyis ka dang gnyis min du 'dod pa phyi mthar brten pa/ sangs rgyas grongs nas 'byung ba dang mi 'byung ba dang gnyis ka dang gnyis min du 'dod pa myang 'das la brten pa/ lus srog gcig dang tha dad du 'dod pa lus srog la brten pa'o// de las rtag pa dang mtha' mi ldan pa dang grongs nas 'byung ba ni g.yo ba ste rtag (90na)lta'o// de las ldog pa rnams ni 'du ba ste chad lta'o// gnyis ka rnams ni gcer bu pa'i lta ba bkram pa ste sgrub pa'o// gnyis min rnams ni gnas ma bu pa'i lta ba bcums pa ste dgag pa'o// lus srog gcig tu lta ba bye brag pa dang tha dad du lta ba grangs can te snga ma sgrub pa phyi ma dgag pa'o// 'di dag ni 'dzam gling du chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe phyi rol pa rnams kyi lta ba drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi don mtha' bcu bzhir bcad nas zhus pa ste thams cad kyang bdag las brtsams pa yin pas khyad gzhi med pa la khyad chos mi 'thad la/ khyad gzhi bkag na don du mi 'gyur bar dgongs nas lan lung du ma bstan pa'o// des na gang zag so sor sbyar ba ni/ rnam pa gsal phyir tsam ste thams cad kyang phyi rol pa'i lta ba yin la de rnams yul med sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes bya ba dang*/ bco lnga pa de las gzhan du yang phung po lnga po de dag ni de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par shes pa dang*/ bcu drug pa thub pas chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid rtogs shing de gzhan la ston par byed pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams kyis dben pa sogs thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba'i skabs kyi shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa de sbyor ba de la yul 'di rnams shes pa'i nus pa yod pa yin no// mdo ni/

yum zab mo 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa bskyed pa'o// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa lam shes ni/ stong nyid mtshan ma med bcas dang*// smon pa rnam par spangs pa dang*// skye med 'gag pa med sogs dang*// chos nyid rnam par 'khrug med dang*// 'du mi byed dang rnam mi rtog /rab dbye mtshan nyid med nyid la// lam shes nyid kyi skabs kyis ni// shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin par bzhed// ces pas bstan/ dang po yum spros pas stong pa nyid dang*/ gnyis pa rgyu'i mtshan ma med pa dang bcas pa dang*/ gsum pa 'bras bu la smon pa (90ba)rnam par spang pa dang*/ bzhi pa gsar du skye ba med pa dang*/ lnga pa sngar yod 'gag pa med pa dang*/ sogs pas kun nas nyon mongs pa dang dad sogs rnam byang dang spang bya'i dngos po dang myang 'das kyi ngo bo nyid dang chos dbyings kyi rten dang 'gyur ba'i chos su med pa drug dang*/ bcu gnyis pa chos nyid lha mi'i sgro skur gyi rnam par 'khrug tu med pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa rgyus 'du mi byed pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa de'i phyir gang du yang rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ bco lnga pa stong nyid sogs mtshan nyid kyi rab dbye dang*/ bcu drug pa mtshan nyid rnams don dam du med pa nyid la gsal snang thob pa 'di rnams kyis bya dka' ba sogs lam shes nyid kyi sbyor ba'i skabs kyi ni shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin par bzhed do// mdo ni/ yum ni stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid do// zhes sogs so// gsum pa lam shes ni/ de ni nyid kyi chos brten nas// gnas dang gus par bya ba dang*// bla ma nyid dang mnyes pa dang*// de la mchod dang byed med dang*// kun tu 'jug mkhyen gang yin dang*// ma mthong ston par mdzad pa dang*// 'jig rten stong nyid rnam pa dang*// brjod dang shes mdzad mngon sum mdzad// bsam mi khyab dang zhi nyid ston// 'jig rten 'du shes 'gog pa la// rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni// shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do//

zhes pas bstan/ dang po dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas de rnams ni rang nyid kyis rtogs pa'i chos yum la brten nas gnas pa dang*/ gnyis pa gus par bya ba dang*/ gsum pa bla ma nyid du bya ba dang*/ bzhi pa mnyes par bya ba dang*/ lnga pa de la mchod yul du ston pa dang*/ drug pa de dag kyang don dam du bya ba med pa dang*/ bdun pa shes bya kun tu ye shes 'jug pas mkhyen pa gang yin pa dang*/ brgyad pa mtshan ma'i sgo nas gang du yang ma mthong ba de de kho na nyid du ston par mdzad pa dang*/ dgu pa kun rdzob kyi 'jig rten stong nyid kyi rnam par dang*/ bcu pa de yang thog mar thos pa'i ngor stong nyid du brjod pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa (91na)bsam pa'i ngor de shes par mdzad pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa sgom pa'i ngor de mngon sum du mthong bar mdzad pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa med pa kho na min pa bsam gyis mi khyab par ston pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa spros pa zhi ba nyid du ston pa dang*/ bco lnga pa 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi gzung ba 'gog pa dang*/ bcu drug pa kun rdzob pa'i 'du shes 'dzin pa 'gog pa la gsal snang thob pa 'di rnams kyis dmigs pa'i ngo bo nyid sogs rnam pa kun mkhyen gyi sbyor ba'i tshul la ni yod pa'i shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do// mdo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yum 'di la brten cing gnas so// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa nus pa phun tshogs de nyan rang la med par ston pa khyad mtshan la bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis// khyad zhugs bden pa'i spyod yul can// skad cig ma ni bcu drug gis// khyad par mtshan nyid bshad pa yin// zhes pas/ dngos su mthong lam khyad 'phags par bstan pas sgom lam dang mi slob lam kyang khyad zhugs pa go nus so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ bsam mi khyab dang mi mnyam dang*// gzhal dang bgrang las yang dag 'das// 'phags pa kun sdud mkhas pa yis// rig bya thun mong min shes nyid//

shes myur bri dang gang med dang*// sgrub dang yang dag 'grub pa dang*// dmigs pa rten dang bcas pa dang*// mtha' dag pa dang yongs 'dzin dang*// ro myang med dang khyad par ni// bcu drug bdag nyid shes bya ste// gang gis lam ni gzhan dag las// khyad du 'phags pas khyad par lam// zhes pas bstan/ bden bzhir dmigs pa bzhi bzhi ste khyad par bcu drug go /de la dang po shes rab tshad med pa'i mthus bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa dang blos gzhal ba las 'das pa dang grangs kyis bgrang ba las yang dag par 'das pa rtogs pa dang bzhi/ gnyis pa 'phags pa kun gyis yon tan sdud pa dang ji lta ji snyed kyi don la mkhas (91ba)pa yis rig par bya ba dang*// nyan rang dang thun mong min pa'i shes rab nyid dang mngon shes nyan rang las myur ba thob pa ste bzhi/ gsum pa bri ba skur 'debs dang gang ba sgro 'dogs med pa dang 'khor gsum dag pas yum sgrub pa dang tshogs gnyis yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/ chos kun la mi rtog par dmigs pa dang bzhi/ bzhi pa lam gyi rten rigs mchog dang bcas pa dang*/ lam gyi yan lag mtha' dag tshang ba dang yongs 'dzin thabs mkhas pas zin pa dang spangs rtogs la ro myang med pa dang bzhi'o// des na khyad par ni/ bcu drug bdag nyid shes bya ste// gang gi lam ni gzhan dag las// khyad du 'phags pas khyad par lam// zhes pa ste chos kyi bdag med ma lus par rtogs pas so// mdo ni/ gzugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang zhes sogs so// gsum pa gzhan don rgya chen sgrub nus par ston pa'i byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang*// mi rnams kyi ni skyabs dag dang*// gnas dang dpung gnyen gling dang ni// yongs 'dren pa zhes bya ba dang*// lhun gyis grub dang theg gsum gyi// 'bras bu mngon sum mi byed dang*// tha ma rten gyi mdzad pa ste// 'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin// zhes pas bstan/

skye dgu rnams la tshe phyi ma phan pa dang tshe 'dir bde ba dang gtan du sdug bsngal las skyob pa gsum ni kun shes kyi sbyor ba'i'o// dang po lhag med la 'god pas mi sogs 'gro ba rnams kyi ni skyabs dag dang*/ gnyis pa bden 'dzin bzlog pa gnas dang*/ gsum pa srid zhi mnyam nyid du rtogs par byed pa dpung gnyen dang*/ bzhi pa rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa gtan gyi don gling dang ni/ lnga pa rang don la sred pa bral bas 'gro ba yongs su 'dren pa zhes bya ba dang*/ drug pa don gnyis 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ bdun (92na)pa theg pa gsum gyi lam gyis nges par 'byung ba thob kyang*/ yang dag mtha'i 'bras bu mngon sum du mi byed pa'i bdag nyid rnams ni lam shes kyi sbyor ba'i'o// byed pa tha ma ni chos 'khor bskor ba sogs 'gro ba'i rten du gyur ba'i mdzad pa ste rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i'o// de ltar bcu gcig pa 'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin no// mdo ni/ byang chen rnams 'jig rten gyi phan pa dang*/ zhes sogs so// bzhi pa khyad chos de rnams dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba ngo bo nyid mtshan la/ kun shes kyi sbyor ba bzhi/ lam shes kyi lnga/ rnam mkhyen gyi bdun no// dang po kun shes kyi sbyor ba bzhi ni/ nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang*// mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dag / ces pas bstan/ chags sogs nyon mongs dang*/ de'i rtags lus ngag gi tshul min dang*/ de'i mtshan ma tshul min yid byed dang*/ mi mthun phyogs srid pa dang gnyen po myang 'das la rtogs pa'i shes sgrib dag gis dben pa'o// gnyis pa lam shes kyi sbyor ba lnga ni/ dben dang dka' dang nges pa dang*// ched du bya dang mi dmigs dang*// mngon par zhen pa bkag pa dang*// zhes pas bstan/ gzod nas med pa'i sems can sgrol bas spyod pa bya dka' bas dben pa dang*/ thams cad chos dbyings ro gcig tu rtogs pas nges pa'i lta ba dang*/

chen po gsum gyi ched du bya ba dang*/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa dang*/ yum la'ang mngon par zhen pa bkag pa dang ngo*// gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba bdun ni/ dmigs pa zhes bya gang yin dang*// mi mthun thogs pa med dang de// gzhi med 'gro med skye med dang*// de bzhin nyid ni mi dmigs dang*// ngo bo nyid bcu drug bdag nyid// mtshon bya lta bur mtshon pas na// mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin// zhes pas bstan/ rnam pa thams cad la dmigs pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa dang*/ de yang 'khrul pa'i snang ba dang mi mthun pa don dam nyid dang*/ shes bya kun la thogs pa med par 'jug pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid la 'khrul pa'i gzhi'am gnas med pa dang*/ 'gro 'ong med pa dang*/ skye 'gag med pa dang*/ de (92ba)bzhin nyid ni de las gzhan du mi dmigs pa dang*/ de ltar sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid yul can ye shes spros pas dben pa'i cha bcu drug gi bdag nyid de snga ma gsum gyis 'di mtshon par bya ba'i gzhi lta bur mtshon pas na mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin no// lta bur zhes pa tha snyad tsam du yin pa'i don no// mdo ni/ 'dod chags rnam par bsal bas dben pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ro// zhes sogs so// bzhi pa thar pa cha mthun shes pa la ngo bo/ dbye ba'o// dang po ngo bo ni/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs// yang dag sgrub la mkhas pa ni// rnam pa thams cad rtogs 'di la// thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod// ces pas bstan/ spyir bsod nams cha mthun dang thar pa cha mthun gnyis las snga ma ni lam ma zhugs kyi dge ba'o// phyi ma ni sdug bsngal las thar ba/ de'i phyogs su gzhol ba'i cha/ mi 'gyur bas mthun pa ste thos bsam las byung ba gtso che zhing sgom byung yang yod la/ lus rten za ma ma ning mtshams med can ma yin pa'i gling gsum gyi mi dang 'dod lha dang sems rten bsam gtan gang rung la skye ba'o// 'dir bye brag tu chos kun mtshan ma med par mos pas bdog pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa la sogs pa'i thabs kyi cha yang dag par sgrub pa la brtson zhing mkhas pa ni rnam pa thams cad rtogs pa'i phyir bsdus te bsgom pa'i sbyor ba 'di la sngon du 'gro ba'i thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod do// mdo ni/

thog mar sems bskyed nas nye bar bzung nas rnam mkhyen gyi sems dang ma bral bar sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa dbye ba la/ yul gyi (93na)dbye ba/ dbang po'i dbye ba'o// dang po yul gyi dbye ba ni/ sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang*// sbyin sogs spyod yul brtson 'grus dang*// bsam pa phun tshogs dran pa dang*// rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin dang*// chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du// shes pa'i shes rab dang rnam lnga// zhes pas bstan/ yul sangs rgyas la sogs pa dkon mchog gsum la dmigs pa'i dad pa dang*/ sbyin sogs phar phyin rnams la spyod pa'i yul can brtson 'grus dang*/ sems bskyed sogs bsam pa phun tshogs la dmigs pa'i dran pa dang*/ g.yeng ba la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad rab tu shes par nus pa'i shes rab dang ste sgom byung du ma nges pas dbang po ma yin pa rnam pa lnga'o// gnyis pa dbang po'i dbye ba ni/

rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnon po yis// rtogs sla rtul pos rtogs dkar bzhed// ces pas bstan/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni dbang po rnon po yis te theg chen gyi dad sogs kyis rtogs sla la dbang po rtul po nyan rang gi dad sogs kyis ni rdzogs byang rtogs dka' bar bzhed do// mdo ni/ sangs rgyas rnams yid la sems te mtshan mar mi byed do// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba nyid bstan pa la/ de skyes pa'i gnas skabs/ rten phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag /bsgom bya sbyor ba'i ngo bo/ dang po la/ dngos/ zhar byung ngo*// dang po dngos ni/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir// sems can thams cad yin par bsngags// de dag nyid la sems mnyam sogs// rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do// bdag nyid sdig pa las zlog cing*// sbyin la sogs la gnas pas gzhan// de dag la ni 'god pa dang*// bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// rtser gyur de bzhin bzod pa ni// rang gzhan rten can bden shes pa// chos mchog de bzhin sems can rnams// smin byed sogs kyis shes par bya// zhes pas bstan/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis rtogs nas de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam pa bsdus nas bsgoms pa na sbyor lam 'byung zhing de'i rjes thob kyis cha bstan pa/ dro ba rnams kyis dmigs pa 'dir/ sems can thams cad yin par bsngags// zhes spyir bstan nas/ de yang sems can de dag nyid la byang chub kyi sems rang gzhan mnyam pa nyid du dmigs pa dang*/ sogs pas byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ g.yo med pa phan pa'i sems dang*/ khong khro med cing mi 'tshe (93ba)ba'i sems dang*/ pha ma dang*/ phu nu dang*/ grogs po dang*/ gnyen dang*/ dus gcig pa'i sems kyis dmigs pa ste drod kyi rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do// bdag nyid sdig pa las zlog cing sbyin pa la sogs phar phyin la gnas pas sems can gzhan yang de dag la ni 'god pa dang*/

de ltar sgrub pa la bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ de sgrub pa rnams dang sems mthun pa nyid rnams ni rtse mor gyur pa'i 'o// rtse mor gnyis don la brtson pa de bzhin du bzod pa'i tshe ni rang gzhan gnyis kar brten pa can te rang gi bden bzhir dmigs pa bzhin gzhan yang de shes pa la 'god pa dang*/ 'bras bu bzhi dang skyon med pa'i theg chen gyi shes pa bskyed pa'i rang bzhin can no// chos mchog kyang snga ma de dag bzhin du rang gis sems can rnams smin par byed pa dang*/ sogs kyi sgras sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa/ mngon shes dang rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes bskyed pa/ chos phun sum tshogs pa/ dam chos gnas pa 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang de la sbyor zhing der gnas pa la legs pa brjod pa sogs yin par shes par bya'o// mdo ni/ sems can rnams kyi drung du sems mnyam pa nyid du gnas par bya'o// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa zhar byung ni/ 'dir skabs dang po drug tu sbyor mthong sgom pa'i lam ci rigs par gsungs pa ni zlos par mi 'gyur te/ dang po gsum du ni gzhi lam rnam pa gsum skye med kyi lta ba'i cha nas dang*/ phyi ma gsum ni dbang thob phyir dang thob nas dang brtan pa thob phyir sgom pa spyod pa phyin drug (94na)gi cha nas bzhag pa'o// yang na zlos pa la/ sgra zlos/ don zlos/ skyon can/ skyon med bzhi las/ 'di ni skyon med de/ gdul bya gzhan dang gzhan la brten nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyogs kyis glang pos kyang*/ slar yang don gzhan la brten nas/ don dam nyid ni bzlas pa yin/ zhes pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa rten phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag bshad pa la/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam thob pa nyid nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byed pa las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur zhing de'i phyir gsungs pa/ nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste// mthong dang sgom pa'i lam dag la//

byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gnas// de 'dir phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// zhes pa ste/ 'di dag la tshul gsum tshad mas nges pa sogs rtog ge'i rtags kyis rnam gzhag byar med cing*/ mthar thug 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyu tshogs yod pa tsam gyis bzhag pa'ang min la/ des na 'dir bstan gyi rtags de rnams rjes thob tu mthong ba las gang zag de'i rgyud la rdzogs byang gi rgyu bar ma chad du yod par dpog pa'am/ lung la brten nas nges pa bskyed pa yin no// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ sbyor/ mthong*/ sgom/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags so// dang po sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags la bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog sogs rtags// rnam pa nyi shur brjod pa yis// nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i// phyir (94ba)mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid 'di// zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang*// the tshom mi dal zad pa dang*// bdag nyid dge ba la gnas shing*// gzhan dag de la 'god pa dang*// gzhan gyi rten can sbyin sogs dang*// zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med// byams lus sogs dang sgrib pa ni// rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs dang*// bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang*// dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang*// gos la sogs pa gtsang ba dang*// lus la srin bu rnams mi 'byung*// gya gyu med sems sbyangs pa dang*// len dang ser sna med sogs dang*// chos nyid ldan par 'gro nyid dang*// sems can don du dmyal 'tshol dang*// gzhan gyis dkri bar mi btub dang*// lam gzhan nye bar ston bdud la// bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa dang*// sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa ste// zhes pas bstan/ dang po gzugs la sogs la dngos por zhen pa las ldog par byed pa dang*/ gnyis pa lta ba ngan pa la bzang po yin nam snyam pa'i the tshom zad pa dang*/ gsum pa ngan song gsum/

kla klo// 'bras bu che ba'i lha'i nang nas 'du shes med pa pa lha tshe ring po/ rgyu 'bras khyad gsod pa'i log lta can/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang 'khor rnam bzhis stongs pa/ don mi go ba lkugs pa ste mi dal ba brgyad du skye ba zad pa dang*/ bzhi pa bdag nyid dge ba bcu la gnas shing gzhan dag de la 'god pa dang*/ lnga pa gzhan don gyi rten can sbyin sogs spyod pa dang*/ drug pa gshis lugs zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med pa dang*/ bdun pa byams pa dang ldan pa'i lus ngag yid gsum dang sogs pas des skyes pa'i las dang*/ brgyad pa 'dod par 'dun pa dang gnod sems dang gnyid rmugs dang rgod 'gyod dang the tshom ste sgrib pa ni rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs pa dang*/ dgu pa lta ba'i bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang*/ bcu pa spyod lam kun tu dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang ldan pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa gos la sro ma sogs med pa dang sogs pas nad nyung zhing dri nga ba med pas gtsang ba dang rnams ni drod la gnas pa'i 'o// bcu gnyis pa lus la srin bu'i rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rnams mi 'byung ba dang*/ bcu gsum pa dman sems gyi gya gyu med pa'i sems dang*/ bcu bzhi pa bsod snyoms pa/ stan gcig pa/ phyis mi len pa (95na)ste zas kyi gsum/ phyag dar khrod pa/ phying pa pa/ chos gos gsum pa ste gos kyis gsum/ dgon pa pa/ bla gab med pa/ shing drung pa/ dur khrod pa ste gnas kyi bzhi/ tsog pu pa/ gzhi ji bzhin pa ste spyod lam gyi gnyis/ de ltar sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis len pa dang*/ bco lnga pa ser sna med pa dang sogs pas phyin drug mi mthun phyogs bral ba dang*/ bcu drug pa chos nyid kyi yum dang ldan par 'gro ba nyid dang*/ bcu bdun pa sems can gyi don du dmyal ba 'tshol ba dang ste der skyes kyang bag tsha med pa rnams ni rtse mor ro// bco brgyad pa dge bshes las gzhan bdud sprul sogs kyi log par bkri bar mi btub pa dang*/

bcu dgu pa byang lam las gzhan dman lam nye bar ston pa'i bdud la bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa dang gnyis ni bzod par ro// nyi shu pa sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa 'khor gsum mi dmigs pas phar phyin spyod pa ste/ rtags ni nyi shu de dag gis// drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang*// chos mchog rnams la gnas pa ni// rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ldog / ces so// mdo ni/ gzugs las phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems phyir mi ldog par rig par bya'o// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags la bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*// shes pa'i skad cig bcu drug ni// byang chub sems dpa' mi ldog pa'i// mtshan nyid yin par shes (95ba)par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bden bzhir dmigs pa'i bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa dang*// sems brtan theg pa dman dag las// rnam ldog bsam gtan la sogs pa'i// yan lag yongs su zad pa dang*// zhes pas bstan/ gzugs sogs la mtshan ma'i 'du shes ldog pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems brtan pa dang*/ theg pa dman pa'i yid byed dag las rnam par ldog pa dang*/ bsam gtan la sogs pa'i snyoms 'jug thob kyang de dag tu rang dbang med par skye ba'i yan lag yongs su zad pa dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ lus sems yang ba nyid dang ni// 'dod pa spyod la thabs mkhas dang*// rtag tu tshangs par spyod nyid dang*// 'tsho ba rnam par dag nyid dang*// zhes pas bstan/ kun nyon bral bas lus sems ldang ba yang ba nyid dang ni/ 'dod pa'i yon tan la spyod pa'i gnas skabs la yang sbyin sogs thabs mkhas pas zin pa dang*/ rang nyid 'dod yon la ro myang med par rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa nyid dang*/ rin chen phreng bar/ tshul 'chos rnyed dang bkur sti'i phyir// dbang po sdom par byed pa ste// kha bsags rnyed dang bskur sti'i phyir// tshig 'jam par sngar ni smra ba'o// gzhogs slong de ni thob bya'i phyir// gzhan gyis rdzas la bsngags byed pa// thabs kyi 'jal ba rnyed pa'i phyir// mngon sum gzhan la smon byed pa// rnyed pas rnyed pa rnams 'dod pa// sngar thob pa la bsngags pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i log 'tsho lnga dang dbang sdud lung ston sogs mi byed pas 'tsho ba rnam par dag pas 'tsho ba nyid dang bzhi'o//

gsum pa ni/ phung sogs bar chad byed rnams dang*// tshogs dang dbang sogs bcas pa yi// g.yul 'gyed// ces pas bstan/ phung sogs khams dang skye mched dang bar chad byed pa rgyal po rkun po la sogs pa rnams kyi gtam dang*/ grong gi tshogs kyi gtam dang*/ kun nyon gyi dbang po dang sogs pas shes pa dang yul gyi gtam dang bcas (96na)pa dang*/ dmag gi g.yul 'gyed pa'i gtam la sbyor sogs bkag pa bzhi'o// bzhi pa ni/ ser sna la sogs la// sbyor dang rjes su sbyor ba yi// gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*// chos ni rdul tsam mi dmigs nyid// rang gi sa la nges pa nyid// sa gsum la ni gnas pa dang*// chos kyi don du srog gtong ba// de 'dra'i skad cig bcu drug ni// blo ldan mthong ba'i lam gnas kyi// phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin// zhes pas bstan/ sbyin sogs kyi mi mthun phyogs ser sna la sogs kyi gtam la dang por sbyor ba dang rjes su rgyun du sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa ste mi smra ba dang*/ kun rdzob pa'i chos ni don du grub par rdul phran tsam yang mi dmigs pa nyid dang*/ rang gi sa dang po la ni gnas par nges pa nyid dang*/ bar chad med pa rnam grol khyad par lam ste rang sa'i lam gsum la ni gnas pa dang*/ dam chos gnas phyir sogs kyi don du rang gi srog kyang gtong phod pa ste bzhi'o// de 'dra'i skad cig bcu drug la gnas pa'i mtshan ma ni/ blo ldan mthong ba'i lam gnas kyi// phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin// mdo ni/ gzugs kyi 'du shes las phyir ldog go /zhes sogs so// 'dir dbang sogs las 'phros nas dbang po bshad na/ dbye ba/ sa gang na yod pa/ spong tshul/ yul lo// dang po la/ rnam byang dang kun nas nyon mongs kyi dbang po gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa'i rnam dag la dbang byed pa dad sogs lnga/ zag med kyi rnam dag la dbang byed pa sbyor lam gyi tshe'i dad sogs lnga ste mi shes pa kun shes pa'i dbang po/

'phags pa slob pa'i de lnga ste kun shes pa'i dbang po/ mi slob pa'i de lnga ste kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po dang brgyad do// gnyis pa ni/ 'bras bu nyer spyod la dbang byed pa bde ba/ sdug bsngal/ yid bde/ yid mi bde/ btang snyoms ste (96ba)tshor ba'i dbang po lnga/ yul la dbang byed pa sgo lnga yid dbang dang drug /lus gnas par dbang byed pa srog gi dbang po/ skye bar dbang byed pa pho mo'i dbang po gnyis dang bcu bzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'dod par kun nyon gyi dbang po thams cad yod/ de las gzugs na pho mo sdug bsngal yid mi bde med/ gzugs med na srog yid btang snyoms gsum yod pa'o// dbang rten ni/ 'dod par rdul rdzas brgyad ka yod/ gzugs na dri ro ma gtogs pa yod/ gzugs med na srog la brten pa'o// gsum pa ni/ zag bcas kyi cha rnams te/ yid dbang*/ sems bde/ yid bde/ btang snyoms bzhi la mthong spangs sgom spangs spang bya min pa gsum gsum du yod/ yid mi bde la mthong spangs sgom spangs gnyis yod/ sgo lnga pho mo srog sdug bsngal gyi dbang po rnams sgom spangs kho na yin no// dad sogs zag bcas dang theg chen ltar na zag bcas mi shes pa kun shes kyi dbang po yang sgom spangs yin no// dbang rten ni brgyad ka sgom spangs so// bzhi pa ni/ 'dod par yul drug /gzugs na dri ro ma gtogs pa/ gzugs med na chos kho na yod pa'o// gsum pa sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags la/ spyir lam gyi rang bzhin/ de sgom pa'i tshul/ bye brag sgom lam gyi dbye ba/ gong 'phel du 'gyur ba la rtsod spangs/ rgyu 'bras la rtsod spong ngo*// dang po spyir lam gyi rang bzhin ni/ sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste// zab mo stong pa nyid la sogs// zab pa de ni sgro 'dogs dang*// skur ba'i mtha' las grol ba nyid// ces pas bstan/ byang 'phags rnams kyi sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa yin te/

mdor (97na)byang sems gang la gnas nas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rdzogs par byed pa'i gnas ni zab mo ste/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa dang*/ 'du bya ba med pa dang skye ba med pa dang 'dod chags dang bral ba 'gog pa dang myang 'das dang zhi ba dang de bzhin nyid dang yang dag pa'i mtha' dang chos kyi tshig bla dwags so// zhes gsungs pa'i glo bur dri ma'i gnas med pa'i zab mo stong pa nyid la sogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhi dang 'bras bu dang theg pa yang 'di yin no// zab mo de ni mdor gzugs sogs las kyang bzlog /mya ngan las 'das par yang bstan zhes pa'i don/ chos dbyings zab mo de ni dngos po yin par sgro 'dogs pa dang myang 'das min pa'i skur pa'i mtha' las grol ba nyid yin te/ de blo rnam shes kyi yul las 'das pas so// gnyis pa de sgom pa'i tshul ni/ nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong ba'i// lam dang sgom pa'i lam nyid la//

yang dang yang du sems pa dang*// 'jal dang nges rtogs sgom pa'i lam// zhes pas bstan/ de lta'i zab mo byang sems kyi sgom tshul ni/ nges 'byed yan lag dang*/ mthong ba'i lam dang*/ sgom pa'i lam nyid la gnas pa'i rim pas snga ma'i tshe zab mo de yang dang yang du sems pa dang*/ gnyis pa'i tshe rang rig pa'i shes rab kyis mngon sum du 'jal ba dang*/ gsum pa'i tshe de nges par rtogs nas sgom pa'i lam rnams so// mdo 'og nas thon/ gsum pa bye brag sgom lam gyi dbye ba ni/ de ni rgyun chags yin pa'i phyir// chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams// chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis// rnam pas rnam pa dgur bzhed do// grangs med la sogs bstan ba rnams// dam pa'i don du bzod ma yin// kun rdzob tu ni thugs brtse ba'i// rgyu mthun de dag thub pa bzhed// ces pas bstan/ rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings mngon gsum du rtogs rjes phye na/ rang rig pa'i ye shes de ni gdod nas rgyun chags su yod pa'i rtag pa yin pa'i (97ba)phyir/ de la sgrib pa'i dri ma cung zad bral ba cher bral ba ches cher bral bas ye shes je gsal du gyur pa'i cha nas dbye ba ste/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams// chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis// rnam pas rnam pa dgur bzhed do// mdo ni/ zab mo 'di dag yang yang sems pa dang 'jal ba dang rtog par byed na grangs med tshad med dpag tu med pa'i dge ba 'phel/ zhes so// 'di las 'phros pa mdor/ grangs ma mchis pa sogs la bye brag ni ci mchis zhes zhus pa'i lan gyi don ni/ grangs med la sogs bstan pa rnams// ming tsam ste/ dam pa'i don du bzod ma yin// mdo ni/ chos nyid de dag la don dang yi ges tha dad du bya ba mi dmigs/ zhes so// 'on kyang kun rdzob tu ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs brtse ba chen po'i rgyu mthun gyi rten 'brel las bsod nams brjod du med pa 'byung ba de dag la dgongs nas gsungs par thub pa bzhed de/

brjod du med pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rgyu mthun gyi bstan pa'o// zhes so// bzhi pa gong 'phel du 'gyur ba rtsod spangs la/ dogs pa/ lan no// dang po dogs pa ni/ dngos po brjod du med pa la// nyams pa dang ni 'phel mi rung*// sgom zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni// ci zhig nyams shing ci zhig thob// ces pas bstan/ dngos po'i gnas tshul chos dbyings ni brjod du med cing 'dus ma byas pa la nyams pa dang ni 'phel ba mi rung ba'i phyir/ de'i rang bzhin can bsgom bya zhes bya ba'i lam gyi ni spang bya ci zhig nyams shing gnyen po ci zhig thob ste mi thob par thal zhes so// mdo ni/ brjod du ma mchis pa'i don la 'phel 'grib (98na)med na des sbyin sogs 'phel 'grib med par 'gyur ro// zhes so// gnyis pa lan ni/ byang chub ji ltar de bzhin du// 'di ni 'dod pa'i don sgrub byed// byang chub de bzhin nyid mtshan nyid// de yang de yi mtshan nyid bzhed// ces pas bstan/ de lta'i skyon med de// 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis ji ltar gdul bya'i don sgrub pa de bzhin du/ chos dbyings 'dis kyang ni gdul bya'i mngon rtogs 'phel ba dang spang bya zad pa'i 'dod pa'i don sgrub par byed cing*/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'bras bu byang chub kyang de bzhin nyid de'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin nyid kyang byang chub de'i mtshan nyid de de gnyis gcig pa'i phyir de ltar bzhed do// mdo ni/ chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid ji lta ba de bzhin du bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ zhes so// lnga pa rgyu 'bras rtsod spong la/ rtsod pa/ lan no// dang po rtsod pa ni/ 'o na don dam par chos dbyings dang byang chub gcig mod/ kun rdzob tu sangs rgyas kyi rgyu la'ang mi rigs pa mthong ste/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu sems bskyed kyi ni skad cig snga ma phyi ma dang phyi ma snga ma dang mi 'grogs pas dge ba'i tshogs mi 'byung la de med par 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i phyir zhes pa'i don/

sems ni snga mas byang chub par// rigs min phyi mas kyang ma yin// zhes so// mdo ni/ sems dang po skyes pa ni slad ma skyes pa dang mi 'grogs zhes sogs so// gnyis pa lan la/ dpes lan 'phang ba/ de las skyes ba'i sgom lam pa'i rtags bshad pa'o// dang po dpes lan 'phang ba ni/ mar me'i dpe yi tshul gyis ni// zhes pas bstan/ sems skad cig re re nas byang chub mi bskyed na yang de dag phan tshun ltos pa las kun rdzob tu rten 'byung gi skye ba tsam yod de/ de yang mar me'i (98ba)skad cig snga phyi re res sdong bu mi sreg kyang gnyis char ltos pa na sdong bu tshig pa mngon sum du rig pa'i dpe 'di'i tshul gyis ni shes par gyis/ mdo gzhung gis thon no// gnyis pa de las skyes ba'i sgom lam pa'i rtags bshad pa ni/ zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad// skye ba dang ni 'gag pa dang*// de bzhin nyid dang shes bya dang*// shes dang spyod dang gnyis med dang*// thabs mkhas pa la zab pa nyid// ces pas bstan/ don dam pa'i sems bskyed rtogs pa'i de ma thag sgom lam zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad rtogs pa 'byung ngo zhes rnam par bzhag nas bye brag tu brgyad yod pa'i dang po/ rten 'brel gyi skye ba dang ni/ gnyis pa don du kun rdzob ma grub pas 'gag pa dang*/ gsum pa shin tu phra ba'i de bzhin nyid dang*/ bzhi pa bden gnyis kyi gnas tshul shes bya dang*/ lnga pa gnas tshul rtogs pa'i ye shes dang*/ drug pa ci la'ang mi spyod pa'i spyod pa dang*/ bdun pa don du rtogs bya rtogs byed gnyis tha dad med pa dang*/ brgyad pa gdod nas sangs rgyas zin pa slar sangs rgyas su ston pa thabs mkhas pa la zab pa nyid de de rnams rtogs pa'o// mdo ni/ rten cing 'brel 'byung zab pa de ni ngo mtshar ro// zhes sogs so// gsum pa bsgom bya sbyor ba'i ngo bo la/ chos sku'i rgyu srid zhi mnyam nyid/

longs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa/ phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba'o// dang po la/ spyi gzhung gnyis/ dang po spyi don ni/ 'di'i 'khor ba ni 'khrul snang sna tshogs myang 'das ni de'i rang bzhin stong nyid yin la/ mnyam nyid kyi tshul ni/ yul de bzhin nyid gcig la yul can 'khrul pas dmigs na srid pa ma 'khrul bas dmigs na zhi ba 'byung ba yin gyi/ don du yul gyi rang bzhin de gnyis ka ma yin pas gnyis kar mi (99na)rtog pa'o// de sgom pa'i sbyor ba ni tshogs lam nas yod de 'dir rnam rdzogs sbyor ba gzhan ma bstan pas so// rgyud la mngon sum 'char ba sa brgyad pa nas so// gnyis pa gzhung don la/ dngos dang*/ klan ka spang ba'o// dang po dngos ni/ chos rnams rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir// srid dang zhi bar mi rtog pa// zhes pas bstan/ yongs su rtogs pa'i chos rnams rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ srid pa yod dngos dang zhi ba med dgag gang du yang mi rtog par sgom pa'o// mdo ni/ sher phyin nyin par sgom pas rnam par 'phel na rmi lam du sgom pas kyang rnam par 'phel lo// de ci'i phyir na/ rmi lam dang nyin par ni rnam par rtog pa med pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa klan ka spang ba ni/ las med la sogs klan ka yi// lan ni ji skad bshad par zad// ces pas bstan/ rmi lam gyi las la 'bras bu mi 'byung ba bzhin rtog bcas kyi dge ba la'ang 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ de gnyis mtshungs pas so snyam na/ las bsog pa dang 'bras bu med pa la sogs pa'i klan ka'i skyon med de/ yongs su rtog pa med na las kyi gnas med pas 'bras bu med la/ sad nas yongs su rtog na rmi lam gyi las la'ang 'bras bu 'byung ngo zhes pa'i lan ni/ mdo las/ ji skad bshad pa der zad cing 'dus pa'i phyir/ mdor dri ba ni rmi lam lta bur gsungs pa de lta na las bsog pa'am 'bri ba med do// lan ni/ dmigs pa med par las mi skye ste zhes dang*/

'on te sad nas rnam par rtog na ni de la bsog pa'am 'bri bar yang 'gyur ro zhes so// gnyis la longs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba ni/ sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du// snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa// de la dag par sgrub pa yis// sangs rgyas zhing ni dag pa nyid// ces pas bstan/ dper na sems can gyi 'jig rten glo bur gyi dri ma rnams de bzhin nyid la 'dre ba med (99ba)pas de khong du chud pa na dri ma 'ja' yal ba ltar 'gyur ba de bzhin 'khrul ngor snang ba'i snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa ngan song sogs de dag la snying rje chen po'i rten 'brel gyi 'khrul pa bsal nas snod dag pa sngar yod gsal bar byas nas sgrub cing sgom pa yis te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing go chod pa ni dag pa'i sems la snang ba nyid do// 'di ni longs sku'i zhing nyid gtso bor gzung ngo*// mdor 'khrul ngor dpes gsungs pa/ sa chen po 'di dag bai ḍūr+ya sngon po'i rgyu las grub pa zhes sogs so// gsum pa phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba la/ rtsa ba shes rab/ de snying rjes zin pas thabs mkhas su 'gyur tshul lo// dang po rtsa ba shes rab ni/ yul dang sbyor ba can 'di ni// zhes pas bstan/ yul sher phyin de bzhin nyid skye 'gag med pa dang yul can rang rig pa'i ye shes gnyis yongs su sbyor ba can srid zhi mnyam nyid du rtogs pa 'di ni zhes ngos bzung ba'o// mdo ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la ji ltar 'dris par bgyi zhes pa'i lan du/ gzugs sogs chos thams cad stong pa'o// zhes sogs so// 'di sgom tshul ni/ stong nyid bag chags goms pa yis// dngos po'i bag chags spong 'gyur zhing*// ci yang med ces goms pa yis// de yang phyis nas spong bar 'gyur// zhes pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa snying rjes zin pas thabs mkhas su 'gyur tshul ni/ dgra rnams las ni 'das pa dang*// mi gnas ji bzhin shugs dang ni//

thun mong ma yin mtshan nyid dang*// ma chags pa dang ma dmigs dang*// mtshan ma smon lam zad pa dang*// de yi rtags dang tshad med pa// thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa bcu// zhes pas bstan/ dang por de yang snying rje chen pos zin pas phung po lnga'i bdud/ 'khor bar 'ching byed nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ 'chi bdag gi bdud/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po lha'i bu'i bdud bzhi'i dgra rnams las ni 'das pa dang*/(100na)gnyis pa zhi ba'i stong nyid la mi gnas pa dang*/ gsum pa dge ba rnams mda' mkhas pas ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'phen pa ltar rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i shugs dang ni/ bzhi pa sems can yal bar mi 'dor ba nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ lnga pa sems can dang lhan cig bag bsres kyang de'i dri ma ma chags pa dang*/ drug pa chos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas ston pa dang*/ bdun pa mtshan mar lta ba zad par byed pa dang*/ brgyad pa 'bras bu la smon par lta ba'i lam zad par byed pa dang*/ dgu pa thabs mkhas dang ldan pa de'i rtags su rgyal bas lung ston pa la mtshan mar mi byed pa dang*/ bcu pa shes bya'i rnam grangs tshad med pa shes pa ste/ re re'i 'jug tu thabs la mkhas pa zhes sbyar bas rnam pa bcu'o// mdo ni/ bdud bzhi dag dang sa gnyis las kyang rab 'das nas/ zhes sogs so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las/ rnam kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// zhes pas bstan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs bzhi pa'i 'grel pa'o/// / gnyis pa de rab tu gyur pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba la/ 'brel bkod pa/ mngon rtogs rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po 'brel bkod pa ni/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba de spang bya'i gnyen por gyur pas rab tu gyur pa yin la dbang thob pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa ste mdor phyir mi ldog gi rtags gsungs pa'i don no// rtse sbyor gyi gong du rnam kun thams cad sngon du 'gro mi dgos (100ba)te/

lam rang rang gi gnas skabs na spang gnyen du ma gyur pa dang gyur pa'i cha nas bzhag pas so// gnyis pa mngon rtogs rgyas par bshad pa la/ sbyor/ mthong*/ sgom/ bar chad med lam gyi rtse sbyor ro// dang po la/ drod/ rtse/ bzod/ mchog gi rtse sbyor/ dang po drod ni/ rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun// rmi lam lta bur lta la sogs// zhes pas bstan/ rtags kyi sgo nas bstan pa ste/ nyin par chos rnams snang stong du mos pa'i mthus/ rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun rmi lam lta bur lta ba sogs dang*/ dman sems la dga' ba mi skye ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos ston pa dang*/ des sprul pa 'gyed pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi gtser ba'i sems can la rang gis chos ston pa dang*/ ngan song mthong na rang sangs rgyas pa'i zhing du 'di dag med par sbyang ngo snyam pa'i sems skye ba drug ni rmi ltas so// me'i gnod pa sogs la bdag phyir mi ldog yin na zhi bar gyur cig ces pa'i bden tshig gis zhi nus pa dang*/ de ltas mi ma yin gyi gnod pa sel nus pa dang*/ phyi nang gi rkyen gyis mi brdzi ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ rtag par yum la slob pa dang*/ chos kun la mngon zhen med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la nye ba ste drug ni sad pa'i rtags so// de ltar drod kyi mnyam bzhag / rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba'i rtags// rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed// mdo ni/ rmi lam na'ang chos thams cad rmi lam 'dra ba nyid du lta'o// zhes so// gnyis pa rtse mo ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo snyed// sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dge la sogs// rnam mang du ni dper mdzad nas// rnam 'phel bcu drug bdag nyid do// zhes pas bstan/ bsod nams 'phel ba'i sgo nas te/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo ji snyed sangs rgyas su gyur pa (101na)la 'ga' zhig gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mchod pa'i dge ba dang*/ la sogs pas stong gsum gyi skye bo de snyed sangs rgyas su gyur pa la mchod pa gnyis/

'dzam gling gi sems can ji snyed/ bsam gzugs sogs 'jig rten pa'i phun tshogs/ rgyun zhugs/ phyir 'ong*/ phyir mi 'ong*/ dgra bcom/ rang byang chub/ bla med byang chub la bkod pa'i dge ba bdun/ stong gsum gyi sems can ji snyed de dang de dag tu bkod pa'i dge ba bdun te dge ba bcu drug gi rnam pa mang du bstan pa ni dper mdzad nas/ rtse mo'i mnyam gzhag ni dpe de dang de dag las rnam par 'phel ba'i bsod nams bcu drug gi bdag nyid do// mdo gzhung gis gsal lo// gsum pa bzod pa ni/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams kyi// yongs su rdzogs pa bla med pa// sems can don yongs ma gtong ba// brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brjod// ces pas bstan/ yum las mi ldog pa brtan pa'i sgo nas te/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum gyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi rnam pa ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i dge ba bla na med pa dang sems can gzhan gyi don yongs su mi gtong bas nyan rang du mi ldog pa nyid dang ldan pas bzod pa'i mnyam gzhag la brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brjod do// mdo ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /ces so//

bzhi pa chos mchog ni/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dag dang*// stong gnyis gsum dag dper mdzad nas// bsod nams mang po nyid kyi ni// ting 'dzin yongs su bsgrags pa yin// zhes pas bstan/ skye med gsum la gnas pa'i rang bzhin te/ gling bzhi pa dang de stong dag ni stong spyi phud de stong la stong gnyis bar ma dang de stong la stong gsum mi mjed de/ de dag skra rtse tsam du bsil ba'i tshad kyang gzung nus pa srid kyi rjes su yi rang dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa'i bsod nams ni tshad med (101ba)do zhes bya ba dag dper mdzad nas bsod nams mang po nyid kyi ni chos mchog gi ting nge 'dzin ni yongs su bsgrags pa yin no// mdo ni/ de dag gi rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa'i bsod nams la ni tshad med do// zhes so// gnyis pa mthong lam rtse sbyor la/ spang bya/ gnyen po'o// dang po la/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po la/ gzung 'dzin gnyis/ dang po gzung ba ni/ 'jug pa dang ni ldog pa la// gzung ba'i rnam rtog so sor de// dgu yi bdag nyid ji bzhin yul// min pa'i bdag nyid dag shes bya// zhes pas bstan/ 'jug pa'i yul theg chen gyi lam 'bras dang ni ldog pa'i yul theg dman gyi lam 'bras la blang dor du 'dzin pa ni gzung ba'i rnam rtog gnyis so// de gnyis so sor yul de'i dbye bas dgu dgu'i bdag nyid du yod la/ 'khrul pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de thams cad kyang gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin gyi yul la dmigs pa min pas yul can de dag kyang phyin ci log pa'i blo'i bdag nyid dag tu shes par bya'o// mdo ni/ gnyis med pa'i 'du shes su mi 'gyur ba de ltar bsngo bar bya'o// zhes dang*/ yum rnam par mi rtog pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa 'dzin pa ni/ so so'i skye bo 'phags dbye bas// sems can rdzas dang btags yod par// rnam rtog 'dzin pa dag tu 'dod// de dag so sor dgu bdag nyid//

gal te gzung don de bzhin nyid// de dag gang gi 'dzin par 'dod// de ltar de dag 'dzin pa yi// ngo bos stong ba'i mtshan nyid do// zhes pas bstan/ so so skye bo dang 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i dbye bas/ chos kyi bdag gi gdags gzhi sems can te gnyis snang can gyi sems la/ snga mas rdzas su zhen pa dang phyi mas btags yod tsam du zhen pa'i rnam par rtog pa ni 'dzin rtog dag tu 'dod cing de dag kyang so sor yul gyis sgo nas dgu dgu'i bdag nyid do// 'khrul pa'i don ni/ gal te rdzas btags gang rung du gzung ba'i don yul de med pa bzhin du rtog pa de dag yul gang gis 'dzin par 'dod pa de mi rung ste/ gzung yul (102na)don la med na de ltar 'dzin pa 'khrul pa las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ des na de dag kyang 'dzin pa'i rang gis ngo bos stong pa'i mtshan nyid do// mdo ni/ gzugs dben pa'i phyir sems can dben pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa la'ang gzung 'dzin gnyis/ dang po la/ 'jug yul/ ldog yul lo// dang po 'jug yul ni/ ngo bo nyid dang rigs dang ni// lam ni yang dag 'grub pa dang*// shes pa'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul dang*// mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dang*// rang gis rtogs dang byed pa dang*// de yi las bya'i 'bras bu la// 'jug pa'i phyogs kyi rten can gyi// rnam rtog de ni rnam dgur 'dod// ces pas bstan/ yul byang chub kyi ngo bo nyid dang*/ de la dmigs pa'i theg chen gyi rigs zag med kyi ye shes dang ni/ des lam ni yang dag 'grub pa dang*/ shes pa mnyam gzhag gi dmigs yul kun rdzob med pas ma 'khrul ba dang*/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po la 'dor len dang*/ byang sems rang gis rtogs pa dang*/ rang don spong bar byed pa dang*/ de'i las gzhan don sgrub pa dang*/ bya ba'i 'bras bu tshogs gnyis la 'jug pa'i phyogs kyi dgu yod pas/ de'i rten can te yul can gyi rnam rtog de ni rnam dgur 'dod/

mdo ni/ gnyen po mi rtog pa'i sgo nas gsungs pa ste/ yum shin tu dben pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ldog yul ni/ srid dang zhi bar ltung ba'i phyir// rtogs pa dman pa nyid dang ni// yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang*// lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang dang*// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro ba dang*// ched du bya ba log pa dang*// nyi tshe ba dang sna tshogs nyid// gnas dang 'jug la rmongs pa dang*// rjes la 'gro zhes bya ba la// rnam rtog dgu yi bdag nyid 'di// ldog pa'i phyogs kyi rten can te// nyan thos la sogs yid las byung*// zhes pas bstan/ yul srid dang zhi bar lhung ba'i phyir/ nyan rang gi rtogs pa dman pa nyid dang ni/ thabs mkhas kyi yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam gyi rnam pa phal cher ma tshang ba dang*/ slar yang theg chen du rang stobs kyis min par gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro dgos pa dang*/ ched du gnyer bar bya ba'i 'bras bu rnam mkhyen la log pa dang*/ spangs pa nyi tshe ba dang*/ rtogs pa mtshan (102ba)'dzin sna tshogs can nyid dang*/ rnam mkhyen la gnas pa dang de'i sgo nas gzhan don la 'jug pa la rmongs pa dang*/ sbyin sogs lnga sher phyin gyi rjes la 'gro ba zhes bya ba la/ rnam rtog dgu'i bdag nyid 'di// ldog pa'i phyogs kyi rten can te// nyan thos la sogs yid la 'byung*// mdo ni/ nyi zlas gling bzhir las byed cing rjes su 'brang ba'i dpes so// gnyis pa 'dzin pa la/ rdzas dang btags par 'dzin pa'o// dang po rdzas 'dzin ni/ 'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang*// yid la byed dang khams rnams ni// gsum po dag dang nyer 'brel dang*// gnas dang mngon par zhen pa dang*// chos kyi dngos po btags pa dang*// chags pa dang ni gnyen po dang*// ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gro nyams la// 'dzin pa dang por shes par bya// zhes pas bstan/ yul gzugs sogs 'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang*/

de dag yid la byed pa dang*/ des na sems sems byung rnams khams rnams ni gsum po dag dang nyer 'brel ba dang*/ gzugs sogs la bden 'dzin gyi gnas pa dang*/ de la mngon par zhen pa dang*/ chos kyi dngos po med pa la rdzas su btags pa dang*/ 'khor gsum la zhen pa'i chags pa dang ni de'i gnyen po rnams la'ang rdzas su 'dzin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sar ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gro ba las nyams pa ste/ dgu po rnams la rdzas su dmigs pa'i rtog pa ni 'dzin pa dang por shes par bya'o// mdo ni/ yum ni chos gang yang yongs su 'dzin pa'am gtong ba med do// zhes so// gnyis pa btags 'dzin ni/ ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung dang*// lam la lam min nges 'dzin dang*// 'gag dang bcas pa'i skye ba dang*// dngos po ldan dang mi ldan dang*// gnas dang rigs ni 'jig pa dang*// don du gnyer dang rgyu med dang*// phyir rgol ba ni dmigs pa la// 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan yin no// zhes pas bstan/ yul can rang gi ched du dmigs pa bzhin rnam mkhyen du nges par mi 'byung ba dang*/ dman lam la rang lam min par nges par 'dzin pa dang*/ rgyu 'gag pa dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu skye ba dang*/ btags pa'i dngos po ldan pa dang rdzas kyi dngos po mi ldan pa dang*/ des gzugs sogs la gnas pa (103na)'jig pa dang*/ nyan rang gi rigs ni 'jig pa dang*/ phyin drug don du gnyer ba dang*/ don du rgyu lam med pa dang*/ yum spyod pa la phyir rgol ba'i bdud rnams ni btags pa tsam du dmigs pa dgu la 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan yin no// mdo ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid gang na ba der lam mnyam pa nyid nas 'gro'o// zhes so// gnyis pa gnyen po la bral 'bras byang chub/ bral byed mthong lam nyid bshad pa'o// dang po la/ thob pa'i rgyu/ byang chub ngos bzung ba'o// dang po thob pa'i rgyu ni/ byang chub la gzhan ston pa dang*// de yi rgyu ni yongs gtong dang*//

de thob bar chad med pa'i rgyu// bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyid dang*// ces pas bstan/ gnyis zhen gyi dri ma bral byed rang bzhin rnam dag mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rgyu gsum ni/ byang chub thob par 'gyur ba la gzhan lung ston pa dang*/ de'i rgyu sher phyin ni gzhan la yongs su gtod pa dang*/ de thob pa'i bar chad med pa'i rgyu'am lam rang rig rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dmigs med kyi snying rje dang ldan pas bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyid can mthong lam rnams so// mdo ni/ byang sems de dag ni dka' ba bgyid pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa byang chub ngos bzung ba la/ dngos kyi don/ de la klan ka spang*/ de sgom tshul lo// dang po dngos kyi don ni/ dri ma zad dang mi skye ba'i// ye shes byang chub ces brjod de// zad med skye med phyir de dag /go rim bzhin du shes par bya// zhes pas bstan/ dri ma med nges yin par rtogs pa zad pa dang ye shes skye 'gag gnas pa dang bral bar rtogs pa mi skye ba ste/ de gnyis mngon du gyur pa'i ye shes la byang chub ces brjod do// chos sku thob pa tsam yin la sgom lam du gnyis snang rim pas 'gags pas chos sku rim pa (103ba)rdzogs byed do// de yang gnas tshul la zhugs te/ yul can nad kyi 'khrul bas yul dung la ser por mthong zhing*/ nad sangs na dkar po nyid mthong mod/ yul dung steng du ser po zad pa dang dkar po gsar skyes med pa ltar/ dri ma zad pa med ye shes skye ba med pa'i phyir/ don de dag go rim bzhin du dpe de ltar shes par bya'o// mdo ni/ yum ni ma zad mi zad zad par mi 'gyur/ zhes so// gnyis pa de klan ka spang ba la/ dogs pa dang*/ lan no// dang po dogs pa ni/ dri ma bden dngos zhig gnyen po gsar skye zhig gis bcom pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na byang chub thob pa'i tha snyad mi rung snyam du dngos smra ba'i blo la 'char ba'o//

gnyis pa lan ni/ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni// rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad// skye med rnam pa ci zhig 'thob// gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la// shes bya la yang ston pa yi// sgrib pa zad par brjod pa gang*// de la kho bo'i mtshar du rtsis// zhes pas bstan/ gnas tshul la de lta ma yin te/ dri ma 'gog pa'i rtsol ba med pa'i kun gzhi'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'di la/ rang ngo mthong ba zhes bya ba'i lam gyi ni/ spang bya rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad par byas shing gsar du skye med kyi rnam pa ci zhig thob par byas pa ma yin te/ gnyid sad pa na rmi lam mi 'byung ba dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar thugs rje chen po bstan pa'i mdor/ zad pa gnyen pos zad pa min// sngon nas zad pas de phyir zad// ces so// rgyud blar yang*/ ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin// 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do// zhes so// tshul de las gzhan sgrib byed kyi chos rnams kyang bden par yod par 'dod la/ rang lugs shes bya khas (104na)len la yang ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sgrib pa sa bon dang bcas pa zad par yang brjod pa gang 'gal bar smra ba'i grub mtha' de la kho bos mtshar du brtsis zhes thugs khrel ba'o// de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ bden grub yin na spong mi nus te/ rtsa sher/ rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba ni// nam yang 'thad par mi 'gyur ro// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// gsum la sgom tshul ni/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol// zhes pas bstan/ theg gsum gyi byang chub la rim 'jug gi dbang du byas na/ nyan thos kyi lta ba/ rang rgyal gyi lta ba/ dbu ma'i lta ba gsum mo// dang po ni/ phung po'i steng gi bdag 'dzin dang bral bas nyon sgrib las grol ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan med par rtogs pas gzung 'dzin rags pa dang bral ba'o// gsum pa ni/

byang sems kyi gnyis zhen mtha' dag 'gog cing bsgoms pas gnyis snang gi shes pa yang nub par 'gyur bas chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'o// de yang*/ yod min med min yod med min// gnyis ka'i bdag nyid min pa'ang min// mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba// de ni dbu ma pa yis rig /ces so// 'di'i don bshad pa la lugs gnyis kyi nang nas thal rang gi dbu ma rang stong smra ba dag gis/ de bzhin nyid la 'dzin pa mi rung ba'i sgo nas bshad de/ de dag gang du gzung yang gnyis 'dzin las ma 'das pas so// zhes zer/ rje btsun dang thogs med mched rang lugs kyi gtso bor ni/ de bzhin (104ba)nyid gnyis snang gi yul du mi 'ong bas de la bden 'dzin byung dogs med kyi/ gzhung 'dis kun rdzob thams cad ri bong gi rwa ltar yod med gnyis ka gnyis min sogs gang du yang med pa de nyid ngo sprod pa'i don yin no// rgyur blar/ sems de rang bzhin 'od gsal bas na nyon mongs ngo bo med gzigs pa// zhes so// des na snying po dag pa gzhan dbang kun gzhi'i ye shes 'di la dri ma med pa'i phyir bsal bya ci yang med cing thog ma med pa'i dus can yin pas ye shes gsar du bzhag par bya ba cung zad med kyi/ 'o na ji ltar sgom na/ yang dag pa'i don rang sems nyid la rang gis yang dag par lta ba'i tshul gyis bsgom mo// de tshe gnyis 'dzin thams cad nub nas blta bya lta byed gnyis med pa'i yang dag pa'i don mngon sum du mthong na mthong lam thob pa yin pas rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro// mdo sdud par/ skye med zad pa med par shes rab 'di shes te/ nyi ma sprin med/ ces so// lang gshegs las/ sems tsam la ni brten nas su// phyi rol don du mi rtog go /snang ba med pa la brten nas// sems tsam las ni 'da' bar bya// yang dag dmigs pa la brten nas// snang ba med las 'da' bar bya// zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no//
