gnyis pa bral byed mthong lam nyid bshad pa la/ spang gnyen dngos bar chad med lam/ gzhi'i gnyen po rnam par grol ba'i lam/ thag sring ba'i gnyen po khyad par gyi lam mo// (105na)dang po spang gnyen dngos bar chad med lam ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re rer ni// de dag phan tshun bsdus pa gang*// skad cig gcig pa'i bzod pa yis// bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam// zhes pas bstan/ sbyor lam gyi skabs su mthong spangs rnam par sun dbyung nas/ sa bon spong byed ni/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin re rer ni/ rang rang ma gtogs pa'i phar phyin lnga po de dag phan tshun bsdus pa'i ye shes gang yin pa de mthong lam skad cig ma gcig pa'i bzod pa bzhi yis bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam mo// mdo ni/ sbyin sogs phar phyin re re la gnas shing gzhan lnga yongs su 'dzin/ zhes so// gnyis pa gzhi'i gnyen po rnam par grol ba'i lam ni/ bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa ni dngos yin la shes pa gzhan rnams kyang rjes mthun pa'o// gsum pa thag sring ba'i gnyen po khyad par gyi lam ni/ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i// ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas// rten cing 'brel 'byung lugs mthun dang*// lugs mi mthun la rtog par byed// ces pas bstan/ mthong lam thob pa des na/ bsam gtan dang po nas 'gog pa'i bar 'gog pa nas bsam gtan dang po'i bar te sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rjes thob tu rten cing 'brel 'byung lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun la rtog par byed do// mdo ni/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug go /zhes dang*/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed ces so sor rtog go /zhes so//

'dir rten 'brel gyi mtha' dpyad pa la/ dbye gzhi/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ gang zhig yod pa ma mthong med mthong ba// 'di 'dra'i mun nag rnam pa ci zhig kwa /zhes pa'i gnyis snang ma rig pa nyon mongs can min pa'o// 'di ni 'khor ba ste ye nas med pas thog mtha' gang yang don la med cing tha snyad du/ thog med gyur kyang mtha' ma dang ldan pa// (105ba)zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ rkyen la rten cing rgyu 'bras ma 'chol bar 'byung ba'o// gsum pa la so sor dbye ba/ rnam gzhag bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'khrul ngor rgyu 'bras mi zad par 'khor ba ste/ nyon mongs can gyi ma rig pa la/ mthong spangs dang sgom spangs gnyis/ dang po bden pa la rmongs pa ste drug yid kho na'i 'khor du 'byung ba'o// gnyis pa la nyon yid 'khor dang drug yid 'khor du 'byung ba gnyis/ phyi ma la'ang bden pa la rmongs pa dang yul la rmongs pa gnyis/ de las rten 'brel gyi skabs 'dir gsungs pa ni phyi ma ste/ des yang srid 'phen byed kyi kun slong byed pa'i phyir/ 'du byed ni des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag yid kyi las so// rnam shes ni las de'i sa bon kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi steng du gnas pa dang de 'bras mngal du nying mtshams sbyar ba'i skabs so// ming gzugs ni de nas phung po gzhan bzhi 'grub pa'o// skye mched drug ni de rnams so sor dod pa'o// reg pa ni yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus nas yul gyi 'gyur ba gcod pa ste mig nas yid kyi 'dus reg drug go /tshor ba ni reg pa las sim gdung bar mar myong ba ste lus tshor sems tshor gnyis so// sred pa ni tshor ba bde sdug la blang dor du chags pa ste khams gsum la sred pa gsum mo// len pa ni de dag 'tshol ba la 'dun pa ste/ 'dod yon la chags pa lta log re gnyis tshul khrims brtul zhugs la rlom pa bdag la chags (106na)pa ste nyer len bzhi'o// srid pa ni de gnyis kyi kun gzhi'i steng gi las kyi sa bon sad nas nus pa mthu can du gyur pa ste/

sngon dus kyi srid pa skye srid 'chi srid bar srid bzhi'o// skye ba ni yang skye gnas su 'jug pa nas tshor ba'i bar te sgo nga mngal drod gsher rdzus skyes bzhi'o// rga shi ni tshe dbang po gzugs stobs dran pa shes rab bde ba 'gyur ba dang dus dang dus min du shi ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ ma rig 'gag pa nas rga shi 'gags pa'i bar rnam byang gi rten 'brel lo// yan lag bcu gnyis po 'di ni mngal skyes kyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ de las dang po gnyis tshe sngon/ tha ma gnyis tshe phyi ma/ lhag ma rnams da ltar gyi skabs yin la/ bsdu na/ dang po brgyad pa dgu nyon mongs// gnyis pa bcu pa las yin te// lhag ma bdun ni sdug bsngal yin// zhes pa ltar ro// gsum pa sgom lam rtse sbyor la/ gnyen po'i sgom lam/ spang bya rtog pa/ brten la yon tan no// dang po la/ spyi gzhung gnyis/ dang po la/ gnyen po thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug /des spang bya spong tshul lo// dang po gnyen po thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug ni/ sgom spangs kyi sa bon mgo gnon par byed pa'i sbyor ba seṅge rnam bsgyings pa sngon du song nas/ drungs 'byin byed bar chad med lam dngos gzhi thod rgal la chung ngu ni sgom tshul seṅge rnam bsgyings dang 'dra la/ 'bring ni bsam gtan dang po las langs nas 'gog par 'jug de nas gnyis par te de ltar mthar gnas brgyad dang 'gog pa spel (106ba)zhing 'gog pa las srid rtse'i sems kyis ldang zhing langs rjes su mnyam bzhag las sad par 'gyur la/ de'i sems tha ma gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i gnas bcu bdun/ chen po ni slar 'gog par zhugs de nas rjes thob tu langs de nas srid rtse yang langs de ltar snyoms 'jug dgu dang rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu spel ba bco brgyad/ yar 'ong phye na sum cu rtsa drug go /thod rgal chung 'bring chen po re rer yang nang gses chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum phye ba ni sa re re'o// de'i sbyor ba seṅge rnam bsgyings pa yang de ltar grangs mnyam du 'gyur zhing snyoms 'jug de dag la ni brten pa tsam yin gyi/

ngo bo ni skabs gnyis par bstan pa'i sgrub pa sgom lam nyid do// gnyis pa de spang bya spang tshul ni/ glo bur rnam dag la sgrib byed gnyis snang can dang des bskyed pa'i gzung 'dzin la btags pa tsam du zhen pa ci rigs yul gyis dgu mtshan bzhir phye ba'i re re la che 'bring chung ngu/ de re rer yang che 'bring chung gsum gsum du phye ba rnams spong ngo*// gnyis pa gzhung don ni/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur// rnam pa gnyis su song 'ongs nas// 'dod par gtogs pa'i rnam par shes// mnyam bzhag min pa'i mtshams bzung ste// thod rgal de ni snyoms 'jug pa// gcig dang gnyis gsum bzhi dang lnga// drug dang bdun dang brgyad brgal nas// 'gog pa'i bar du mi 'drar 'gro// zhes pas bstan/ thod rgal chung ngu ni 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur/ rnam pa gnyis su yar song dang phyir 'ongs nas so// chen po ni/ 'dod par gtogs pa'i rnam par shes pa mnyam gzhag min pa rjes thob kyi mtshams bzung can te/ thod rgal du ni snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshul mthar gnas brgyad kyi gcig dang gnyis gsum bzhi dang lnga/ drug dang bdun dang brgyad la rjes thob dang spel te rgal nas 'gog par 'jug pa de'i bar du (107na)mnyam rjes mi 'dra ba spel mar 'gro ba'o// 'bring ni gzhung gis ma bstan no// mdo ni/ thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug go /zhes so// gnyis pa spang bya rtog pa la gzung 'dzin gnyis/ dang po la/ 'jug ldog gnyis/ dang po 'jug pa ni/ mdor bsdus rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyis// btang bas yongs su ma bzung dang*// dus gsum yon tan med pa dang*// legs pa'i lam ni rnam gsum la// gzung ba'i rnam rtog 'di gcig ste// sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i spyod yul can// zhes pas bstan/ yul gnyis med kyi ye shes mdor bsdus dang chos can spyi'i mtshan nyid rgyas pa dang yum la mi slob pa sangs rgyas kyis btang bas yongs su ma bzung yang slob ma rnams ma btang bas yongs su bzung ba dang*/

yum la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i yon tan med 'dzin las zlog ste dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byung bar rtog pa gsum dang legs pa'i lam ni mos spyod ma dag sa dag sa rnam pa gsum la 'jug byar zhen pa'i rtog pa dgu ni/ gzung ba'i rnam rtog 'di la gnyis yod pa'i dang po gcig ste/ yum la sbyor ba'i dus kyi yul can rnam pa dang spyod pa'i yul yin pas btags pa tsam gyi yul yul can no// mdo ni/ gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid gang zhe na chos thams cad kyi mdo dang rgyas par byed do// zhes so// gnyis pa ldog pa ni/ gnyis pa sems dang sems byung rnams// 'jug pa'i yul can yin bzhed de// sems mi skye dang byang chub kyi// snying po yid la mi byed dang*// theg pa dman pa yid byed dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid mi byed// sgom dang sgom pa med pa dang*// de dag las ni bzlog nyid dang*// ji bzhin don min rnam rtog pa// sgom pa'i lam la shes par bya// zhes pas bstan/ gnyis su snang ba can gyi sems dang sems byung rnams kyang yul la 'jug pa'i yul can gyi rtog pa yin pas spang bya'i gtso bo yin par bcom ldan 'das bzhed cing*/ de la yul byang chub kyi sems mi bskyed pa dang byang chub kyi snying po yum yid la mi byed dang theg pa dman pa yid la byed pa dang chos can rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid la mi byed pa dang rab tu sgom pas rnam mkhyen thob bam snyam pa dang*/ sgom pa med (107ba)pas thob bam snyam pa dang*/ de dag las ni bzlog pa sgoms kyang bsgoms la ma bsgoms kyang ma bsgoms pas thob bam snyam pa dang*/ sgoms pa yang min mi sgom pa yang min pas thob bam snyam pa nyid dang*/ de bzhin nyid kun gzhi'i ye shes la gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin gyi don min nam snyam pa'i sems byung gi rnam rtog 'phro ba la skyon can du lta ba'i rnam par rtog pa dgu ni/

sgom pa'i lam la gnas pa'i spang byar shes par bya'o// ci nas kyang sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos rnams mi rgyu ba de ltar sher phyin la spyad sgrub bsgom par bya'o// zhes so// gnyis pa 'dzin pa la btags pa dang 'dogs pa'i rgyu gnyis/ dang po btags pa ni/ sems can btags pa'i spyod yul dang*// chos btags pa dang stong min nyid// chags dang rab 'byed bdag nyid dang*// dngos por byed dang theg gsum dang*// yon ni dag pa ma yin dang*// spyod pa rnam par 'khrugs pa la// 'dzin par byed pa dang po de// shes par bya ba bsgrags pa yin// zhes pas bstan/ yul chos bdag gi gdags gzhi sems can rnam shes btags pa tsam du 'dzin pa'i spyod yul can dang de la snang ba'i chos rnams btags pa dang stong nyid min par kun rdzob snang tsam yod par zhen pa nyid dang dmigs yul la chags pa dang chos rnams shes rab kyis rab tu 'byed pa'i bdag nyid dang dngos por 'du byed pa'i zhen pa dang*/ theg gsum so sor zhen pa dang yum la mi gzhol ba yon tan gyi gnas ni dag pa ma yin dang 'khor gsum du rtog pas sbyin sogs spyod pa rnam par 'khrugs pa ste/ de rnams la btags pa tsam du zhen cing 'dzin par byed pa ni 'dzin rtog dang por de ni shes par bya bar bsgrags pa yin no// gang zag mi dmigs na ji ltar gdags par bya de ltar chos thams cad du ma btags pas rnam mkhyen thob par 'gyur/ zhes so// gnyis pa (108na)'dogs pa'i rgyu ni/ sems can btags dang de rgyu yi// yul can de yis rnam 'joms pas// sgom ba'i lam dang 'brel ba yi// mi mthun phyogs gzhan rnam pa dgu// bdag nyid ji bzhin kun mkhyen ni// gsum gyi sgrib pa rnam gsum dang*// zhi lam de bzhin nyid sogs dang*// mtshungs par ldan dang mi ldan dang*// mi mnyam sdug bsngal la sogs dang*// nyon mongs rnams kyi rang bzhin dang*//

gnyis su med la kun rmongs la// rnam par rtog pa tha mar bzhed// ces pas bstan/ sems can chos bdag tu btags pa dang 'dogs pa de'i gzhi'am rgyu'i yul can gnyis snang gi shes pa sgom lam de'i rnam par 'joms pas gnyen po sgom pa'i lam dang spang byar 'brel ba'i mi mthun phyogs 'dzin rtog snga ma las gzhan rnam pa dgu 'chad de zhes mgo 'dren pa'o// dgu ni yul mkhyen gsum gyis spangs pa'i bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin du kun mkhyen ni gsum gyi ngo bo rnam par dag pa la sgrib pa rnam pa gsum dang theg gsum gyi zhi ba'i lam dang chos nyid de bzhin nyid sogs dang yum mtshungs par ldan pa dang mi ldan pa dang spangs rtogs mi mnyam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa bzhi dang*/ nyon mongs rnams kyi rang bzhin zad skye med pa dang gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i don la kun tu rmongs pa rnams la rnam par rtog pa ni 'dzin rtog mtha' mar bzhed do// rnam mkhyen nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yin no// zhes so// gsum pa brten pa yon tan ni/ yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni// yun ring lon nas dbugs phyin ltar// rnam pa kun du 'gro ba yi// bde sgrub yon tan phun tshogs kun// rgya mtsho che la chu bo bzhin// 'bras bu mchog gis sba ba yi// sems dpa' chen po de la ni// rnam pa kun tu rten par byed// ces pas bstan/ yams nad dang 'dra ba'i shes sgrib 'di rnams sman dang 'dra ba'i spros med ye shes kyis zad par byas nas spangs pa de ni nad kyi ngal dub yun ring lon nas de las grol bas dbugs phyin zhing bde ba thob pa ltar du gyur pas de lta'i byang sems la rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba sgrub pa'i yon tan phun tshogs zad med kun rgya mtsho che la chu bo 'bab pa bzhin rgyun mi chad du 'byung zhing der ma zad 'bras bu rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog thob (108ba)pa dag gis mdzes shing dpa' ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po de la ni rnam pa kun tu brten par byed pa ste/

byang sems de ni myur du 'tshang rgya'o// mdo ni/ lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu ltar sems can thams cad la nye bar 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// zhes so// bzhi pa bar chad med lam gyi rtse sbyor la/ bar chad med rtse dngos/ lam gyi dmigs rnams la klan ka bsal ba'o// dang po bar chad med rtse dngos ni/ stong gsum skye bo nyan thos dang*// bse ru'i rtogs pa phun tshogs dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med la// bkod pa'i dge ba dper mdzad nas// bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni// sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar med de// bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin// de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid// ces pas bstan/ gnas ngan len gyi dri ma yang dag min rtog gi sa bon chags thogs kyi sgrib pa gzhom byed rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin rgyun mtha'i ye shes yin la de yang dpes bstan pa/ bar chad med pa'i lam gyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ stong gsum gyi skye bo thams cad nyan thos kyi rtogs pa dang rang rgyal bse ru lta bu'i rtogs pa phun tshogs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa skyon med pa sa dang po la bkod pa'i dge ba rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin 'di'i brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro zhes dper mdzad nas bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni bsgrubs pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'di dang sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar na sgrib pas chod pa med de de'i phyir bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes nyid yin no// mdo ni/ byang sems byang chub tu zhugs pa'i bsod nams kyi brgya'i char yang mi 'gro zhes so// gnyis pa la/ dmigs rnams bshad pa/ de la log rtog bsal ba'o// dang po la/ spyir rgyu rkyen gyi rnam gzhag /gzhung don bshad pa'o// dang po spyir rgyu rkyen gyi rnam gzhag ni/ rgyu ni 'bras bu nye bar len cing 'bras bu'i ngo bo bskyed pa ste/ dbye na rang las gzhan pa 'bras bu'i ngo bo bskyed pa byed rgyu/

tshogs pa (109na)gcig pa'i 'byung bzhi phan tshun rgyu 'bras lta bu lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu/ spang bya rang rigs dang sa mtshungs lta bu'i 'dra ba bskyed pa skal mnyam gyi rgyu/ gtso sems dang rang 'khor sems byung phan tshun phan 'dogs pa mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu/ nyon mongs can phyi ma rnams rang sa'i kun 'gro snga mas bskyed pa kun 'gro'i rgyu/ mi dge ba dang dge ba zag bcas ni rnam smin gyi rgyu ste drug go /rkyen ni 'bras bu'i khyad par bskyed pa ste/ dbye na/ rgyu tha ma lnga rgyu'i rkyen/ sems kyi skad cig snga ma ni phyi ma'i de ma thag rkyen/ gzugs sogs yul rnams rnam shes kyi dmigs rkyen/ byed rgyu ni bdag rkyen te bzhi'o// des na 'jim pas bum pa bskyed pa ltar rgyu rkyen mtshungs pa'ang yod do// gnyis pa gzhung don bshad pa ni/ 'di yi dmigs pa dngos med de// bdag po dran pa yin par bzhed//

rnam pa zhi nyid// ces pa'i bstan/ theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes 'di'i dmigs pa ni/ skye 'gag sogs kun rdzob pa'i dngos po med pa ste/ bdag po ni sgom pa'i shes rab bam dran pa yin par bzhed la rnam pa ni spros mtshan zhi ba rang rig ye shes nyid yin no// de dag ni tha snyad tsam du bzhag pa ste don tu de bzhin nyid la rgyu rkyen sogs bzhag tu med pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dmigs pa ni dngos po med pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa de la log rtog bsal ba la/ log rtog 'byung tshul/ de bsal tshul lo// dang po log rtog 'byung tshul ni/ 'di la ni// rab tu smra rnams brgyud mar rgol// zhes pa'i bstan/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lam gsungs pa 'di la ni/ de kho na nyid don dam pa'i rang bzhin las kun rdzob kyi rten (109ba)'brel sna tshogs zad med du 'char ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul blor mi shong ba'i rtog ge rab tu smra ba rnams kyis kun rdzob kyi dngos po rnams med na/ lam gyis dmigs pa nas yum sgom pa'i bar mi 'thad do zhes brgyud mar rgol bar 'gyur ro// mdor/ rab 'byor gyi dri ba'i sgo nas klan ka bcu drug dang*/ ston pas de dag gi lan gsungs shing*/ de'i tshe dngos su rgol ba med kyang dogs slongs lta bu'o// gnyis pa de bsal tshul ni/ dmigs pa 'thad dang 'di yi ni// ngo bo nyid nges gzung ba dang*// rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes dang*// dam pa'i don dang kun rdzob dang*// sbyor dang dkon mchog gsum po dang*// thabs bcas thub pa'i rtogs pa dang*// phyin ci log ni lam bcas dang*// gnyen po mi mthun phyogs dag dang*// mtshan nyid dang ni sgom pa la// smra ba rnams kyi log rtog pa// rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid rten can// rnam pa bcu drug dag tu bzhed// ces pas bstan/ 'dus byas kyi chos rnams 'khrul snang yin pa'i phyir 'phags chen gyi mnyam bzhag gi dmigs pa dngos med 'thad pa dang*/

chos dbyings las gzhan pa'i chos med pa'i phyir ye shes de'i ni ngo bo dngos med nyid du nges par gzung ba 'thad pa dang*/ chos nyid de chos thams cad kyi gshis la 'jug pa'i phyir des rnam pa kun mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes su 'thad pa dang*/ phan tshun thabs shes su 'gyur ba'i phyir dam pa'i don gyi bden pa dang kun rdzob kyi bden pa 'thad pa dang*/ de ni rtsa sher/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par// dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes pa lta bu'o// byang chub kyi don du spyod pa'i phyir phyin drug la sbyor ba 'thad pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i don rtogs pa'i phyir sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ de bzhin nyid byang chub yin pa'i phyir chos dkon mchog dang*/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub la slob pa'i phyir dge 'dun dkon mchog ste gsum po 'thad pa dang*/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs par 'jug pa'i phyir thabs mkhas dang bcas pa 'thad pa dang*/ spros pa rnams med nges su gzigs pa'i phyir (110na)thub pa'i rtogs pa 'thad pa dang*/ gzugs sogs rtag mi rtag gang du gzung yang 'dzin pa yin pas phyin ci log ni 'thad pa dang*/ lam thams cad la slob pa'i phyir rnam mkhyen thob byed kyi lam bcas 'thad pa dang*/ kun rdzob tu blang dor 'byung ba'i phyir gnyen po 'thad pa dang*/ spang bya mi mthun phyogs dag 'thad pa dang*/ thams cad chos dbyings su ro gcig pa'i phyir mtshan nyid 'thad pa dang ni gang yang yid la mi byed pa sgom pa yin pa'i phyir yum sgom pa 'thad pa ste/ de dag la 'khrul par smra ba rnams kyi log par rtog pa rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid la brten nas 'byung ba can gyi log lta rnam pa bcu drug bsal ba dag tu bzhed do// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las/ rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa'i skabs te lnga pa'o// zhes pas bstan/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs lnga pa'i 'grel pa'o/// / gsum pa de dag go rim du sgom pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba la/ 'brel bkod pa/ mngon rtogs bshad pa'o// dang po 'brel bkod pa ni/ rtse sbyor gyi mi mthun phyogs spangs nas rnam par grol ba'i lam rim gyi 'phel ba/ chos dbyings bstod par/ ji ltar tshes pa'i zla ba ni// rim gyis rim gyis 'phel bar 'gyur// skad cig skad cig rgyas par mthong*// de bzhin sa la bzhugs rnams kyang*// zhes pa ltar ro// log rtog bcu drug bsal ba'i mdor chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs nas 'tshang rgya bar gsungs pa las 'phros pa'i don/ gnyis pa mngon rtogs rgyas par bshad pa la/ spyod pa (110ba)bsod nams gtso bor gyur pa phyin drug /zung 'jug gi lam du gyur pa rjes dran drug /lta ba ye shes gtso bor sgom pa ngo bo nyid kyi sbyor ba'o// dang po spyod pa bsod nams gtso bor gyur pa phyin drug ni/ sbyin pa shes rab bar dag dang*// zhes pas bstan/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sbyin pa nas shes rab bar dag la spyod pa dang*/ shes rab ni ngo bo lta bar 'gyur med kyang spyod sgom gang la yang des zin dgos pas gang du yang bsdus pa'o// gnyis pa zung 'jug gi lam du gyur pa rjes dran drug ni/ sangs rgyas la sogs dran dang chos// zhes pas bstan/ sangs rgyas te rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rjes su dran pa dang la sogs pas dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi chos dang*/ byang sems phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun dang tshul khrims dang gtong ba dang lhar skyes pa'i 'phags pa rnams rjes su dran pa'o// de dag kyang dran pa med cing yid la byar med pas dran zhing sgom pa ste dkon mchog gsum la brten/ sbyin tshul gnyis phyin drug gi gzhir bzung lha la dpang por byas nas rnal 'byor sgom pa'o//

gsum pa lta ba ye shes gtso bor sgom pa ngo bo nyid kyi sbyor ba ni/ dngos med ngo bo nyid kyis de// mthar gyis pa yi bya bar bzhed// ces pas bstan/ rnam pa bsdus sgom gyi ngo bo mnyam nyid kyi rnal 'byor mtshan 'dzin gyi dngos pos gos pa med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi ste/ de dag ni mthar gyis pa'i bya ba ste sbyor bar bzhed do// mdo ni/ mthar gyi bya ba dang*/ mthar gyi bslab pa dang*/ mthar gyi sgrub pa rtsom mo// zhes so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las/ mthar gyis pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i skabs te drug pa'o// zhes pas bstan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs drug pa'i 'grel pa'o/// / bzhi pa de cig car du sgom pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la/ 'brel bkod pa/ mngon rtogs bshad pa'o// skabs bdun pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ dang po 'brel bkod pa ni/ (111na) bsdus sgom gyi rnal 'byor de rnams kyi spros pa ma lus bsal bas skad cig nyid la 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i sbyor ba ste/ phyin drug mi dmigs par sgom pa'i tshul gsungs pa las 'phros pa'o// gnyis pa mngon rtogs rgyas bshad la/ gnas ngan len gyi dri ma bral bzhin pa rnam smin min pa/ de dang bral nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su 'gyur kha ma rnam par smin pa/ mtshan nyid min pa/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'o// dang po gnas ngan len gyi dri ma bral bzhin pa rnam smin min pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang*// zag med chos kun bsdus pa'i phyir// thub pa'i skad cig gcig pa yi// rtogs pa 'di ni shes par bya// zhes pas bstan/ sbyin pa dang la sogs pas tshul khrims sogs zag med kyi chos re res kyang zag med kyi chos nam mkha' gang ba kun bsdus pas cig shin tu phra ba'i dri ma dang bral na thams cad de dang bral bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/

de dang mtshungs par thub pa'i ye shes kyi skad cig gcig rtogs pa yis de bzhin nyid ma lus par rtogs pa 'di ni rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes su shes par bya'o// mdo ni/ sems bskyed pa gcig gis phyin drug rdzogs par byed// ces so// gcig rtogs pas thams cad rtogs pa dpes bstan pa ni/ ji ltar skyes bus zo chun rgyun// rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na// thams cad cig car 'gul ba ltar// skad cig gcig shes de bzhin no// zhes so// gnyis pa de dang bral nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su 'gyur kha ma rnam par smin pa ni/ gang tshe chos dkar thams cad kyi// rang bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin// rnam smin chos nyid gnas skabs skyes// de tshe skad cig gcig ye shes// zhes pas bstan/ dus gang gi tshe chos dkar po rnam par byang ba thams cad kyi rang bzhin kun gzhi ye shes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gzod nas dri mas ma gos mod/ de lta na'ang ma rig pas rang rig pa'i ye shes la bslad pas de bzhin nyid yongs rdzogs ma mthong la rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyis shin tu phra ba'i dri ma yang bcom pa'i rnam smin (111ba)gyi tshul du/ so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyang chos nyid sher phyin nyid kyi gnas skabs su skyes te/ de nyid las ma 'das shing de'i ngo bo yin pas yul yul can dbyer med du gyur pa ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid yin la de'i tshe de'i skad cig ma snga ma gcig ni rgyun mtha'i ye shes so// de ltar klu sgrub kyis/ nam zhig sa yi mthar thug na// chos kyi sku yang rdzogs shing gsal// zhes so// mdo ni/ lam shes pa nyid la spyod cing chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par thob nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rjes su thob/ ces so// gsum pa mtshan nyid min pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs spyod pa yis// chos kun rmi lam 'drar gnas nas// chos rnams mtshan nyid med pa nyid// skad cig ma ni gcig gis rtogs//

zhes pas bstan/ yum las yang dag pa'i kun rdzob kyi rten 'brel shugs 'byung du 'byung bas mnyam bzhag de'i tshe yang sbyin pa la sogs pa'i spyod pa rgya che ba'i chos kun kyang rmi lam dang 'dra bar 'byung bar gnas nas chos de rnams kyang mtshan nyid med pa nyid du rtogs pa'i skad cig ma ni gcig gis rnam mkhyen mngon du byed pa'o// mdo ni/ sprul pa lta bu'i nyer len gyis phung po lnga la gnas shing phyin drug la spyod do// zhes so// bzhi pa gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma ni/ rmi lam dang ni de mthong nyid// gnyis kyi tshul du mi mthong ltar// chos rnams gnyis su med pa yi// de nyid skad cig gcig gis mthong*// zhes pas bstan/ dper na yul rmi lam yang shes pa yin pa dang ni yul can de mthong ba nyid kyang shes pa yin pas gnyis tha dad du med kyang yul yul can gnyis 'byung ba ltar ma rig gnyid kyi ngang nas gzung 'dzin gnyis tha dad du snang zhing*/ gnyid sad pa na rmi lam dang de mthong gang yang mi 'byung bas gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi tshul du mi mthong ba ltar/ ma rig bag chags dang bcas pa sangs na chos rnams yod med gnyis su mi mthong bar gnyis su (112na)med pa'i sems kyi dag pa de nyid skad cig gcig gis mthong bar byed pa'i sbyor ba'o// mdo ni/ yum la spyod pa'i tshe rmi lam mi mthong rmi lam mthong ba mi mthong*// zhes so// 'di rnams rgyun mtha'i ye shes rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gcig la nus pa so so'i cha yod pas phye ba'o// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las/ skad cig ma gcig pa'i mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i skabs te bdun pa'o// zhes pas bstan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs bdun pa'i 'grel pa'o//

gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku bshad pa la/ 'brel bkod pa/ dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po 'brel bkod pa ni/ lam sbyor bzhi rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pas rnam pa rnams je gsal du gyur te rang 'od kyis rang gi mun pa bsal ba ltar skye ba med pa gsum car mngon sum du rtogs pa'i chos sku thob par 'gyur te/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba bzhi pa'i mdo las 'phros nas gsungs pa'i don no// gnyis pa dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa la spyi gzhung gnyis/ dang po la/ sku'am thugs kyi rnam gzhag /des shes bya mkhyen tshul lo// dang po sku'am thugs kyi rnam gzhag ni/ kun gzhi'i ye shes yum chen mo bde gshegs snying po de la chos dbyings ye shes zhes kyang bya/ rten 'brel yang dag pa'i ye shes sna tshogs 'char bas/ sngags nas rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi sku zhes kyang gsungs so// de ni chos sku'am ngo bo nyid sku ste dbye gzhi'o// de la gdod nas dri mas gos ma myong ba 'od gsal ba'i cha ni me long ye shes te longs sku'o// de'i (112ba)dmigs pa med pa'i byams chen sems can thams cad la mnyam par khyab pa'i cha ni mnyam nyid ye shes so// de la rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char ba'i cha nas sor rtog ye shes des sems can thams cad kyi don sgrub pa'i phrin las kyi cha nas bya sgrub ye shes sprul pa'i sku'o// des na kun gzhi'i rnam shes sogs kyi dri ma bral ba las ye shes de dang de snang ba yin gyi de de dag tu 'gyur ba ni min te/ dper na sprin bsal bas nyi 'od 'byung yang sprin nyi 'od du gyur pa ma yin pa bzhin no// de rnams ni sangs rgyas rang gi gnas tshul las phye ba yin la gdul bya la snang ba'i gzugs sku dang gsung dbyangs mdzad pa rnams ni bya ba yul la yod pa'i phrin las kyi cha gdul bya rang rgyud gnyis snang gi chas bsdus pa'o// gnyis pa des shes bya mkhyen tshul ni/

sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la mnyam rjes kyi rnam gzhag don la bzhag tu med kyang tha snyad kyi ngor mnyam bzhag kho nar bzhugs pa yin la/ de'i tshe gnyis snang sa bon dang bcas pa med pa'i phyir ye shes de la kun rdzob mi snang ngo*// dper na rab rib bral na skra shad mi snang ba bzhin no// 'o na thams cad mkhyen par mi 'gyur ro snyam na/ skyon med de/ chos rnams kyi gnas tshul yod nges thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyir/ bden bzhi'i gnas lugs shes pa bzhin no// de ltar klu sgrub kyis/ de bzhin kun rdzob shes pa dag /blo gros mig ni bye gyur cing*// mi shes gnyid dang bral gyur nas// sad pa'i tshe na mi gzigs so// snang tshul mkhyen pa ni/ snang tshul nyid de gdul bya'i rgyud kyi bsdus pa gzugs skur snang ba dang chos gsung bar snang (113na)ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa gzhung don la/ ngo bo nyid sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku/ phrin las bshad pa'o// dang po la/ mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni// zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag / thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa// de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can// zhes pas bstan/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi chos sku ni/ de la zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag yod pa thams cad ngang gis thob par gyur pa'i cha dang*/ de sngar nas dri mas rnam pa kun tu rnam par dag pa de dag rang bzhin dbyer med gcig 'dres par gyur pa don la mtshan nyid med pa'i mtshan nyid can zhig go /mdo ni/ mtshan nyid med pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes so//

gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ zag med kyi chos brgya bzhi bcu so sor bshad/ nyon mongs med pa dang smon gnas mkhyen pa dmigs kyis phye ba/ khyab pa dang rtag pa'i don bstan pa'o// dang po zag med kyi chos brgya bzhi bcu so sor bshad pa ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang*// rnam par thar dang mthar gyis ni// snyoms 'jug dgu yi bdag nyid dang*// zad par bcu yi bdag nyid dang*// zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni// rab tu dbye bas rnam brgyad dang*// nyon mongs med dang smon mkhyen dang*// mngon shes so so yang dag rig / rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang*// dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang*// mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag dang*// bsrung ba med pa rnam gsum dang*// dran pa nyer gzhag rnam gsum dang*// bsnyel ba mi mnga'i chos nyid dang*// bag chags yang dag bcom pa dang*// skye la thugs rje chen po dang*// thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos// bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang*// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*// chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// zhes pas bstan/ zag med kyi chos gang zhe na/ lam thams cad kyang 'di'i yul can gyi dri ma bral rim gyis thob pas cung zad cung zad bral ba dang thams cad bral ba'i dbye bas byang phyogs nas chos sku'i bar rnams bstan pa/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang*// rnam par thar dang mthar gyis ni// snyoms 'jug dgu yi bdag nyid dang*// zhes pa rnams bstan zin la/ 'byung ba bzhi kha dog bzhi nam mkha' rnam shes rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin te/ zad par bcu yi bdag nyid la/ rten/ sgom tshul/ sgra don no// dang po ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ dang por sgom tshul/ sa la dmigs rten ma gsungs la/ gzhan snod chus bkang ba me 'bar ba rlung lus la phog pa tshon sngo ser dmar dkar gyi dkyil 'khor mtho gang ngam (113ba)sor bzhi pa'i bug pa mar me'i 'od rtsig ngos la phog pa rnams la dmigs nas de dag gi ming sa sogs yid la byas nas de dang des chos kun la khyab par bsgom zhing de brtan pa'i mtshan mar nam mkhar gnas pa'i nor bu'i rlung g.yab dang zla ba dmar po lta bu dang 'dug pa ltar mi g.yo ba dang dmigs rten kha dog de rnams nam mkhar 'phags nas nor bu'i rlung yab ltar mkhar snang ba dang bu ga bskyed nas nam mkha' ltar 'phel ba dang rab tu dang bas phyogs kun snang ba 'dra ba rnams 'grub pa'i rtags so// chu lbu ba can me du ba can rlung rlangs pa can sngo sogs bzhi la me tog ge sar dang sdong bu med pa lta bu/

bu ga bskyed mi nus pa thogs bcas su snang ba ni mi 'grub pa'i rtags so// phyis goms nas so sor dmigs pa mthong ba'i mod la ting nge 'dzin gsal bar 'gyur zhing*/ gcig nas mang po sogs dang chu dang nam mkhar gom pa 'dor ba dang sar 'dzul ba dang me sbar ba dang rlung ltar mgyogs pa dang bai ḍūr+ya sogs kyi sa gzhir bsgyur ba dang rtsig pa la thogs med 'gro ba dang gnyid rmugs rgyang ring du byed do// gsum pa ni/ rgyun mi 'chad du mtha' yas par spro ba'o// zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni/ rang la gzugs la 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs chung ngu bcud kyi sems can dang chen po snod kyi 'jig rten/ bzang po lha dang ngan pa mi la blta zhing gzugs de dag zil gyis mnan nas zhi gnas kyis shes lhag mthong gis mthong ba ni zil gnon gnyis/ rang la gzugs med par 'du shes pa de ltar blta ba zil gnon gnyis bzhi po 'di ni rnam thar dang po gnyis las 'byung ba'o// (114na)rang la gzugs med par 'du shes pa kho nas phyi'i gzugs kha dog lhan skyes sngon po dang sbyar ba'i sngon po lta bur ston pa gnyis kar 'od sngon po 'byung ba rnams blta zhing zil gyis mnan nas shes mthong ngo*// de bzhin ser dkar dmar por blta ba ni zil gnon bzhi ste dbyibs kyi bzhi kha dog gi bzhir rab tu dbye bas rnam brgyad dang*/ mdor kha dog la lhan skyes dang sbyar byung gi dpe gnyis gnyis kyang gsungs so// sgra don ni dbang 'byor ba'i phyir dmigs pa zil gyis gnon pa'o// de nas/ nyon mongs med dang smon mkhyen dang*/ mngon shes so sor yang dag rig /len pa gnas pa gtong ba la mnga' brnyes pas lus yongs dag dang sprul bsgyur la mnga' brnyes pas dmigs pa yongs dag dang ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pas thugs yongs dag dang ye shes la mnga' brnyes pas mkhyen pa yongs dag ste/ rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang*/

tshe byin gyis brlabs nas bskal pa'i bar du gnas nus pa dang*/ sems kyis ji ltar 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug nus pa dang yo byad nor gyi char 'bebs nus pa dang khams gong na myong 'gyur las 'dod par myong bar byed pa lta bu dang*/ bsam gtan las ma nyams par 'dod par skye nus pa lta bu dang sa chur chu sar sogs mos pa tsam gyis bsgyur nus pa dang*/ gzhan don zad pa med pa'i smon lam 'grub pa dang rdzu 'phrul dpag med gdul bya 'dul phyir ston pa dang*/ so so yang dag par rig pa'i ye shes dang bsam pa dang 'tsham par chos ston pa ste/ dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag (114ba)dang*/ sgo gsum gyi spyod pa shin tu dag pas gzhan la bcab dgos mi 'byung bas 'khor gyi nang du bag brkyang nas gsung ba ni bsrung ba med pa rnam gsum dang*/ chos nyan pa gus ma gus cha mnyam can gsum la chags sdang cha mnyam gyi g.yeng ba gsum mi mnga' bar btang snyoms kyi dran pa nyer gzhag rnam gsum dang*/ sems can gyi don dus yol gyi bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i mdzad pa 'bras bu can gyi chos nyid dang*/ sgrib gnyis kyi bag chags yang dag par bcom pas rgyu ba dang gnas pa nam du yang kun mkhyen min pa'i spyod pa lus ngag 'gyur ba med pa dang*/ su dar su rgud ces nyin mtshan lan drug tu skye bo thams cad la thugs rje chen pos gzigs pa dang*/ thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos/ bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang*/ sku gsum gyi byang chub brnyes nas sems can kun gyi the tshom gcod pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*/ de dag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin no// mdo ni/ zag pa med pa'i chos de dag kyang gang lags/ bka' rtsal pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun dang*/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa nyon mongs med pa dang smon gnas mkhyen pa dmigs kyi phye ba ni/

nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta// mi yi nyon mongs yongs spong nyid// grong sogs su de'i nyon mongs rnams// rgyun gcod rgyal ba'i nyon mongs med// sangs rgyas smon nas mkhyen pa ni// lhun gyis grub dang chags spangs dang*// thogs pa med dang rtag gnas dang*// 'dri ba kun lan 'debs par bzhed// ces pas bstan/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi nyon mongs pa med pa'i lta ba ni gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa skye ba'i rkyen spong ba tsam dang rang rgyud la med pa tsam yin la/ mi la sogs pa'i gdul bya mang po'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs yongs su spong ba nyid dang grong la sogs pa rnams su phebs pa tsam gyis der gnas pa'i skye bo rnams kyi nyon mongs rnams rgyun gcod pa'i mthu yod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs med (115na)pa'o// yang nyan rang gi smon gnas shes pa ni shes bya gang rung zhig shes par smon nas smon lam sngon du song ba las smon pa'i gnas de shes pa yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi smon gnas mkhyen pa ni/ gzod nas lhun gyis grub pa dang chags pa spangs ba dang thogs pa med par 'jug pa dang rtag tu mnyam bzhag la gnas pa dang*/ de'i ngang las the tshom can gyi dri ba kun gyi lan 'debs nus par bzhed do// gsum pa khyab pa dag rtag pa'i don bstan pa ni/ rgyu ni yongs su smin gyur na// gang dang gang la gang dang ni// gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa// de dang de la de snang ngo*// lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*// sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar// sangs rgyas rnams ni byung gyur kyang*// skal ba med pas bzang mi myong*// de ltar mdzad pa rgya che'i phyir// sangs rgyas khyab par nges par brjod// ces pas bstan/ chos sku ye gdod nas lhun grub tu bzhugs na sems can thams cad la mi snang ba ci/ gzhan don mi 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyang yod pa yin nam snyam na/

dri ma glo bur bar shes nas mnyam nyid kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa'i rgyu ni/ yongs su smin par gyur pa nas dad pa la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis gsos btab pa gdul bya gang dang gang la 'dul byed gang dang ni gang gi tshe phrin las kyi bya bas dri ma bsal zhing rtogs pa 'phel ba'i sgo nas phan par gyur pa na gdul bya de'i dag snang dang 'tsham par de la de snang ngo*// de lta min par sems can thams cad kyis mi mthong ba'i tshul ni/ dper na lha'i rgyal pos char phyogs ris med par phab pas/ sa bon nus ldan las 'bras bu bskyed kyang*/ sa bon rul pa lta bu'i mi rung ba las 'bras bu mi 'khrungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas rnams ni dus gsum rgyun chad med par byung bar gyur kyang ma rig pas bsgribs pa'i skal ba med pa rnams kyi 'bras bu bzang po mi myong zhing mi 'thob bo// des na rnam shes la mi snang bas chos sku khyab rtag min par mi 'gyur te/ lha'i char de ltar mdzad pa rgya che ba'i phyir sangs rgyas khyab par nges par (115ba)brjod/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// ces rgyud blar gsungs pa ltar/ de nyid zad pa med pa'i phyir// rtag pa zhes kyang brjod pa yin// zhes so// gnyis pa longs sku la/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid 'di// theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir// thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed// ces pas bstan/ sangs rgyas rang gi gnas tshul la ye shes kyi mtshan dpe 'bar la/ theg chen 'phags pa la de las dman pa dang*/ nyan thos sogs la de las kyang rags pa'i mtshan dpe snang ba'o// des na gzhan snang gi longs sku'i dbang du byas nas/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid 'di/ theg chen kho na'i chos la nye bar longs spyod pa'i phyir/ thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed do// mdo ni/

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ mtshan/ dpe byad bshad pa'o// dang po mtshan ni/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs// phyag dang zhabs sor drwa bas 'brel ba dang*// phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags// 'di yi sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang*// sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang*// zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs// byin pa e na ya'i 'dra phyag ring mdzes// 'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog / lpags pa gser mdog lpags pa srab pa dang*// spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang*// zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seng ge'i 'dra// 'di yi dpung pa'i mgo zlum thal gong rgyas// 'di la ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog snang*// sku ni n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab// gtsug tor dbur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang*// tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra dang tshems// shin tu dkar dang tshad mnyam thags bzang dang*// grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang*// spyan ni mthon mthing spyan rdzi ba mchog gi /'dra ba 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// zhes pas bstan/ sngon las kyi rgyu dang mtshan rang gi gnas tshul dang snga ltas kyi 'bras bu gsum gsum gyis ston te/ sngon bla ma bsu skyel dang chos nyan la bstod pa dang mchod rten la bsti stang byas pa'i rgyus phyag zhabs la rtsibs stong ldan pa'i 'khor lo ba so la brkos pa 'dra bas mtshan pa dang de ni 'khor shin tu mnga' ba'i snga ltas so// de bzhin sbyar nas/ dam bca' brtan pas rus sbal gyi lto ba ltar zhabs mthil mnyam pa ni mi g.yo ba'i dang*/ bsdu ba bzhir goms pas phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo'i bar sor gdub bzhes pa la mi gnod drwa bas 'brel ba bya ngang pa'i lta bu ni 'khor myur du 'du ba'i dang*/ bza' btung zhim la mang ba gzhan la sbyin pas phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa dang*/(116na)'di'i sku ni zhabs mthil gnyis phyag mthil gnyis phrag pa gnyis ltag pa ste bdun po dag tu skyong med par gzhan dang mnyam pas mtho ba de gnyis ni bza' bca' dang btung ba nyams su bde ba thob pa'i ltas dang*/

bcings pa bkrol bas sor mo ring ba zhabs mthil gyi dkyus dang mtho mnyam pa dang*/ srog bskyabs pas rting pa yangs pa zhabs bzhi cha phyir 'phags pa dang*/ srog gcod spangs pas sku'i ring thung la mi phal pa'i khru phyed dang bcu gcig yod pas byin las khru bdun gyi che zhing dgye sgur ma song bas drang ba dang gsum ni sku tshe ring ba'i dang*/ dge ba'i chos blangs pas zhabs pus mo'i lha nga dang long bu phyir 'bur ba mi mngon pa dang*/ dge ba blangs pa cher spel bas sku'i spu ni gyen du rtse mo phyogs pa dang gnyis ni mi mnyam pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i dang*/ rig pa dang bzo'i las rang gis blangs shing gzhan la sbyin pas byin pa 'tsham la zlum pa ri dwags e ṇa ya ste sha ba'i byin pa 'dra ba ni myur du 'dzin pa'i dang*/ ser sna ma byas pas ma btud par phyag mthil pus mo'i lha ngar sleb pas ring zhing mdzes pa ni yo byad mang ba dang dul ba'i dang*/ mdza' ba ma phye ba dang gzhan tshangs spyod la bskul zhing gsang tshig bsrungs pas rta cang shes ltar 'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa mchog ni bu mang ba'i dang*/ gzhan la gos stan byin pas lpags pa gser gyi mdog ltar snum pa dang*/ khang pa dang yul gnas sbyin pas lpags pa skyi srab la 'jam pa dang gnyis ni gos stan khang bzang gnas bzang thob pa'i dang*/ 'du 'dzi spangs pas ba spu ni bu ga gcig na gnyis med par re re (116ba)nas g.yas 'khyil legs 'khrungs dang*/ mkhan slob pha ma sogs tshul bzhin bkur bas zhal gyi smin mtshams su spu dkar 'jam 'od dang ldan pa shin tu phra ba sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi mdzod spu g.yas 'khyil gyis brgyan pa dang gnyis ni mnyam par med pa'i dang*/ smod lan du snyan par smras pas ro stod phel ka che ba seṅge'i 'dra ba dang*/ legs bshad mthun par 'dzin pas 'di'i dpung pa'i mgo rgyas shing zlum pa dang gnyis ni thub pa med pa'i dang*/ nad pa la sman dpyad rim gro byin pas thal gong mgrin pa zlum zhing mthong ga rgyas pa dang*/

'di la rtsi dang phan pa'i zas sbyin pas phal la ro mi zhim la yang ro mchog tu snang ba dang gnyis ni nad nyung ba'i dang*/ gzhan la skyed mos tshal byin pas sku ni ring thung dang 'dom tshad snyoms pas shing n+ya gro dha ltar mchu zheng gab pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang byin pas gtsug tor g.yas 'khyil zlum po dbu'i steng du sor bzhi tsam 'phags pa ldan pa dang gnyis ni mnga' thang che ba'i dang*/ tshig snyan cing 'jam pa kho na smras pas ljags kyis skra mtshams dang snyan gyi bar du khebs pas ring zhing mdzes pa dang*/ thams cad la dam pa'i chos go bar byas pas gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar nang du ji lta bar phyir thag ring du'ang thos pa dang gnyis ni yan lag lnga ldan gyi gsung mnga' ba'i dang*/ yan lag lnga ni/ yongs su shes shing shes par 'gyur ba dang*/ mnyan na dga' ba dang zab cing dbyangs rjes su 'byung ba dang btang mi bra ba ma 'khrugs shing gsal ba'o// tshig 'khyal spangs pas 'gram pa zlum rgyas seṅge'i 'dra ba ni tshig la (117na)kun gyis nyan pa'i dang*/ skye bo thams cad bkur bas tshems shin tu dkar ba dang*/ 'tsho ba rnam par dag pas tshems ring thung med par tshad mnyam pa gnyis ni 'khor snga nas sogs pa'i dang*/ bden pa'i tshig 'ba' zhig smras pas tshems thags bzang ba dang*/ phra ma spangs pas tshems grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang gnyis ni 'khor dbyer mi phyed pa'i dang*/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas pas spyan dkar nag ma 'dres pa nag po'i sa ni mthon mthing 'dra ba dang*/ chags sdang rmongs pa med par bltas pas spyan gyi rdzi ma ma 'dres pa ba khyu mchog gi dang 'dra ba gnyis ni kun nas mdzes pa'i snga ltas so// de ltar na/ 'di dag sum bcu rtsa gnyis mtshan/

de dag gi rgyu bstan pa ni/ 'di la mtshan ni gang gang gi /sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu gang yin// de dang de ni rab rdzogs pas// mtshan ni 'di dag yang dag 'grub// ces pas bstan/ de gang zhe na/ bla ma skyel la sogs pa dang*// yang dag blangs pa brtan pa dang*// bsdu ba bsten dang gya nom pa'i// dngos po sbyin dang bsad bya ba// thar bar byed dang dge ba ni// yang dag blangs pa spel la sogs// sgrub byed rgyu yi mtshan nyid de// mdo las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin// zhes gsungs pa rnams bkrol zin to// gnyis pa dpe byad bshad pa ni/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang*// mdog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams// zlum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang*// rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med// longs bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang*// seng ge glang chen bya dang ni// khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang*// mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags// byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tsham// gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku// mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang*// sku yi kho lag yangs shing bzang*// gom snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni// dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang*// sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang*// shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang*// yan lag shin tu rnam 'byes dang*// gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang*// sku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs dang*// phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni// zab dang g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang*// kun nas lta na sdug pa dang*// kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni// smre ba gnag bag med pa dang*// phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang*// phyag ris mdangs yod zab ring dang*// zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang*// mchu ni bim pa ltar dmar dang*// ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang*// dmar dang 'brug gi sgra nyid dang*// gsung mnyen 'jam dang mche ba zlum// rno dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang*// byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho dang*// mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni//

spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug /pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang*// smin tshugs ring dang 'jam pa dang*// snum dang spu ni mnyam pa dang*// phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang*// nyams pa rnam par spangs pa dang*// dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang*// dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang*// dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag dang*// stug dang 'jam dang ma 'dzings dang*// mi bshor dri zhim skyes bu yi// yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang*// dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni// sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed// ces pas bstan/ 'du byed las dben pas thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang*/ phan bde'i thugs mnga' bas sen mo mdog snum pa dang*/ rigs mtho bas sen mo mtho ba dang*/ kha na ma tho med pas sor mo rnams zlum pa dang*/ dge ba tshogs pas sor mo rgyas pa dang*/ dge ba grub pas sor mo'i rtse mo byin gyis phra ba dang*/ 'tsho ba rab tu bsrungs pas (117ba)rtsa lpags pa'i phyir mi mngon pa dang*/ nyon mongs med pas rtsa mdud pa med pa dang*/ dben pa'i chos mnga' bas long bu nang du 'bur ba mi mngon pa dang*/ 'gran zla med pas zhabs gnyis ring thung che chung med par mnyam pa dang*/ mi'i seṅge yin pas brjid par seṅge dang*/ mi'i glang chen yin pas thad kar glang chen dang*/ nam mkhar gshegs pas bya ngang pa'i dang ni mi'i khyu mchog yin pas 'khor gyi sna 'dren pa khyu mchog gi stobs kyis gshegs pa dang*/ mthun pa'i lam mnga' bas g.yas phyogs nas 'byon zhing g.yas nas ldog pa dang*/ bltas na mdzes par gshegs pa dang*/ thugs ma yo bas sku drang por gshegs pa dang*/ dag pa'i yon tan ston pas sku 'gying legs pa 'khril bag chags pa dang*/ sdig pa med pas sku dri med byi dor byas 'dra dang*/ gdul byar 'tsham pa'i chos ston pas sbom phra dang*// skabs phyed pa'i rim par 'tsham pa dang*/ kun spyod dag pas sku gtsang ba dang*/ thugs 'jam pas sku 'jam pa reg na bde ba dang*/

thugs dag pas sku dag pa dang*/ chos 'dul ba rdzogs pas mtshan so gnyis ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ yon tan yangs shing bzang bas sku'i kho lag khyon che ba yangs shing bzang ba dang*/ thugs thams cad la snyoms pas gom pa che chung snyoms pa dang*/ spyan gnyis ni gzigs pa dag pa dang*/ 'jam pa'i chos ston pas sku gzhon sha can nyid dang*/ thugs mi zhum pas sku sha zhum pa med pa dang*/ mi dge ba thams cad byang bas sku sha khengs te rgyas pa dang*/ yang srid bcom pas sku mi lhod par shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang*/ rten 'brel ston pas yan lag rnams kyi ring 'os ring (118na)thung 'os thung ba shin tu rnam par 'byes pa dang*/ spyan la rab rib sogs gzigs par sgrib pa med cing mig rnag sogs mi 'byung bas dag pa dang*/ slob ma khrims ldan 'khor bas sku'i phyal zlum pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i skyon med pas rked skabs phyin pa dang*/ nga rgyal med pas phyal ma rnyongs pa rgyu ltongs min pa dang*/ chos ston pa zad pa med pas phyal la mtho kyong med pa phyang nge ba dang*/ chos zab mo rtogs pas lte ba'i khung bu ni gting zab pa dang*/ gdam ngag 'dzin pa'i slob ma 'du bas lte ba'i ri mo g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang*/ spyod lam mdzes pa'i dge 'dun 'du bas sku'i spyod pa kun nas lta na sdug pa dang*/ sgo gsum gyi kun spyod gtsang ba dang*/ chos nag po bral bas sku la ni rme ba dang sha mtshan gnag bag med pa dang*/ nyams su len bde ba'i chos ston pas phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam pa dang*/ dge sbyong chen po brnyes pas phyag gi ri mo la snum pa'i mdangs yod pa dang*/ brtan par bzhugs pas phyag gi ri mo zab pa dang*/ bzod pa'i chos ston pas phyag gi ri mo ring ba dang*/ bslab pa phra mo nas 'cha' bas zhal sgros ni ha cang mi ring ba dang*/ gzugs brnyan 'jig rten du bkye bas mchu ni me tog bim pa ltar dmar zhing gzugs brnyan snang ba dang*/

tshig 'jam pos 'dul bas ljags bde zhing mnyen pa dang*/ yon tan phra ba'i tshogs dang ldan pas ljags srab pa dang*/ chos 'dul ba gting dpag dka' bas ljags dmar ba dang*/ bsnyengs pa mi mnga' bas 'brug gi sgra ltar brjid pa nyid ldan (118ba)pa dang*/ 'jam par smra ba'i slob ma mnga' bas gsung mnyen cing 'jam pa dang*/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba las 'das pas mche ba zlum pa dang*/ gdul dka' 'dul bas mche ba rno ba dang*/ chos 'dul ba dkar bas mche ba dkar ba dang*/ mnyam pa nyid la gnas pas mche ba ring thung sogs mnyam pa dang*/ mngon rtogs rim gyis ston pas mche ba'i rtse mo byin gyi phra ba dang*/ shes rab kyi ri bo la gnas pas shangs mtho ba dang*/ 'dul ba'i skye bo gtsang ma mnga' bas shangs la dri ma med pas mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos yangs pa mnga' bas spyan dkyus ring zhing yangs pa dang*/ sems can gyi tshogs 'dren pas spyan gyi rdzi ma stug pa dang*/ lha dang lha min na chung sogs dga' bar byed pas spyan dkar nag phyed pa pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang*/ phyi rjes su gzigs pas smin ma g.yas g.yon 'brel bas tshugs ring ba dang*/ 'jam por 'dul bas smin ma 'jam pa dang*/ dge ba'i snum dang ldan pas smin ma snum pa dang*/ skyon thams cad mkhyen pas smin ma'i spu ni ring thung sogs mnyam pa dang*/ gnod pa bzlog pas phyag ring zhing rgyas pa dang*/ nyon mongs las rgyal bas snyan mtho dman che chung mnyam pa dang*/ bsam pa ma nyams pas 'dul bas snyan 'on pa sogs nyams pa rnam par spangs pa dang*/ lta ba thams cad byang bas skra mtshams dod pa ni dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang*/ phas rgol 'dul bas dpral ba'i dbyes che ba dang*/ smon lam dam pa rdzogs pas dbu gdugs ltar rgyas pa dang*/ yul gyi dga' (119na)ba ldog pas dbu la skra dkar mi 'byung zhing bung ba ltar kha dog gnag pa dang*/ spang bya'i bag nyal zad pas dbu skra stug pa dang*/

thugs 'jam pos bstan pa'i snying po thugs su chud pas skra 'jam pa dang*/ thugs ma 'khrugs pas skra ma 'dzings pa dang*/ brlang ba'i gsung dang bral bas skra gyen la ma brdzes pa mi bshor ba dang*/ byang chub yan lag gi spos bsgrubs pas skra'i dri zhim pas skyes bu'i yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang*/ phyag zhabs la dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni rdzas brgyad dang ri mo gru bzhi sogs yod pa ni sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed do// gsum pa sprul sku ni/ gang gis srid pa ji srid bar// 'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag / mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni// thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi chad// ces pas bstan/ bzo sprul sku dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' 'dul ba'i phyir pi wang mkhan du sprul ba lta bu dang*/ skye ba sprul pa ni gzings zam pa sman 'bras bu 'bab chu sogs ji ltar 'dod pa'i sprul pa 'byung ba dang*/ byang chub chen po'i sprul sku ni mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs ston pa'o// de ltar gdul bya gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i sku sna tshogs pas srid pa ji srid par 'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag cig car mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni thub pa'i sprul sku yin pas rgyun mi 'chad 'byung ngo*// mdo ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa sna tshogs pa'i phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ zhes so// bzhi pa 'phrin las la/ gnas tshul gyi phrin las mdor bstan/ snang tshul so sor bshad pa'o// dang po gnas tshul gyi phrin las mdor bstan pa ni/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i// las ni rgyun mi chad par 'dod// ces pas bstan/ sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad pa de bzhin du 'khor ba ji srid par chos dbyings ye shes 'di'i las rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba (119ba)ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod de rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa snang tshul so sor bshad pa ni/ 'gro rnams zhi ba'i las dang ni// bsdu rnam bzhi la dgod pa dang*//

kun nas nyon mongs bcas pa yi// rnam par byang ba rtogs pa dang*// sems can rnams don ji bzhin gyi// don dang pha rol phyin drug dang*// sangs rgyas lam dang rang bzhin gyis// stong pa nyid dang gnyis zad dang*// brda dang dmigs pa med pa dang*// lus can rnams ni yongs smin dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ni// mngon par zhen pa bzlog pa dang*// byang chub thob dang sangs rgyas zhing*// rnam par dag dang nges pa dang*// sems can don ni tshad med dang*// sangs rgyas bsten sogs yon tan dang*// byang chub yan lag lam rnams ni// chud mi za dang bden mthong dang*// phyin ci log ni spangs pa dang*// de gzhi med pa'i tshul dang ni// rnam par byang dang tshogs dang ni// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa la// tha dad yongs su mi shes dang*// mya ngan 'das la dgod pa ste// chos kyi sku yi phrin las ni// rnam pa nyi shu bdun du bzhed// ces pas bstan/ 'bad med du 'byung ba'i mdzad pa nyer bdun te/ ngan song gi 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal dang 'dod lha rnams 'dod par zhen pa dang tshangs pa rnams lta ba zhi ba ste gcig ni lam gyi rten la 'god pa dang ni/ mi'i 'gro ba rnams bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi la 'god pa dang*/ thos bsam gyi dor bya kun nas nyon mongs dang bcas pa dang*/ blang bya rnam par byang ba rtogs pa gnyis ni tshogs lam la 'god pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi don ji lta ba bzhin gyi lam tshad med bzhi'i don dang*/ pha rol phyin drug dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi lam dge bcu dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du shes pa bzhi ni sbyor lam la 'god pa dang*/ gnyis chos thams cad gdod nas zad pa gcig ni mthong lam la 'god pa dang*/ tha snyad kyi chos rnams brdar btags pa tsam dang*/ 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa dang*/ lus can gzhan rnams ni yongs su smin nus pa dang*/ nyan rang dang thun mong min pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ni/

mngon par zhen pa'i 'dzin pa bzlog pa dang*/ byang chub thob pa ltar mdzad pa bcu ston nus pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi snod bcud kyi zhing rnam par dag par sbyong nus pa dang*/ skye ba phyi ma zhing 'dir sangs rgyas 'di zhes nges par 'gyur ba dang*/ sems can don ni tshad med sgrub nus pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bsten pa dang sogs pas bsnyen bkur bgyid pa dang yon tan shes par nus pa dang*/ tshe 'di la byang chub chen po thob nus pa'i yan lag rdzogs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thob nges pas dge ba'i las rnams ni chud mi za ba dang*/ bden pa'i de kho na nyid (120na)skad cig la mthong nus pa dang*/ rtag 'dzin sogs phyin ci log bzhi ni spangs pa dang*/ de'i gzhi yang dag min rtog gi sa bon med par byed pa'i tshul dang ni/ zag med rnam par byang ba'i chos rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang ni/ 'dus byas 'khor ba 'dus ma byas pa myang 'das la tha dad yongs su mi shes pas mnyam pa nyid dang bco brgyad ni sgom lam la 'god pa dang*/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la 'god pa ste gcig ni 'bras bu la 'god pa'o// mdo ni/ sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ zhes so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las/ chos sku'i skabs te brgyad pa'o// zhes pas bstan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs brgyad pa'i 'brel pa'o// gnyis pa 'bring la mos pa'i gang zag la drug tu bstan pa ni/ mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang*// de rab de yi go rim dang*// de mtha' de yi rnam smin ni// don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa drug / ces pas bstan/ gzhi lam 'bras bu dbyer mi phyed pa sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid mkhyen gsum gcig tu byas/

de rtogs byed kyi sbyor ba dang de rab dang de'i go rim dang de'i mtha' ste sbyor ba bzhi/ sbyor ba de'i rnam smin chos sku'i rang zhal mthong ba 'bras bu chos sku gcig dang bcas pa ni don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa drug go// gsum pa bsdus pa la mos pa'i gang zag la gsum du bstan pa ni/ yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu// sbyor ba bzhi yi bdag nyid dang*// chos sku 'phrin las 'bras bu ni// don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum// zhes pas bstan/ glo bur gyi dri ma rab rib lta bu sel ba'i yul kun gzhi'i ye shes yum sher phyin ldog cha nas ni mkhyen pa rnam pa gsum po ru phye ba gcig tu byas/ de la sgrib pa'i dri ma kun (120ba)rdzob pa ri bong gi rwa lta bu de ltar yin par rtogs byed kyi rgyu skye med du sgom pa'i rnal 'byor gong 'phel gyi sgo nas phye ba sbyor ba bzhi'i bdag nyid gcig tu byas/ des 'khrul snang yul dang bcas pa dag nas rang ngo rang gis rig par gyur pa chos sku phrin las 'bras bu dang bcas pa gcig rnams ni don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum mo// gsum pa mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba/ rje btsun byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / zhes pas bstan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rdzogs so/// /

rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi d+yā kā ra pradz+nyā dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dpal go mi 'chi med la sogs pa dang lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis legs par gtan la phab pa'o// gang tshe skom pas nyen pa'i sems can phra mo'i mdun du glo bur rgya mtsho lud gyur na// de tshe rab tu skrag cing 'thung ba'i spros pa nye bar zhi bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du ci// de bzhin yul don bde blag rtogs par 'dod pa'i skye bo blo gros dman pa 'ga' zhig gis// bla ma'i legs bshad zab rgyas mi rtogs de phyir bdag gi chu thigs lta bu 'di brtsams so// sbas don mngon rtogs 'chad tshe yang*// dngos bstan stong nyid du lhung ba'i// mkhas rnams mtshar byas tshur shog dang*// bstan bcos 'di la blta bar gyis// des na 'di brtsams pa dang 'di la gzhan gyis rjes su yi rang dang*// 'di nyid bklags dang 'di la thos bsam nyams len (121na)bgyis pa gang yin rnams// mtha' yas sems can 'khrul pa'i dri ma sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems pa'i phyir// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal nyid du 'khor gsum dag pas bsngo bar bgyi// zhes pa ni rang gzhan kun la phan par sems pa'i blos rab tu bskul nas zhwa dmar ba lnga pas rang lo nyer gsum gyi thog lug lo zla ba brgyad pa la grub par byas pa'i dge bas mtshungs med bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs nas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// / ༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhi rastu/ deng 'dir gsung rab rin chen 'phrul par du// bzhengs dges legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum du// bgyis pa'i dge tshogs dri ma med pa rnams// gcig tu bsdoms te mthun rkyen sgrub rnams dang*// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe ring 'byor ldan zhing*// ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te// bla med rnam grol thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// bstan 'dzin dam pa gang na su bzhugs rnams// sku tshe'i rkyen gegs tha dag rab zhi nas// bstan 'gro'i don chen bla med mdzad bzhin du// dam chos bdud rtsi'i sbrang char 'bebs gyur cig

/yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu lo legs shing*// nad mug 'khrug rtsod thams cad zhi ba dang*// mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags par// rdzogs ldan dang po'i lang tsho 'char bar shog /de'i mthus kha ba ris pa'i skye dgu'i yid// rnam dkar dge ba'i las la phyogs pa dang*// mthun rkyen legs tshogs gong nas gong 'phel te// dam chos 'dzin pa'i snod du rung bar shog /'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na pad+mo yi// zhabs pad bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir myur bkod de// zhi bsil chos kyi bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ror// longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang myur 'char shog /khyad par bstan pa'i snying po sgrub brgyud kyi// ring lugs dri med sa chen yongs khyab ste// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// sku tshe mi 'gyur tshe lha'i ngo bor brtan// phrin las mi zad nyi zla'i 'od dang sdeb// 'dus tshogs dge 'dun bgrang yas rgyu skar la// zab rgyas chos kyi gru char 'bebs par shog /lha rnams mkha' la shis pa'i glu dbyangs len// 'gro rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i yun du 'tsho// klu rnams dga' bas nor 'dzin dbyig gis bkang*// mthar thug sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog /ces pa'ang 7 rgyal dbang karma pa o rgyan phrin las rdo rje mchog dgung grangs bcu gsum steng*/ 'og min mtshur phu'i gdan sar ljags rtsom gnang ba'i rten gsum gsar bzhengs kyi dge bsngo'i smon tshig byin rlabs can no/// /
